+@dsl_user_op
+def _tcgen05_after_thread_sync(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [],
+        "tcgen05.fence::after_thread_sync;",
+        "",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _tcgen05_before_thread_sync(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [],
+        "tcgen05.fence::before_thread_sync;",
+        "",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _tmem_load_f32x2(tmem_addr: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Tuple[Float32, Float32]:
+    result = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32(), T.i32()]),
+        [Int32(tmem_addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned.32x32b.x2.b32 {$0, $1}, [$2];",
+        "=r,=r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Float32(
+            llvm.bitcast(
+                T.f32(),
+                llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip),
+                loc=loc,
+                ip=ip,
+            )
+        )
+        for i in range(2)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _tmem_load_f32x4(
+    tmem_addr: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> Tuple[Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32]:
+    result = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32()]),
+        [Int32(tmem_addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned.32x32b.x4.b32 {$0, $1, $2, $3}, [$4];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Float32(
+            llvm.bitcast(
+                T.f32(),
+                llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip),
+                loc=loc,
+                ip=ip,
+            )
+        )
+        for i in range(4)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _tmem_load_f32x8(
+    tmem_addr: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> Tuple[Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32, Float32]:
+    result = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal(
+            [T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32(), T.i32()]
+        ),
+        [Int32(tmem_addr).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "tcgen05.ld.sync.aligned.32x32b.x8.b32 {$0, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7}, [$8];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,=r,=r,=r,=r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Float32(
+            llvm.bitcast(
+                T.f32(),
+                llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip),
+                loc=loc,
+                ip=ip,
+            )
+        )
+        for i in range(8)
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _tmem_load_f32_heads(
+    tmem_addr: Int32,
+    q_heads_per_kv: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    # Keep the address collective and let the SM100 .32x32b fragment map one
+    # K row to one lane. This is the same interleaved local-load contract used
+    # by DeepGEMM; a CuTe epilogue layout must not rewrite the TMEM address.
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_heads_per_kv == 2):
+        return _tmem_load_f32x2(tmem_addr)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(q_heads_per_kv == 4):
+        return _tmem_load_f32x4(tmem_addr)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(q_heads_per_kv == 8):
+        return _tmem_load_f32x8(tmem_addr)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("SM100 prefill TMEM local reduction supports H=2/4/8")
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _device_contract_trap() -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [],
+        "trap;",
+        "",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )

+@cute.jit
+def _prefill_persistent_work_info(
+    work_idx: Int32,
+    mCuSeqlensQ: cute.Tensor,
+    mCuSeqlensK: cute.Tensor,
+    batch_size: Int32,
+    block_q: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    grid_k_work_items = PREFILL_GRID_K // PREFILL_COMPILED_WORK_K_GROUP
+    q_block_ordinal = work_idx // Int32(grid_k_work_items)
+    k_partition = (work_idx % Int32(grid_k_work_items)) * Int32(
+        PREFILL_COMPILED_WORK_K_GROUP
+    )
+    batch_idx = Int32(0)
+    q_start = Int32(0)
+    q_global_row = Int32(0)
+    q_local_block = Int32(0)
+    valid_seq_q = Int32(0)
+    valid_seq_k = Int32(0)
+    request_block_prefix = Int32(0)
+    found = False
+    for batch in cutlass.range(batch_size, unroll=1):
+        batch_q_start = mCuSeqlensQ[batch]
+        batch_q_end = mCuSeqlensQ[batch + Int32(1)]
+        request_q = batch_q_end - batch_q_start
+        request_q_blocks = cute.ceil_div(request_q, block_q)
+        owns_q = (q_block_ordinal >= request_block_prefix) & (
+            q_block_ordinal < request_block_prefix + request_q_blocks
+        )
+        if owns_q:
+            batch_idx = batch
+            q_start = batch_q_start
+            q_local_block = q_block_ordinal - request_block_prefix
+            q_global_row = batch_q_start + q_local_block * Int32(block_q)
+            valid_seq_q = request_q
+            valid_seq_k = mCuSeqlensK[batch + Int32(1)] - mCuSeqlensK[batch]
+            found = True
+        request_block_prefix = request_block_prefix + request_q_blocks
+
+    q_block_last = cutlass.min(
+        (q_local_block + Int32(1)) * Int32(block_q), valid_seq_q
+    ) - Int32(1)
+    min_actual_q = cutlass.max(
+        valid_seq_q - Int32(block_q - 1), q_block_last + Int32(1)
+    )
+    max_query_position = (
+        valid_seq_k * Int32(REGION_TOKENS) - min_actual_q + q_block_last
+    )
+    causal_regions = cutlass.max(Int32(0), max_query_position // Int32(REGION_TOKENS))
+    causal_regions = cutlass.min(causal_regions, valid_seq_k)
+    valid_k_blocks = cute.ceil_div(causal_regions, PREFILL_BLOCK_KV)
+    valid = (
+        found
+        & (valid_seq_q > Int32(0))
+        & (valid_seq_k > Int32(0))
+        & (k_partition < valid_k_blocks)
+    )
+    return (
+        valid,
+        q_global_row,
+        q_local_block,
+        k_partition,
+        batch_idx,
+        q_start,
+        valid_seq_q,
+        valid_seq_k,
+        causal_regions,
+        valid_k_blocks,
+    )
+

+@cute.kernel
+def _pack_prefill_qw_kernel(
+    mQIn: cute.Tensor,
+    mWIn: cute.Tensor,
+    mQOut: cute.Tensor,
+    mWOut: cute.Tensor,
+    total_q_elems: Int32,
+    total_w_elems: Int32,
+    batch_q: Int32,
+    q_heads_per_kv: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block_q: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    tid = (
+        cute.arch.block_idx()[0] * Int32(PREFILL_PREPARE_THREADS)
+        + cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    )
+    total = total_q_elems + total_w_elems
+    if tid < total_q_elems:
+        dim = tid % Int32(HEAD_DIM)
+        packed_row = tid // Int32(HEAD_DIM)
+        q_idx = packed_row // Int32(q_heads_per_kv)
+        head = packed_row % Int32(q_heads_per_kv)
+        valid = q_idx < batch_q
+        safe_q = cutlass.select_(valid, q_idx, Int32(0))
+        safe_head = cutlass.select_(valid, head, Int32(0))
+        value = mQIn[safe_q, Int32(0), safe_head, dim]
+        mQOut[packed_row, dim] = cutlass.select_(
+            valid, cvt_f32_to_e4m3(Float32(value)).to(Uint8), Uint8(0)
+        )
+    if (tid >= total_q_elems) & (tid < total):
+        weight_tid = tid - total_q_elems
+        head = weight_tid % Int32(q_heads_per_kv)
+        q_idx = weight_tid // Int32(q_heads_per_kv)
+        valid = q_idx < batch_q
+        safe_q = cutlass.select_(valid, q_idx, Int32(0))
+        value = mWIn[safe_q, Int32(0), head]
+        mWOut[q_idx, head] = cutlass.select_(valid, Float32(value), Float32(0.0))
+
+
+def _make_pack_prefill_qw_call_v2(q_heads_per_kv: int, block_q: int):
+    @cute.jit
+    def _call_v2(
+        mQIn: cute.Tensor,
+        mWIn: cute.Tensor,
+        mQOut: cute.Tensor,
+        mWOut: cute.Tensor,
+        stream,
+        grid_x: Int32,
+        total_q_elems: Int32,
+        total_w_elems: Int32,
+        batch_q: Int32,
+    ):
+        _pack_prefill_qw_kernel(
+            mQIn,
+            mWIn,
+            mQOut,
+            mWOut,
+            total_q_elems,
+            total_w_elems,
+            batch_q,
+            q_heads_per_kv,
+            block_q,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=[grid_x, 1, 1],
+            block=[PREFILL_PREPARE_THREADS, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    return _call_v2
+
+
+@cached_compile_function
+def _compile_pack_prefill_qw_for_signature(
+    device_key: tuple[str, Optional[int]],
+    q_signature: tuple[torch.dtype, tuple[object, ...], tuple[object, ...]],
+    w_signature: tuple[torch.dtype, tuple[object, ...], tuple[object, ...]],
+    q_out_signature: tuple[torch.dtype, tuple[object, ...], tuple[object, ...]],
+    w_out_signature: tuple[torch.dtype, tuple[object, ...], tuple[object, ...]],
+    q_heads_per_kv: int,
+    block_q: int,
+):
+    device = sparse_utils.device_from_cache_key(device_key)
+    q = _placeholder_from_signature(
+        q_signature, device=device, dynamic_shape_fill=block_q
+    )
+    weights = _placeholder_from_signature(
+        w_signature, device=device, dynamic_shape_fill=block_q
+    )
+    q_out = _placeholder_from_signature(
+        q_out_signature, device=device, dynamic_shape_fill=PREFILL_BLOCK_QH
+    )
+    w_out = _placeholder_from_signature(
+        w_out_signature, device=device, dynamic_shape_fill=block_q
+    )
+    f_q = sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+        q, alignment=TMA_COPY_ALIGN_BYTES, dynamic_shape_dim=0, divisibility=block_q
+    )
+    f_w = sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+        weights,
+        alignment=TMA_COPY_ALIGN_BYTES,
+        dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+        divisibility=block_q,
+    )
+    f_q_out = sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+        q_out,
+        alignment=TMA_COPY_ALIGN_BYTES,
+        dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+        divisibility=PREFILL_BLOCK_QH,
+    )
+    f_w_out = sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+        w_out,
+        alignment=TMA_COPY_ALIGN_BYTES,
+        dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+        divisibility=block_q,
+    )
+    stream_fake = cute.runtime.make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=True)
+
+    return _cute_compile(
+        _make_pack_prefill_qw_call_v2(q_heads_per_kv, block_q),
+        f_q,
+        f_w,
+        f_q_out,
+        f_w_out,
+        stream_fake,
+        Int32(
+            (q_out.numel() + w_out.numel() + PREFILL_PREPARE_THREADS - 1)
+            // PREFILL_PREPARE_THREADS
+        ),
+        Int32(q_out.numel()),
+        Int32(w_out.numel()),
+        Int32(q.shape[0]),
+    )
+

+@cute.jit
+def _prefill_work_barrier(
+    work_done_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    phase: Int32,
+) -> Int32:
+    lane_idx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % Int32(LANES_PER_WARP)
+    if lane_idx == Int32(0):
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(work_done_ptr)
+    cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(work_done_ptr, phase)
+    return phase ^ Int32(1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _prefill_consumer_loop(
+    tmem_base: cute.Pointer,
+    sW: cute.Tensor,
+    mO: cute.Tensor,
+    mCuSeqlensQ: cute.Tensor,
+    mCuSeqlensK: cute.Tensor,
+    w_full_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    w_empty_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    s_full_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    s_empty_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    work_done_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+    total_work: Int32,
+    batch_size: Int32,
+    consumer_stage: Int32,
+    q_heads_per_kv: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block_q: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    consumer_tidx = tidx % Int32(128)
+    w_stage = Int32(0)
+    w_phase = Int32(0)
+    tmem_stage = consumer_stage
+    tmem_phase = Int32(0)
+    work_done_phase = Int32(0)
+    work_idx = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    while work_idx < total_work:
+        (
+            valid_work,
+            q_global_row,
+            q_local_block,
+            k_partition,
+            _,
+            _,
+            valid_seq_q,
+            _,
+            causal_regions,
+            valid_k_blocks,
+        ) = _prefill_persistent_work_info(
+            work_idx, mCuSeqlensQ, mCuSeqlensK, batch_size, block_q
+        )
+        if valid_work:
+            q_local_base = q_local_block * Int32(block_q)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(w_full_ptr + w_stage, w_phase)
+            weight_regs = cute.make_rmem_tensor((block_q, q_heads_per_kv), Float32)
+            for q_slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(block_q):
+                valid_q_slot = (q_local_base + Int32(q_slot)) < valid_seq_q
+                for head in cutlass.range_constexpr(q_heads_per_kv):
+                    weight = Float32(sW[Int32(q_slot), Int32(head), w_stage])
+                    weight_regs[q_slot, head] = cutlass.select_(
+                        valid_q_slot, weight, Float32(0.0)
+                    )
+
+            for k_group_offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+                PREFILL_COMPILED_WORK_K_GROUP
+            ):
+                kv_block = k_partition + Int32(k_group_offset)
+                while kv_block < valid_k_blocks:
+                    cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(s_full_ptr + tmem_stage, tmem_phase)
+                    _tcgen05_after_thread_sync()
+                    kv_base = kv_block * Int32(
+                        PREFILL_BLOCK_KV
+                    ) + consumer_stage * Int32(PREFILL_MMA_TILE_M)
+                    for q_slot in cutlass.range_constexpr(block_q):
+                        tmem_addr = Int32(
+                            tmem_base.toint()
+                            + tmem_stage * Int32(PREFILL_BLOCK_QH)
+                            + Int32(q_slot * q_heads_per_kv)
+                        )
+                        acc_token_val = _tmem_load_f32_heads(tmem_addr, q_heads_per_kv)
+                        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_load()
+                        weighted = Float32(0.0)
+                        row = consumer_tidx
+                        for head in cutlass.range_constexpr(q_heads_per_kv):
+                            raw = acc_token_val[head]
+                            value = cute.arch.fmax(raw, Float32(0.0))
+                            weighted = weighted + value * weight_regs[q_slot, head]
+                        if q_slot == block_q - 1:
+                            _tcgen05_before_thread_sync()
+                            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(s_empty_ptr + tmem_stage)
+                        key = kv_base + row
+                        q_local_idx = q_local_base + Int32(q_slot)
+                        if (q_local_idx < valid_seq_q) & (key < causal_regions):
+                            dst = cute.make_tensor(
+                                elem_pointer_i64_offset(
+                                    mO, (q_global_row + Int32(q_slot), key)
+                                ),
+                                cute.make_layout((1,), stride=(1,)),
+                            )
+                            dst[0] = mO.element_type(weighted)
+                    next_tmem_stage = tmem_stage + Int32(PREFILL_NUM_CONSUMER_GROUPS)
+                    if next_tmem_stage >= Int32(PREFILL_S_STAGES):
+                        next_tmem_stage = next_tmem_stage - Int32(PREFILL_S_STAGES)
+                        tmem_phase = tmem_phase ^ Int32(1)
+                    tmem_stage = next_tmem_stage
+                    kv_block = kv_block + Int32(PREFILL_GRID_K)
+            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(w_empty_ptr + w_stage)
+            next_w_stage = w_stage + Int32(1)
+            if next_w_stage >= Int32(PREFILL_Q_STAGES):

+                ):
+                    kv_block = k_partition + Int32(k_group_offset)
+                    while kv_block < valid_k_blocks:
+                        pipeline_k.consumer_wait(k_cons_debug)
+                        with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                            cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(
+                                pipeline_k.sync_object_empty.get_barrier(
+                                    k_cons_debug.index
+                                )
+                            )
+                        k_cons_debug.advance()
+                        kv_block = kv_block + Int32(PREFILL_GRID_K)
+            work_idx = work_idx + cute.arch.grid_dim()[0]
+
+    if (warp_idx == Int32(PREFILL_MMA_WARP)) & cutlass.const_expr(
+        debug_mode == 0 or debug_mode == 4
+    ):
+        lane_idx = tidx % Int32(LANES_PER_WARP)
+        q_cons = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+            pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, PREFILL_Q_STAGES
+        )
+        k_cons = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+            pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, PREFILL_K_STAGES
+        )
+        tCrA0_all = tiled_mma.make_fragment_A(sK0)
+        tCrA1_all = tiled_mma.make_fragment_A(sK1)
+        tCrB0_all = tiled_mma.make_fragment_B(sQ0)
+        tCrB1_all = tiled_mma.make_fragment_B(sQ1)
+        # The UMMA producer owns one persistent three-slot TMEM ring.  The two
+        # math groups consume alternating slots (+2 modulo 3), so their state
+        # must survive persistent work-item boundaries.
+        score_stage = Int32(0)
+        score_phase = Int32(0)
+        work_done_phase = Int32(0)
+        work_idx = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+        while work_idx < total_work:
+            (
+                valid_work,
+                _,
+                _,
+                k_partition,
+                _,
+                _,
+                _,
+                _,
+                _,
+                valid_k_blocks,
+            ) = _prefill_persistent_work_info(
+                work_idx, mCuSeqlensQ, mCuSeqlensK, batch_size, block_q
+            )
+            if valid_work:
+                pipeline_q.consumer_wait(q_cons)
+                q_stage = q_cons.index
+                sQ0_stage = sQ0[None, None, None, q_stage]
+                sQ1_stage = sQ1[None, None, None, q_stage]
+                tCrB0_stage = tCrB0_all[None, None, None, q_stage]
+                tCrB1_stage = tCrB1_all[None, None, None, q_stage]
+                for k_group_offset in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+                    PREFILL_COMPILED_WORK_K_GROUP
+                ):
+                    kv_block = k_partition + Int32(k_group_offset)
+                    while kv_block < valid_k_blocks:
+                        pipeline_k.consumer_wait(k_cons)
+                        k_stage = k_cons.index
+                        sK0_stage = sK0[None, None, None, k_stage]
+                        sK1_stage = sK1[None, None, None, k_stage]
+                        for math_group in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+                            PREFILL_NUM_CONSUMER_GROUPS
+                        ):
+                            cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(
+                                s_empty_ptr + score_stage, score_phase
+                            )
+                            _tcgen05_after_thread_sync()
+                            tmem_offset = tmem_base.toint() + score_stage * Int32(
+                                PREFILL_BLOCK_QH
+                            )
+                            k0_group = sK0_stage
+                            k1_group = sK1_stage
+                            if math_group == 1:
+                                k0_group = cute.make_tensor(
+                                    sK0_stage.iterator + sK0_stage.stride[1],
+                                    sK0_stage.layout,
+                                )
+                                k1_group = cute.make_tensor(
+                                    sK1_stage.iterator + sK1_stage.stride[1],
+                                    sK1_stage.layout,
+                                )
+                            sm100_flash_utils.gemm_ptx_partial(
+                                tiled_mma.op,
+                                tmem_offset,
+                                tCrA0_all[None, None, None, k_stage],
+                                tCrB0_stage,
+                                k0_group,
+                                sQ0_stage,
+                                zero_init=True,
+                            )
+                            sm100_flash_utils.gemm_ptx_partial(
+                                tiled_mma.op,
+                                tmem_offset,
+                                tCrA1_all[None, None, None, k_stage],
+                                tCrB1_stage,
+                                k1_group,
+                                sQ1_stage,
+                                zero_init=False,
+                            )
+                            with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                                tcgen05.commit(s_full_ptr + score_stage)
+                            next_score_stage = score_stage + Int32(1)
+                            if next_score_stage >= Int32(PREFILL_S_STAGES):
+                                next_score_stage = Int32(0)
+                                score_phase = score_phase ^ Int32(1)
+                            score_stage = next_score_stage
+                        pipeline_k.consumer_release(k_cons)
+                        k_cons.advance()
+                        kv_block = kv_block + Int32(PREFILL_GRID_K)
+                pipeline_q.consumer_release(q_cons)
+                q_cons.advance()
+            if q_heads_per_kv == 2:
+                work_done_phase = _prefill_work_barrier(work_done_ptr, work_done_phase)
+            work_idx = work_idx + cute.arch.grid_dim()[0]
+
+    if (tidx < Int32(PREFILL_NUM_CONSUMER_THREADS)) & cutlass.const_expr(
+        debug_mode == 0 or debug_mode == 4
+    ):
+        _prefill_consumer_loop(
+            tmem_base,
+            sW,
+            mO,
+            mCuSeqlensQ,
+            mCuSeqlensK,
+            w_full_ptr,
+            w_empty_ptr,
+            s_full_ptr,
+            s_empty_ptr,
+            work_done_ptr,
+            total_work,
+            batch_size,
+            warp_idx // Int32(WARPS_PER_WARPGROUP),
+            q_heads_per_kv,
+            block_q,
+        )
+
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    if (warp_idx == Int32(PREFILL_MMA_WARP)) & cutlass.const_expr(
+        debug_mode != 3 and debug_mode != 5
+    ):
+        cute.arch.relinquish_tmem_alloc_permit()
+        cute.arch.dealloc_tmem(tmem_base, Int32(PREFILL_TMEM_COLUMNS))
+

+def _prefill_paged_logits_call_impl_v131(
+    mQ: cute.Tensor,
+    mKCache: cute.Tensor,
+    mBlockTable: cute.Tensor,
+    mW: cute.Tensor,
+    mO: cute.Tensor,
+    mCuSeqlensQ: cute.Tensor,
+    mCuSeqlensK: cute.Tensor,
+    stream,
+    seq_q: Int32,
+    seq_k: Int32,
+    block_table_cols: Int32,
+    batch_size: Int32,
+    num_pages: Int32,
+    summaries_per_page: Int32,
+    persistent_grid: Int32,
+    q_heads_per_kv: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block_q: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    mma_tiler_mnk = (PREFILL_BLOCK_KV, PREFILL_BLOCK_QH, PREFILL_K_SEGMENT)
+    tiled_mma = sm100_utils.make_trivial_tiled_mma(
+        Float8E4M3FN,
+        tcgen05.OperandMajorMode.K,
+        tcgen05.OperandMajorMode.K,
+        Float32,
+        tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE,

+    )
+    sQ_layout_fp8_0 = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_b(
+        tiled_mma, mma_tiler_mnk, Float8E4M3FN, PREFILL_Q_STAGES
+    )
+    sQ_layout_fp8_1 = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_b(
+        tiled_mma, mma_tiler_mnk, Float8E4M3FN, PREFILL_Q_STAGES
+    )
+    sK_layout_fp8_0 = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_a(
+        tiled_mma, mma_tiler_mnk, Float8E4M3FN, PREFILL_K_STAGES
+    )
+    sK_layout_fp8_1 = sm100_utils.make_smem_layout_a(
+        tiled_mma, mma_tiler_mnk, Float8E4M3FN, PREFILL_K_STAGES
+    )
+    q_segment_layout = cute.make_layout(
+        (mQ.shape[0], PREFILL_K_SEGMENT),
+        stride=(mQ.stride[0], mQ.stride[1]),
+    )
+    mQ_segment0 = cute.make_tensor(mQ.iterator, q_segment_layout)
+    mQ_segment1_ptr = cute.domain_offset((Int32(0), Int32(PREFILL_K_SEGMENT)), mQ)
+    mQ_segment1 = cute.make_tensor(mQ_segment1_ptr.iterator, q_segment_layout)
+    tma_atom_Q0, tma_tensor_Q0 = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_B(
+        cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+        mQ_segment0,
+        cute.select(sQ_layout_fp8_0, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+        mma_tiler_mnk,
+        tiled_mma,
+        1,
+    )
+    tma_atom_Q1, tma_tensor_Q1 = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_B(
+        cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+        mQ_segment1,
+        cute.select(sQ_layout_fp8_1, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+        mma_tiler_mnk,
+        tiled_mma,
+        1,
+    )
+    mKCache_pages = cute.make_tensor(
+        cute.recast_ptr(mKCache.iterator, dtype=Uint8),
+        cute.make_layout(
+            (
+                PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+                PREFILL_TMA_ROWS,
+                HEAD_DIM // PREFILL_K_SEGMENT,
+                PREFILL_COMPILED_TMA_PAIRS_PER_PAGE,
+                mKCache.shape[0],
+            ),
+            stride=(
+                1,
+                PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+                PREFILL_TMA_CHUNK_BYTES,
+                Int32(PREFILL_TMA_PAGE_STRIDE_BYTES),
+                summaries_per_page * Int32(HEAD_DIM),
+            ),
+        ),
+    )
+    k_page_layout = cute.make_layout(
+        (
+            PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+            PREFILL_TMA_ROWS,
+            PREFILL_COMPILED_TMA_PAIRS_PER_PAGE,
+            mKCache.shape[0],
+        ),
+        stride=(
+            1,
+            PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+            Int32(PREFILL_TMA_PAGE_STRIDE_BYTES),
+            summaries_per_page * Int32(HEAD_DIM),
+        ),
+    )
+    mKCache_pages0 = cute.make_tensor(mKCache_pages.iterator, k_page_layout)
+    mKCache_pages1_ptr = cute.domain_offset(
+        (Int32(0), Int32(0), Int32(1), Int32(0), Int32(0)), mKCache_pages
+    )
+    mKCache_pages1 = cute.make_tensor(mKCache_pages1_ptr.iterator, k_page_layout)
+    sK_page_layout = cute.make_layout(
+        (
+            PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+            PREFILL_TMA_ROWS,
+            PREFILL_COMPILED_TMA_PAIRS_PER_PAGE,
+        ),
+        stride=(1, PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES, PREFILL_TMA_CHUNK_BYTES),
+    )
+    tma_atom_K0, tma_tensor_K0 = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+        cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+        mKCache_pages0,
+        sK_page_layout,
+        (
+            PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+            PREFILL_TMA_ROWS,
+            PREFILL_COMPILED_TMA_PAIRS_PER_PAGE,
+        ),
+    )
+    tma_atom_K1, tma_tensor_K1 = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+        cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+        mKCache_pages1,
+        sK_page_layout,
+        (
+            PREFILL_GEN5_ATOM_BYTES,
+            PREFILL_TMA_ROWS,
+            PREFILL_COMPILED_TMA_PAIRS_PER_PAGE,
+        ),
+    )
+    sW_layout_single = cute.make_layout(
+        (block_q, q_heads_per_kv), stride=(q_heads_per_kv, 1)
+    )
+    sW_layout = cute.make_layout(
+        (block_q, q_heads_per_kv, PREFILL_Q_STAGES),
+        stride=(q_heads_per_kv, 1, PREFILL_BLOCK_QH),
+    )
+    tma_atom_W, tma_tensor_W = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(
+        cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(),
+        mW,
+        sW_layout_single,
+        (block_q, q_heads_per_kv),
+    )
+    _prefill_paged_logits_kernel(
+        tma_atom_Q0,
+        tma_tensor_Q0,
+        tma_atom_Q1,
+        tma_tensor_Q1,
+        tma_atom_K0,
+        tma_tensor_K0,
+        tma_atom_K1,
+        tma_tensor_K1,
+        tma_atom_W,
+        tma_tensor_W,
+        mQ,
+        mKCache,
+        mBlockTable,
+        tiled_mma,
+        sQ_layout_fp8_0,
+        sQ_layout_fp8_1,
+        sK_layout_fp8_0,
+        sK_layout_fp8_1,
+        sW_layout,
+        mW,
+        mO,
+        mCuSeqlensQ,
+        mCuSeqlensK,
+        seq_q,
+        seq_k,
+        block_table_cols,
+        batch_size,
+        num_pages,
+        summaries_per_page,
+    ).launch(
+        grid=(persistent_grid, 1, 1),
+        block=[PREFILL_NUM_THREADS, 1, 1],
+        stream=stream,
+    )

+    debug_mode: int,
+    work_k_group: int,
+    summaries_per_page: int,
+):
+    global PREFILL_COMPILED_Q_HEADS_PER_KV
+    global PREFILL_COMPILED_BLOCK_Q

+    global PREFILL_COMPILED_PAGES_PER_K_TILE

+    PREFILL_COMPILED_PAGES_PER_K_TILE = PREFILL_BLOCK_KV // summaries_per_page
+    PREFILL_COMPILED_PAGE_SEGMENT_BYTES = summaries_per_page * PREFILL_K_SEGMENT
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _call_v152(
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,
+        mKCache: cute.Tensor,

+        batch_size: Int32,
+        num_pages: Int32,
+        summaries_per_page: Int32,
+        persistent_grid: Int32,

+            mKCache,
+            mBlockTable,
+            mW,
+            mO,
+            mCuSeqlensQ,
+            mCuSeqlensK,
+            stream,
+            seq_q,
+            seq_k,
+            block_table_cols,
+            batch_size,
+            num_pages,
+            summaries_per_page,
+            persistent_grid,
+            q_heads_per_kv,
+            block_q,
+        )
+
+    return _call_v152

+def _validate_inputs(
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    summary: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor,
+    page_size: int,
+    q_runtime: torch.Tensor,
+    kernel_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
+    page_size = _prefill_validate_summaries_per_page(page_size)
+    q_heads_per_kv = int(index_q.shape[2])
+    block_q = _prefill_block_q_for_heads(q_heads_per_kv)
+    if tuple(index_q.shape[1:]) != (SUMMARY_KV_HEADS, q_heads_per_kv, HEAD_DIM):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"paged prefill logits index_q must be [Q,{SUMMARY_KV_HEADS},H,{HEAD_DIM}], got "
+            f"{tuple(index_q.shape)}"
+        )
+    query_rows = int(index_q.shape[0])
+    max_regions = int(out.shape[1])
+    if query_rows <= 0 or query_rows % block_q:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"paged prefill logits Q capacity must be a positive multiple of "
+            f"{block_q}, got {query_rows}"
+        )
+    if max_regions <= 0 or max_regions % PREFILL_SCORE_ROWS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"paged prefill logits region capacity must be a positive multiple of "
+            f"{PREFILL_SCORE_ROWS}, got {max_regions}"
+        )
+    if tuple(weights.shape) != (query_rows, SUMMARY_KV_HEADS, q_heads_per_kv):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"paged prefill logits weights must be [Q,{SUMMARY_KV_HEADS},H], got "
+            f"{tuple(weights.shape)}"
+        )
+    if summary.dim() != 4 or tuple(summary.shape[2:]) != (SUMMARY_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "paged prefill logits summary must be "
+            f"[pages,page_rows,{SUMMARY_KV_HEADS},{HEAD_DIM}] with page_rows in "
+            f"{PREFILL_SUPPORTED_SUMMARIES_PER_PAGE}, "
+            f"got {tuple(summary.shape)}"
+        )
+    if int(summary.shape[1]) != page_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "paged prefill logits page_size must match summary.shape[1], "
+            f"got page_size={page_size}, summary.shape[1]={int(summary.shape[1])}"
+        )
+    batch_size = int(block_table.shape[0]) if block_table.dim() == 2 else 0
+    if (
+        block_table.dtype != torch.int32
+        or block_table.dim() != 2
+        or batch_size <= 0
+        or not block_table.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(

+# Step5 SM100 union prefill
+
+Private dependencies from StepFun commit b3055a1c0e5a17da35bbf36d8f60651e073706c3. Original source hashes and local modifications are recorded in MANIFEST.json. Copyright and license headers are retained.
+
+This fork does not import or replace the public SGLang FA4 implementation. Package initializers are inert. FakeTensor descriptors are constructed locally without monkeypatching CUTLASS or modifying installed files. Compilation uses SGLang's cache owner with recursive source fingerprinting.
+
+The candidate consumes compact Q/O rows. Query group count comes from union metadata, not ceil(T/qgroup). Private load and output hooks apply the group's compact-row offset. WorkQGlobal is the native per-query position vector; WorkQLocal/WorkQLen are compact start/end rows. The schedule computes union-relative causal limits, and retains the tail-load validity mask.
+
+The public entry is step5_sparse_prefill. Backend-owned typed schedule buffers are allocated before decoder layers. Enabled by default on compute capability 10.x; disable it with SPARSE_PREFILL_SM100 in step5/options.py. No padded Q/O buffers or adapter packing kernels are used. Native SWA remains unchanged.

+@dsl_user_op
+def ld_acquire(lock_ptr: cute.Pointer, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> cutlass.Int32:
+    lock_ptr_i64 = lock_ptr.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value()
+    state = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        [lock_ptr_i64],
+        "ld.global.acquire.gpu.b32 $0, [$1];",
+        "=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+    return cutlass.Int32(state)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def red_relaxed(
+    lock_ptr: cute.Pointer, val: cutlass.Constexpr[Int32], *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> None:
+    lock_ptr_i64 = lock_ptr.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value()
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [lock_ptr_i64, Int32(val).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "red.relaxed.gpu.global.add.s32 [$0], $1;",
+        "l,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def red_release(

+) -> None:
+    lock_ptr_i64 = lock_ptr.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value()
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [lock_ptr_i64, Int32(val).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],

+    old = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        [lock_ptr_i64, Int32(val).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "atom.global.add.s32 $0, [$1], $2;",
+        "=r,l,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+    return cutlass.Int32(old)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def atom_cas_i32(
+    lock_ptr: cute.Pointer, compare: Int32, val: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> cutlass.Int32:
+    lock_ptr_i64 = lock_ptr.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value()
+    old = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        [
+            lock_ptr_i64,
+            Int32(compare).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            Int32(val).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        ],
+        "atom.global.cas.b32 $0, [$1], $2, $3;",
+        "=r,l,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+    return cutlass.Int32(old)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def globaltimer_u64(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> cutlass.Int64:
+    val = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i64(),
+        [],
+        "mov.u64 $0, %globaltimer;",

+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,

+    return cutlass.Int64(val)

+def _shape_with_dynamic_dims(
+    shape,
+    dynamic_shape_dim: int | None,
+    dynamic_shape_dims: tuple[int, ...] | None,
+    divisibility: int,
+):
+    modes = (
+        tuple(int(v) for v in dynamic_shape_dims)
+        if dynamic_shape_dims is not None
+        else (() if dynamic_shape_dim is None else (int(dynamic_shape_dim),))
+    )
+    if not modes:
+        return tuple(int(v) for v in shape)
+    return tuple(

+def make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+    tensor: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    alignment: int,
+    dtype=None,
+    dynamic_layout_dim: int | None = None,
+    dynamic_shape_dim: int | None = None,
+    dynamic_shape_dims: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
+    dynamic_stride_dims: tuple[int, ...] = (),
+    divisibility: int = 1,
+) -> cute.Tensor:
+    if dynamic_shape_dim is not None and dynamic_shape_dims is not None:
+        raise ValueError("pass dynamic_shape_dim or dynamic_shape_dims, not both")
+    shape_modes = (
+        tuple(int(v) for v in dynamic_shape_dims)
+        if dynamic_shape_dims is not None
+        else (() if dynamic_shape_dim is None else (int(dynamic_shape_dim),))
+    )
+    stride = [
+        cute.sym_int(divisibility=divisibility) if idx in dynamic_stride_dims else int(v)
+        for idx, v in enumerate(tensor.stride())
+    ]
+    # Equivalent to the fork's descriptor shim, without mutating CUTLASS classes.
+    if dynamic_layout_dim is not None and tensor.stride()[dynamic_layout_dim] != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Dynamic layout leading dimension must have stride 1")
+    order = tensor.dim_order()
+    from cutlass.cute.typing import SymInt
+    for mode in shape_modes:
+        for dim in order[:order.index(mode)]:
+            if not isinstance(stride[dim], SymInt):
+                stride[dim] = cute.sym_int(divisibility=divisibility)
+    return cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(
+        _cutlass_dtype_from_torch_with_metadata(tensor.dtype) if dtype is None else dtype,
+        _shape_with_dynamic_dims(tensor.shape, dynamic_shape_dim, dynamic_shape_dims, divisibility),

+@dsl_user_op
+def elem_pointer_i64_offset(
+    x: cute.Tensor, coord: cute.Coord, *, loc=None, ip=None  # noqa: ARG001
+) -> cute.Pointer:
+    flat_coord_i64 = tuple(cutlass.Int64(c) for c in cute.flatten(coord))
+    flat_stride = cute.flatten_to_tuple(x.stride)
+    if len(flat_coord_i64) != len(flat_stride):
+        raise ValueError("Coordinate and stride must have the same length")
+    offset = sum(c * s for c, s in zip(flat_coord_i64, flat_stride, strict=True))
+    byte_offset = offset * x.element_type.width // 8
+    return cute.make_ptr(
+        x.element_type,

+@cute.jit
+def shuffle_sync(
+    value: cute.Numeric,
+    offset: cute.typing.Int,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE,
+) -> cute.Numeric:
+    if const_expr(value.width % 32 != 0):
+        raise ValueError("value type must be a multiple of 32 bits")
+    mask = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE - width
+    clamp = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE - 1
+    mask_and_clamp = mask << 8 | clamp
+    val = cute.make_fragment(1, type(value))
+    val[0] = value
+    val_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(val, cutlass.Int32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(val_i32)):
+        val_i32[i] = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val_i32[i], offset, mask_and_clamp=mask_and_clamp)
+    return val[0]

+    res.store(x)

+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4, cute.size(x.shape), 4):
+        local_max[0] = fmax_f32(local_max[0], res[i + 0])
+        local_max[1] = fmax_f32(local_max[1], res[i + 1])
+        local_max[2] = fmax_f32(local_max[2], res[i + 2])

+    local_max[0] = fmax_f32(local_max[0], local_max[1])
+    local_max[2] = fmax_f32(local_max[2], local_max[3])

+"""Small FP helper intrinsics used by the sparse GQA kernels.
+
+These helpers keep the sparse GQA package self-contained while preserving the
+PTX-level behavior expected by the kernels.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from cutlass import Float32, Uint32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def fmax_f32(a: Float32, b: Float32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    return Float32(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [Float32(a).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Float32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            "max.f32 $0, $1, $2;",
+            "=f,f,f",
+            has_side_effects=False,
+            is_align_stack=False,
+            asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def cvt_f32_to_e4m3(a: Float32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    return Uint32(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            T.i32(),
+            [Float32(a).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            """
+            {
+                .reg .b16 fp8_pair;
+                .reg .f32 zero;
+                mov.f32 zero, 0f00000000;
+                cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 fp8_pair, zero, $1;
+                cvt.u32.u16 $0, fp8_pair;
+            }
+            """,
+            "=r,f",
+            has_side_effects=False,
+            is_align_stack=False,
+            asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["cvt_f32_to_e4m3", "fmax_f32"]

+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.cute.sm100_union.flash_attn import copy_utils, utils as flash_utils

+SUPPORTED_Q_HEADS = (8, 16)
+DEFAULT_Q_HEADS = 16
+HEAD_DIM = 192
+REGION_TOKENS = 8
+PAGE_TOKENS = 16
+M_BLOCK = 128
+N_BLOCK = 128
+REGIONS_PER_BLOCK = N_BLOCK // REGION_TOKENS
+MASK_WORD_BITS = 32
+COPY_ELEMS = 8

+SCHEDULE_THREADS = 512

+
+def _debug_validate_schedule(
+    union_counts: torch.Tensor,
+    union_phys_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    workspace: "Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace",
+    *,
+    physical_region_count: int,
+) -> None:
+    if os.getenv("OPTIMUS_SM100_PREFILL_DEBUG_VALIDATE") != "1":
+        return
+    width = int(union_phys_indices.shape[1])
+    columns = torch.arange(width, device=union_counts.device)[None, :]
+    active = columns < union_counts[:, None]
+    invalid_count = ((union_counts < 0) | (union_counts > width)).sum()
+    invalid_phys = (
+        active
+        & (
+            (union_phys_indices < 0)
+            | (union_phys_indices >= int(physical_region_count))
+        )
+    ).sum()
+    block_counts = workspace.block_counts
+    invalid_blocks = (
+        (block_counts < 0) | (block_counts > int(workspace.max_blocks))
+    ).sum()
+    block_columns = torch.arange(
+        int(workspace.max_blocks), device=block_counts.device
+    )[None, :]
+    active_blocks = block_columns < block_counts[:, None]
+    invalid_indices = (
+        active_blocks
+        & (
+            (workspace.block_indices[:, : workspace.max_blocks] < 0)
+            | (
+                workspace.block_indices[:, : workspace.max_blocks]
+                >= int(workspace.max_blocks)
+            )
+        )
+    ).sum()
+    failures = {
+        "counts": int(invalid_count.item()),
+        "phys": int(invalid_phys.item()),
+        "blocks": int(invalid_blocks.item()),
+        "indices": int(invalid_indices.item()),
+    }
+    if any(failures.values()):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "SM100 union-exact prefill schedule validation failed: "
+            f"{failures}, groups={union_counts.numel()}, width={width}, "
+            f"physical_region_count={physical_region_count}"
+        )
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace:
+    block_counts: torch.Tensor
+    block_indices: torch.Tensor
+    full_block_counts: torch.Tensor
+    exact_region_words: torch.Tensor
+    causal_token_limits: torch.Tensor
+    max_union_windows: int
+    q_heads: int
+
+    @property
+    def group_capacity(self) -> int:
+        return int(self.block_counts.numel())
+
+    @property
+    def max_blocks(self) -> int:
+        return (int(self.max_union_windows) + REGIONS_PER_BLOCK - 1) // REGIONS_PER_BLOCK
+
+    @property
+    def q_group(self) -> int:
+        return M_BLOCK // int(self.q_heads)
+
+
+def make_sm100_union_exact_prefill_workspace(
+    *,
+    group_capacity: int,
+    max_union_windows: int,
+    device: torch.device | str,
+    q_heads: int = DEFAULT_Q_HEADS,
+) -> Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace:
+    groups = int(group_capacity)
+    windows = int(max_union_windows)
+    heads = int(q_heads)
+    if groups <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"group_capacity must be positive, got {groups}")
+    if windows <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"max_union_windows must be positive, got {windows}")
+    if heads not in SUPPORTED_Q_HEADS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"SM100 union-exact prefill supports q_heads in {SUPPORTED_Q_HEADS}, "
+            f"got {heads}"
+        )
+    q_group = M_BLOCK // heads
+    max_blocks = (windows + REGIONS_PER_BLOCK - 1) // REGIONS_PER_BLOCK
+    return Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace(
+        block_counts=torch.empty((groups,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        # The final column carries the exact region count for the gather producer.
+        # Generic SM100 block-sparse consumers only visit the first max_blocks columns.
+        block_indices=torch.arange(
+            max_blocks + 2, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        ).expand(groups, -1).clone(),
+        # Keep all four BlockSparseTensors fields materialized. CuTeDSL drops
+        # intermediate None values while rebuilding the aggregate ABI.
+        full_block_counts=torch.zeros((groups,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        exact_region_words=torch.empty(
+            (groups, max_blocks, q_group),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=device,
+        ),
+        causal_token_limits=torch.empty(
+            (groups, q_group), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        ),
+        max_union_windows=windows,
+        q_heads=heads,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_schedule_kernel(max_blocks: int, q_group: int):
+    @cute.kernel
+    def _schedule_kernel(
+        mUnionCounts: cute.Tensor,
+        mUnionPhys: cute.Tensor,
+        mUnionLogical: cute.Tensor,
+        mExactMaskBits: cute.Tensor,
+        mCausalLimits: cute.Tensor,
+        mWorkQGlobal: cute.Tensor,
+        mWorkQLocal: cute.Tensor,
+        mWorkQLen: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockCounts: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockIndices: cute.Tensor,
+        mExactRegionWords: cute.Tensor,
+        mCausalTokenLimits: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        group, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+        count = mUnionCounts[group]
+        if tid == 0:
+            mBlockCounts[group] = (
+                count + Int32(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK - 1)
+            ) // Int32(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK)
+            mBlockIndices[group, Int32(max_blocks)] = count
+            valid_rows = mWorkQLen[group] - mWorkQLocal[group]
+            valid_rows = cutlass.select_(valid_rows < Int32(q_group), valid_rows, Int32(q_group))
+            last_position = Int32(-1)
+            if valid_rows > Int32(0):
+                last_position = mWorkQGlobal[mWorkQLocal[group]] + valid_rows - Int32(1)
+            last_window = cutlass.select_(count > Int32(0), count - Int32(1), Int32(0))
+            last_logical = mUnionLogical[group, last_window]
+            token_limit = count * Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+            if (count > Int32(0)) & (last_logical == last_position // Int32(REGION_TOKENS)):
+                token_limit = (count - Int32(1)) * Int32(REGION_TOKENS) + last_position % Int32(REGION_TOKENS) + Int32(1)
+            mBlockIndices[group, Int32(max_blocks + 1)] = cutlass.select_(valid_rows > Int32(0), token_limit, Int32(0))
+        mask_word_count = int(max_blocks) * q_group
+        for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(
+            (mask_word_count + SCHEDULE_THREADS - 1) // SCHEDULE_THREADS
+        ):
+            flat_idx = tid + Int32(chunk * SCHEDULE_THREADS)
+            if flat_idx < Int32(mask_word_count):
+                block_idx = flat_idx // Int32(q_group)
+                q_slot = flat_idx % Int32(q_group)
+                q_valid = mWorkQLocal[group] + q_slot < mWorkQLen[group]
+                word = Uint32(0)
+                for region_in_block in cutlass.range_constexpr(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK):
+                    window = block_idx * Int32(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK) + Int32(region_in_block)
+                    window_valid = window < count
+                    safe_window = cutlass.select_(window_valid, window, Int32(0))
+                    exact_bits = mExactMaskBits[group, safe_window]
+                    selected = (exact_bits & (Int32(1) << q_slot)) != Int32(0)
+                    # The compact union contract guarantees valid logical and
+                    # physical indices in [0, count). Re-reading both arrays for
+                    # every q-slot would duplicate that validation eight times.
+                    region_valid = q_valid & window_valid & selected
+                    word = word | cutlass.select_(
+                        region_valid,
+                        Uint32(1) << Uint32(region_in_block),
+                        Uint32(0),
+                    )
+                mExactRegionWords[group, block_idx, q_slot] = Int32(word)
+
+        if tid < Int32(q_group):
+            q_slot = tid
+            q_global = Int32(-1)
+            if mWorkQLocal[group] + q_slot < mWorkQLen[group]:
+                q_global = mWorkQGlobal[mWorkQLocal[group] + q_slot]
+            q_valid = mWorkQLocal[group] + q_slot < mWorkQLen[group]
+            lo, hi = Int32(0), count
+            while lo < hi:
+                mid = (lo + hi) // Int32(2)
+                if mUnionLogical[group, mid] <= q_global // Int32(REGION_TOKENS):
+                    lo = mid + Int32(1)
+                else:
+                    hi = mid
+            limit = lo * Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+            last_window = limit // Int32(REGION_TOKENS) - Int32(1)
+            has_last = limit >= Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+            safe_last = cutlass.select_(has_last, last_window, Int32(0))
+            current_region_in_union = (
+                has_last
+                & (mUnionLogical[group, safe_last] == q_global // Int32(REGION_TOKENS))
+            )
+            exact_limit = cutlass.select_(
+                current_region_in_union,
+                limit - Int32(REGION_TOKENS) + q_global % Int32(REGION_TOKENS) + Int32(1),
+                limit,
+            )
+            mCausalTokenLimits[group, q_slot] = cutlass.select_(
+                q_valid, exact_limit, Int32(0)
+            )
+
+    return _schedule_kernel
+
+
+def _make_schedule_launch(max_blocks: int, q_group: int):
+    kernel = _make_schedule_kernel(max_blocks, q_group)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _launch(
+        mUnionCounts: cute.Tensor,
+        mUnionPhys: cute.Tensor,
+        mUnionLogical: cute.Tensor,
+        mExactMaskBits: cute.Tensor,

+        mBlockIndices: cute.Tensor,

+            block=[SCHEDULE_THREADS, 1, 1],

+
+    return _launch
+

+@cached_compile_function

+    metadata = torch.empty(
+        (1, int(max_union_windows)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    block_counts = torch.empty((1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    block_indices = torch.empty(
+        (1, max_blocks + 2), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    exact_region_words = torch.empty(
+        (1, max_blocks, int(q_group)),
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    causal_token_limits = torch.empty(
+        (1, int(q_group)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )

+    return cute.compile(
+        _make_schedule_launch(max_blocks, int(q_group)),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            counts, alignment=4, dynamic_shape_dim=0
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            metadata,
+            alignment=4,
+            dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+            dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            metadata,
+            alignment=4,
+            dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+            dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            metadata,
+            alignment=4,
+            dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+            dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            causal_token_limits,
+            alignment=4,
+            dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+            dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            counts, alignment=4, dynamic_shape_dim=0
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            counts, alignment=4, dynamic_shape_dim=0
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            counts, alignment=4, dynamic_shape_dim=0
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            block_counts, alignment=4, dynamic_shape_dim=0
+        ),
+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(
+            block_indices,
+            alignment=4,
+            dynamic_shape_dim=0,
+            dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),

+        sparse_utils.make_fake_tensor_like_with_dynamic_dim(

+
+
+def schedule_sm100_union_exact_prefill(
+    union_counts: torch.Tensor,
+    union_phys_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    union_logical_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    exact_mask_bits: torch.Tensor,
+    causal_limits: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_global: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_local: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_len: torch.Tensor,
+    workspace: Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace,
+) -> None:
+    if union_counts.dtype != torch.int32 or union_counts.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("union_counts must be a 1D int32 tensor")
+    if not union_counts.is_cuda or not union_counts.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("union_counts must be contiguous CUDA storage")
+    if union_counts.device != workspace.block_counts.device:
+        raise ValueError("union_counts and workspace must be on the same device")
+    if int(union_counts.numel()) != workspace.group_capacity:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SM100 union-exact workspace capacity must equal the runtime metadata "
+            f"capacity, got {workspace.group_capacity} and {int(union_counts.numel())}"
+        )
+    compiled = _get_compiled_schedule(
+        int(workspace.max_union_windows),
+        int(workspace.q_group),
+        sparse_utils.device_cache_key(union_counts.device),
+    )
+    compiled(
+        union_counts,
+        union_phys_indices,
+        union_logical_indices,
+        exact_mask_bits,
+        causal_limits,
+        work_q_global,
+        work_q_local,
+        work_q_len,
+        workspace.block_counts,
+        workspace.block_indices,
+        workspace.exact_region_words,
+        workspace.causal_token_limits,
+    )
+
+
+class _UnionExactAttentionMask(AttentionMask):
+    @cute.jit
+    def apply_mask_sm100(
+        self,
+        acc_S: cute.Tensor,
+        m_block: Int32,
+        n_block: Int32,
+        thr_mma: cute.TiledMma,
+        thr_tmem_load: cute.TiledCopy,
+        mask_seqlen: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+        mask_causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+        mask_local: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+        mask_mod: cutlass.Constexpr[Optional[Callable]] = None,
+        batch_idx: Int32 = None,
+        head_idx: Int32 = None,
+        aux_tensors: Optional[list] = None,
+        fastdiv_mods=(None, None),
+    ) -> None:
+        del mask_seqlen, mask_causal, mask_local, mask_mod, batch_idx, head_idx, fastdiv_mods
+        cS = cute.make_identity_tensor((self.tile_m, self.tile_n))
+        tScS = thr_mma.partition_C(cS)
+        tScS_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_D(tScS)
+        ncol = const_expr(cute.size(tScS_t2r.shape))
+        assert ncol == N_BLOCK
+        global_row = tScS_t2r[0][0] + m_block * Int32(self.tile_m)
+        mask_row = global_row // Int32(self.qhead_per_kvhead_packgqa)
+        q_group = self.tile_m // self.qhead_per_kvhead_packgqa
+        group = mask_row // Int32(q_group)
+        q_slot = mask_row % Int32(q_group)
+        mExactRegionWords = aux_tensors[7]
+        mCausalTokenLimits = aux_tensors[8]
+        region_word = Uint32(mExactRegionWords[group, n_block, q_slot])
+        for region in cutlass.range_constexpr(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK):
+            keep = cutlass.Boolean(region_word & (Uint32(1) << Uint32(region)))
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(REGION_TOKENS):
+                score_idx = region * REGION_TOKENS + token
+                acc_S[score_idx] = acc_S[score_idx] if keep else -Float32.inf
+        causal_limit = mCausalTokenLimits[group, q_slot] - n_block * Int32(N_BLOCK)
+        if causal_limit < Int32(N_BLOCK):
+            mask_r2p(acc_S, causal_limit, arch=100, rank1=True)
+
+
+class _UnionExactFlashAttentionForwardSm100(FlashAttentionForwardSm100):
+    """SM100 FMHA pipeline with sparse union-region gather in the load role."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, dtype, max_union_windows: int, q_heads: int) -> None:
+        self.input_dtype = dtype
+        self.max_union_windows = int(max_union_windows)
+        self.q_heads = int(q_heads)
+        self.q_group = M_BLOCK // self.q_heads
+        super().__init__(
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            HEAD_DIM,
+            qhead_per_kvhead=self.q_heads,
+            pack_gqa=True,
+            m_block_size=M_BLOCK,
+            n_block_size=N_BLOCK,
+            is_persistent=True,
+            has_aux_tensors=True,
+            paged_kv_non_tma=True,
+            force_non_tma_o=True,
+            attention_mask_cls=_UnionExactAttentionMask,
+        )
+        self.prefetch_attention_mask = True
+        self.num_regs_softmax = 256
+        self.num_regs_other = 64
+        if self.q_stage != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError("SM100 union-exact prefill requires one Q stage")
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def prefetch_attention_mask_sm100(
+        self,
+        m_block: Int32,
+        n_block: Int32,
+        thr_mma_qk,
+        thr_tmem_load,
+        aux_tensors: list,
+    ) -> tuple[Uint32, Int32]:
+        cS = cute.make_identity_tensor((M_BLOCK, N_BLOCK))
+        tScS = thr_mma_qk.partition_C(cS)
+        tScS_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_D(tScS)
+        global_row = tScS_t2r[0][0] + m_block * Int32(M_BLOCK)
+        mask_row = global_row // Int32(self.q_heads)
+        group = mask_row // Int32(self.q_group)
+        q_slot = mask_row % Int32(self.q_group)
+        region_word = Uint32(aux_tensors[7][group, n_block, q_slot])
+        causal_limit = aux_tensors[8][group, q_slot] - n_block * Int32(N_BLOCK)
+        return region_word, causal_limit
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def apply_prefetched_attention_mask_sm100(
+        self,
+        acc_S: cute.Tensor,
+        prefetched_mask,
+    ) -> None:
+        region_word, causal_limit = prefetched_mask
+        for region in cutlass.range_constexpr(REGIONS_PER_BLOCK):
+            keep = cutlass.Boolean(region_word & (Uint32(1) << Uint32(region)))
+            for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(REGION_TOKENS):
+                score_idx = region * REGION_TOKENS + token
+                acc_S[score_idx] = acc_S[score_idx] if keep else -Float32.inf
+        if causal_limit < Int32(N_BLOCK):
+            mask_r2p(acc_S, causal_limit, arch=100, rank1=True)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def output_row_offset(self, m_block: Int32, aux_tensors: list) -> Int32:
+        return aux_tensors[5][m_block] - m_block * Int32(self.q_group)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def output_seqlen_q(
+        self,
+        seqlen_q: Int32,
+        m_block: Int32,
+        aux_tensors: list,
+    ) -> Int32:
+        return m_block * Int32(self.q_group) + aux_tensors[6][m_block] - aux_tensors[5][m_block]
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _load_union_kv(
+        self,
+        sK: cute.Tensor,
+        sV: cute.Tensor,
+        mX: cute.Tensor,
+        source_physical_token: Int32,
+        source_valid_i32: Int32,
+        producer_state: pipeline.PipelineState,
+        mbar_full_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        mbar_empty_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        K_or_V: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ) -> None:
+        stage, phase = producer_state.index, producer_state.phase
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(mbar_empty_ptr + stage, phase)
+        num_threads = len(self.load_warp_ids) * cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % num_threads
+        atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            cpasync.CopyG2SOp(cache_mode=cpasync.LoadCacheMode.GLOBAL),
+            self.input_dtype,
+            num_bits_per_copy=COPY_ELEMS * self.input_dtype.width,
+        )
+        threads_per_row = GATHER_THREADS_PER_ROW
+        tiled_copy = cute.make_tiled_copy_tv(
+            atom,
+            cute.make_ordered_layout(
+                (num_threads // threads_per_row, threads_per_row), order=(1, 0)
+            ),
+            cute.make_layout((1, COPY_ELEMS)),
+        )
+        thr_copy = tiled_copy.get_slice(tidx)
+        sX = sK if const_expr(K_or_V == "K") else sV
+        sX_cur = sX[None, None, None, stage]
+        sX_flat = cute.make_tensor(
+            sX_cur.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (sX_cur.shape[0][0], (sX_cur.shape[0][1], sX_cur.shape[2])),
+                stride=(
+                    sX_cur.stride[0][0],
+                    (sX_cur.stride[0][1], sX_cur.stride[2]),
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+        if const_expr(K_or_V == "V"):
+            sX_flat = cute.make_tensor(
+                sX_flat.iterator, cute.select(sX_flat.layout, mode=[1, 0])
+            )
+        cX = cute.make_identity_tensor((N_BLOCK, HEAD_DIM))
+        tXsX = thr_copy.partition_D(sX_flat)
+        tXcX = thr_copy.partition_S(cX)
+
+        for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tXsX, mode=[1])):
+            source_lane = m % threads_per_row
+            source_token = flash_utils.shuffle_sync(
+                source_physical_token, source_lane, width=threads_per_row
+            )
+            valid_i32 = flash_utils.shuffle_sync(
+                source_valid_i32, source_lane, width=threads_per_row
+            )
+            src_ptr_i64 = (
+                elem_pointer(mX, (source_token, 0, 0, 0)).toint()
+                if const_expr(K_or_V == "K")
+                else elem_pointer(mX, (0, source_token, 0, 0)).toint()
+            )
+            src_ptr = cute.make_ptr(
+                self.input_dtype,
+                src_ptr_i64,
+                cute.AddressSpace.gmem,
+                assumed_align=REQUIRED_POINTER_ALIGN,
+            )
+            src_row = cute.make_tensor(src_ptr, cute.make_layout((HEAD_DIM,)))
+            src_vectors = cute.tiled_divide(src_row, (COPY_ELEMS,))
+            pred = cute.make_fragment_like(tXsX[(0, None), m, 0], cute.Boolean)
+            pred.fill(valid_i32 != Int32(0))
+            for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tXsX, mode=[2])):
+                vector_idx = tXcX[0, 0, k][1] // COPY_ELEMS
+                src = src_vectors[None, vector_idx]
+                dst = tXsX[None, m, k]
+                src = cute.make_tensor(src.iterator, dst.layout)
+                cute.copy(tiled_copy, src, dst, pred=pred)
+        cute.arch.cp_async_commit_group()
+        cute.arch.cp_async_mbarrier_arrive_noinc(mbar_full_ptr + stage)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def load(
+        self,
+        thr_mma_qk,
+        thr_mma_pv,
+        mQ,
+        mK,
+        mV,
+        mO,
+        mReductionQueue,
+        mFusedTimeline,
+        sQ,
+        sK,
+        sV,
+        mPageTable,
+        tma_atom_Q,
+        tma_atom_K,
+        tma_atom_V,
+        pipeline_kv,
+        sPageRing,
+        mbar_ptr,
+        block_info,
+        num_splits,
+        mNumSplitsActual,
+        SeqlenInfoCls: Callable,
+        TileSchedulerCls: Callable,
+        blocksparse_tensors: BlockSparseTensors,
+        aux_tensors: list,
+    ) -> None:
+        del (
+            thr_mma_pv,
+            mO,
+            mReductionQueue,
+            mFusedTimeline,
+            mPageTable,
+            tma_atom_K,
+            tma_atom_V,
+            sPageRing,
+            block_info,
+            num_splits,
+            mNumSplitsActual,
+        )
+        num_load_threads = len(self.load_warp_ids) * cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % Int32(num_load_threads)
+        q_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+        kv_producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(
+            pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.kv_stage
+        )
+        tile_scheduler = TileSchedulerCls()
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        mBlockCounts, mBlockIndices, _, mUnionPhys4d = blocksparse_tensors
+
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, _ = work_tile.tile_idx
+            seqlen = SeqlenInfoCls(batch_idx)
+            mQ_cur = seqlen.offset_batch_Q(mQ, batch_idx, dim=3)[
+                None, None, head_idx
+            ]
+            mQ_cur = cute.domain_offset(
+                ((0, self.output_row_offset(m_block, aux_tensors)), 0), mQ_cur
+            )
+            gQ = cute.local_tile(
+                mQ_cur, cute.select(self.mma_tiler_qk, mode=[0, 2]), (None, 0)
+            )
+            tSgQ = thr_mma_qk.partition_A(gQ)
+            load_Q_fn, _, _ = copy_utils.tma_get_copy_fn(
+                tma_atom_Q, 0, cute.make_layout(1), tSgQ, sQ
+            )
+            block_count = mBlockCounts[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+            if block_count > Int32(0):
+                if tidx < Int32(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE):
+                    self.load_Q(
+                        load_Q_fn,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_q_full_offset,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_q_empty_offset,
+                        block=m_block,
+                        stage=0,
+                        phase=q_producer_phase,
+                    )
+                union_count = mBlockIndices[
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    Int32(cute.size(mBlockIndices.shape[3]) - 2),
+                ]
+                union_token_limit = mBlockIndices[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, Int32(cute.size(mBlockIndices.shape[3]) - 1)]
+                source_row = (
+                    (tidx % Int32(GATHER_THREADS_PER_ROW))
+                    * Int32(num_load_threads // GATHER_THREADS_PER_ROW)
+                    + tidx // Int32(GATHER_THREADS_PER_ROW)
+                )
+                for offset in cutlass.range(block_count, unroll=1):
+                    sparse_block = mBlockIndices[
+                        batch_idx,
+                        head_idx,
+                        m_block,
+                        block_count - Int32(1) - offset,
+                    ]
+                    source_union_token = sparse_block * Int32(N_BLOCK) + source_row
+                    source_window = source_union_token // Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+                    source_token_in_region = source_union_token % Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+                    source_window_valid = source_window < union_count
+                    safe_source_window = cutlass.select_(
+                        source_window_valid, source_window, Int32(0)
+                    )
+                    source_physical_region = mUnionPhys4d[
+                        batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, safe_source_window
+                    ]
+                    source_valid = source_window_valid & (source_union_token < union_token_limit) & (
+                        source_physical_region >= Int32(0)
+                    )
+                    safe_source_region = cutlass.select_(
+                        source_valid, source_physical_region, Int32(0)
+                    )
+                    source_physical_token = (
+                        safe_source_region * Int32(REGION_TOKENS)
+                        + source_token_in_region
+                    )
+                    source_valid_i32 = Int32(
+                        cutlass.select_(source_valid, Int32(1), Int32(0))
+                    )
+                    self._load_union_kv(
+                        sK,
+                        sV,
+                        mK,
+                        source_physical_token,
+                        source_valid_i32,
+                        kv_producer_state,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_kv_full_offset,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_kv_empty_offset,
+                        "K",
+                    )
+                    kv_producer_state.advance()
+                    self._load_union_kv(
+                        sK,
+                        sV,
+                        mV,
+                        source_physical_token,
+                        source_valid_i32,
+                        kv_producer_state,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_kv_full_offset,
+                        mbar_ptr + self.mbar_load_kv_empty_offset,
+                        "V",
+                    )
+                    kv_producer_state.advance()
+                q_producer_phase ^= Int32(1)
+
+            tile_scheduler.prefetch_next_work()
+            tile_scheduler.advance_to_next_work()
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.get_current_work()
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _get_union_exact_op(dtype, max_union_windows: int, q_heads: int):

+@cached_compile_function

+    q = torch.empty(
+        (1, q_group, int(q_heads), HEAD_DIM), dtype=torch_dtype, device=device
+    )
+    k = torch.empty((1, PAGE_TOKENS, 1, HEAD_DIM), dtype=torch_dtype, device=device)
+    v = torch.empty_like(k)
+    out = torch.empty_like(q)
+    lse = (
+        torch.empty((q_group, int(q_heads)), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        .transpose(0, 1)
+        .unsqueeze(0)

+    )
+    union_phys = torch.empty(
+        (1, int(max_union_windows)), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    union_logical = torch.empty_like(union_phys)
+    exact_mask = torch.empty_like(union_phys)
+    union_counts = torch.empty((1,), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    work_q_global = torch.empty_like(union_counts)
+    work_q_local = torch.empty_like(union_counts)

+    )

+    fq = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        q, dynamic_shape_dims=(1,), dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1, 2)
+    )
+    fk = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        k, dynamic_shape_dims=(1,), dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1, 2)
+    )
+    fv = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        v, dynamic_shape_dims=(1,), dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1, 2)
+    )
+    fout = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        out, dynamic_shape_dims=(1,), dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1, 2)

+    f_union_phys = _make_dynamic_fake(

+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        alignment=4,
+    )
+    f_union_logical = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        union_logical,
+        dynamic_shape_dims=(0,),
+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),

+    f_exact_mask = _make_dynamic_fake(

+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),

+    f_union_counts = _make_dynamic_fake(

+    )
+    f_work_q_global = _make_dynamic_fake(

+    f_work_q_local = _make_dynamic_fake(

+    )
+    f_work_q_len = _make_dynamic_fake(

+    )
+    f_block_counts = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        block_counts,
+        dynamic_shape_dims=(2,),
+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1),
+        alignment=4,
+    )
+    f_block_indices = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        block_indices,
+        dynamic_shape_dims=(2,),
+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0, 1, 2),
+        alignment=4,

+        alignment=4,

+    f_exact_region_words = _make_dynamic_fake(
+        exact_region_words,
+        dynamic_shape_dims=(0,),
+        dynamic_stride_dims=(0,),
+        alignment=4,
+    )
+    f_causal_token_limits = _make_dynamic_fake(

+        alignment=4,

+    f_union_phys4d = _make_dynamic_fake(

+def _validate_tensor(
+    tensor: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    name: str,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ndim: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> None:
+    if tensor.dtype != dtype or tensor.ndim != ndim:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} must be rank-{ndim} {dtype}, got shape={tuple(tensor.shape)} "
+            f"dtype={tensor.dtype}"
+        )
+    if tensor.device != device or not tensor.is_cuda or not tensor.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous CUDA storage on {device}")

+def _token_wise_flash_attn_prefill_union_sm100_gqa_impl(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    v_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    union_counts: torch.Tensor,
+    union_phys_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    union_logical_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    exact_mask_bits: torch.Tensor,
+    causal_limits: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_global: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_local: torch.Tensor,
+    work_q_len: torch.Tensor,
+    workspace: Sm100UnionExactPrefillWorkspace,
+    out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    lse: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+    schedule_workspace: bool,
+) -> torch.Tensor:

+def normalize_group_quant_scale_format(
+    scale_format: Optional[str],

+    if scale_format is None:

+    normalized = str(scale_format).lower()
+    aliases = {
+        "float": SCALE_FORMAT_FLOAT32,
+        "fp32": SCALE_FORMAT_FLOAT32,
+        "float32": SCALE_FORMAT_FLOAT32,
+        "packed_ue8m0": SCALE_FORMAT_PACKED_UE8M0,
+        "ue8m0_packed": SCALE_FORMAT_PACKED_UE8M0,
+        "sm100_1d1d": SCALE_FORMAT_SM100_1D1D,
+        "mn_major_tma_packed_ue8m0": SCALE_FORMAT_SM100_1D1D,
+    }
+    try:
+        return aliases[normalized]
+    except KeyError as err:
+        supported = ", ".join(sorted(set(aliases.values())))
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scale_format={scale_format!r}; expected one of {supported}.") from err

+def group_quant_scale_format_code(scale_format: str) -> int:

+    if scale_format == SCALE_FORMAT_PACKED_UE8M0:

+    if scale_format == SCALE_FORMAT_SM100_1D1D:

+def make_group_quant_packed_ue8m0_scale_tensor(
+    rows: int,

+    device: torch.device,

+        storage = torch.empty((rows, padded_groups), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)

+        return storage.view(torch.int32), storage, 1

+    if scale_format == SCALE_FORMAT_SM100_1D1D:

+def warp_reduce(
+    val: cute.TensorSSA | cute.Numeric,
+    op: Callable,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE,
+) -> cute.TensorSSA | cute.Numeric:
+    if cutlass.const_expr(isinstance(val, cute.TensorSSA)):
+        res = cute.make_fragment(val.shape, val.dtype)
+        res.store(val)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(val.shape)):
+            res[i] = warp_reduce(res[i], op, width)
+        return res.load()
+    else:
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(int(math.log2(width))):
+            val = op(val, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(val, offset=1 << i))
+    return val

+@cute.jit
+def shuffle_sync(
+    value: cute.Numeric,
+    offset: cute.typing.Int,
+    width: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE,
+) -> cute.Numeric:
+    assert value.width % 32 == 0, "value type must be a multiple of 32 bits"
+    mask = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE - width
+    clamp = cute.arch.WARP_SIZE - 1
+    mask_and_clamp = mask << 8 | clamp
+    val = cute.make_fragment(1, type(value))
+    val[0] = value
+    val_i32 = cute.recast_tensor(val, cutlass.Int32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(val_i32)):
+        val_i32[i] = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(val_i32[i], offset, mask_and_clamp=mask_and_clamp)

+    warps_per_row = cute.size(reduction_buffer.shape[1])

+def pack_fp32x8_to_fp8x8(
+    lane_vals: cute.Tensor,
+    inv_scale: Float32,
+    fp8_min: Float32,
+    fp8_max: Float32,
+) -> Int64:
+    # Note(wangbojun/codex): Keep the repeated 8-lane FP8 pack path in one
+    # place without hiding the surrounding load/scale flow that still differs
+    # across kernels.
+    packed_pairs = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Int16)
+    for pair in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        idx0 = pair * 2
+        idx1 = idx0 + 1
+        val0 = Float32(lane_vals[idx0]) * inv_scale
+        val0 = cute.arch.fmax(-fp8_max, -val0)
+        val0 = -val0
+        val0 = cute.arch.fmax(fp8_min, val0)
+        val1 = Float32(lane_vals[idx1]) * inv_scale
+        val1 = cute.arch.fmax(-fp8_max, -val1)
+        val1 = -val1
+        val1 = cute.arch.fmax(fp8_min, val1)
+        packed_pairs[pair] = cvt_fp32x2_to_e4m3x2(val1, val0)
+    return pack_int16x4_to_int64(
+        packed_pairs[0],
+        packed_pairs[1],
+        packed_pairs[2],
+        packed_pairs[3],
+    )

+# Layout contract shared with the 128-wide group-quant kernels: one quant group
+# is covered by a half warp (16 lanes x 8 values), element index within the
+# group is `lane_in_half * 8 + elem` (bit0-2 in-register, bit3-6 across lanes).
+_FWHT_VALS_PER_THREAD = 8
+_FWHT_HALF_WARP = 16
+_FWHT_MAX_LOG2_GROUP_SIZE = 7  # group <= 128 stays inside one half warp
+_FWHT_HALF_WARP_MASK_AND_CLAMP = ((cute.arch.WARP_SIZE - _FWHT_HALF_WARP) << 8) | (
+    _FWHT_HALF_WARP - 1
+)
+
+_FWHT_FRAGMENT_CACHE: dict = {}
+
+
+def make_fwht_halfwarp_fragment(log2_group_size: int) -> Callable:
+    """Build an in-place unnormalized FWHT over an 8-value fp32 fragment.
+
+    Butterfly network for a Hadamard group of size 2**log2_group_size laid out
+    as `idx = lane_in_half * 8 + elem`: the first min(3, k) stages are
+    in-register add/sub pairs, the remaining k-3 stages exchange values with
+    `lane ^ (1 << j)` via shuffle_sync_bfly. The caller must fold the g**-0.5
+    normalization into its own scale computation. The high-side sign flip is
+    done by XOR-ing the fp32 sign bit so every lane executes the same
+    instruction stream (no divergence around the shuffles).
+    """
+    assert 1 <= log2_group_size <= _FWHT_MAX_LOG2_GROUP_SIZE, (
+        f"log2_group_size={log2_group_size} outside supported range "
+        f"[1, {_FWHT_MAX_LOG2_GROUP_SIZE}] (hadamard group must fit a half warp)."
+    )
+    cached = _FWHT_FRAGMENT_CACHE.get(log2_group_size)
+    if cached is not None:
+        return cached
+
+    num_inreg_stages = min(3, log2_group_size)
+    num_xlane_stages = max(0, log2_group_size - 3)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _fwht_halfwarp_fragment(lane_vals: cute.Tensor, lane_in_half: Int32) -> None:
+        for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_inreg_stages):
+            stride = 1 << stage
+            for elem in cutlass.range_constexpr(_FWHT_VALS_PER_THREAD):
+                if (elem & stride) == 0:
+                    low = Float32(lane_vals[elem])
+                    high = Float32(lane_vals[elem + stride])
+                    lane_vals[elem] = low + high
+                    lane_vals[elem + stride] = low - high
+
+        if num_xlane_stages > 0:
+            mask_and_clamp = Int32(_FWHT_HALF_WARP_MASK_AND_CLAMP)
+            full_mask = Int32(-1)
+            for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_xlane_stages):
+                offset = 1 << stage
+                # +0.0 on the low side, -0.0 on the high side: XOR-ing this
+                # into the fp32 bits maps val -> +/-val without a branch.
+                lane_bit = (Uint32(lane_in_half) >> Uint32(stage)) & Uint32(1)
+                sign_mask = lane_bit << Uint32(31)
+                for elem in cutlass.range_constexpr(_FWHT_VALS_PER_THREAD):
+                    val = Float32(lane_vals[elem])
+                    other = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(
+                        val,
+                        offset=Int32(offset),
+                        mask=full_mask,
+                        mask_and_clamp=mask_and_clamp,
+                    )
+                    flipped = bitcast_u32_to_f32(bitcast_f32_to_u32(val) ^ sign_mask)
+                    lane_vals[elem] = flipped + other
+
+    _FWHT_FRAGMENT_CACHE[log2_group_size] = _fwht_halfwarp_fragment
+    return _fwht_halfwarp_fragment
+
