+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Step5 region-score entry; all state and output storage belong to callers."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+
+
+def can_use_step5_scoring_cute(device: torch.device) -> bool:
+    return (
+        # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_SCORING_CUTE; prune dead paths.
+        step5_options.SCORING_CUTE
+        and device.type == "cuda"
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0] == 10
+    )
+
+
+def _check(value, *, shape, dtype, device, name):
+    if (
+        value.layout != torch.strided
+        or tuple(value.shape) != shape
+        or value.dtype != dtype
+        or value.device != device
+        or not value.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Step5 scoring {name} requires contiguous {shape}/{dtype} on {device}"
+        )
+
+
+def _assert_group32_ownership(row_to_req: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    groups = row_to_req.view(-1, 32)
+    owner = groups[:, :1]
+    all_padding = (groups == 0).all(dim=1)
+    owned_or_padding = ((groups == owner) | (groups == 0)).all(dim=1)
+    torch._assert_async(
+        (all_padding | ((owner[:, 0] > 0) & owned_or_padding)).all(),
+        "Step5 group-32 rows must share one request slot or be padding",
+    )
+
+
+def step5_paged_scores(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    compressed_index_keys: torch.Tensor,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    row_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    clear_future: bool = True,
+    group_rows: int = 1,
+    workspace=None,
+    weight_scale: float | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Score completed historical regions for flattened ragged query rows.
+
+    Q is BF16 or prequantized unscaled E4M3. FP32 weights are already scaled by the
+    index head count (``weight_scale=1``). BF16 weights are the unscaled GEMM
+    output and default to ``weight_scale=0.5`` (exact: ``4**-0.5``). An explicit
+    scale overrides the dtype default. CompressedIndexKeys is
+    the existing SW128 byte backing.
+    Request slot zero is padding. Valid slots/positions and compressed_index_keys
+    publication are the backend's responsibility. Each valid req_to_token entry
+    at logical offset 8*r must be an aligned physical start of a complete region.
+    Native 64-token pages retain their contiguous logical offsets. Groups of
+    4 or 32 rows share one request owner, with optional padding rows.
+    Output width must cover all positions//8, including Graph replay inputs.
+    With ``clear_future=True``, invalid/future output columns are always -inf.
+    The SM10x live-length selector may set it false because it never reads those
+    columns. Inputs are immutable; output must not share storage with them.
+    Warm up before Graph capture.
+    """
+    if q.device.type != "cuda" or torch.version.hip is not None:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring requires NVIDIA CUDA")
+    if type(clear_future) is not bool:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring clear_future must be a bool")
+    if q.ndim != 3 or q.shape[1] not in (2, 4) or q.shape[2] != 256:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring Q requires [tokens, 2 or 4, 256]")
+    tokens, heads, _ = q.shape
+    if group_rows not in (1, 4, 32) or (group_rows > 1 and tokens % group_rows):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring group_rows must be 1, 4, or 32 and divide rows")
+    if q.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring Q must be BF16 or E4M3")
+    _check(q, shape=tuple(q.shape), dtype=q.dtype, device=q.device, name="q")
+    if weights.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 scoring weights must be BF16 or FP32")
+    explicit_weight_scale = weight_scale is not None
+    if weight_scale is None:
+        weight_scale = 0.5 if weights.dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 1.0
+    _check(
+        weights,
+        shape=(tokens, heads),
+        dtype=weights.dtype,
+        device=q.device,
+        name="weights",
+    )
+    if (
+        compressed_index_keys.ndim != 4
+        or compressed_index_keys.shape[1:] != (8, 1, 256)
+        or compressed_index_keys.shape[0] < 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 compressed_index_keys requires SW128 [pages, 8, 1, 256]"
+        )
+    _check(
+        compressed_index_keys,
+        shape=tuple(compressed_index_keys.shape),
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=q.device,
+        name="compressed_index_keys",
+    )
+    if req_to_token.ndim != 2 or req_to_token.shape[0] < 1:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 request map requires [request slots, token capacity]")
+    for name, value, shape in (
+        ("req_to_token", req_to_token, tuple(req_to_token.shape)),
+        ("row_to_req", row_to_req, (tokens,)),
+        ("positions", positions, (tokens,)),
+    ):
+        if value.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+            raise ValueError(f"Step5 scoring {name} must be int32 or int64")
+        _check(value, shape=shape, dtype=value.dtype, device=q.device, name=name)
+    if group_rows == 32:
+        _assert_group32_ownership(row_to_req)
+    if (
+        out.ndim != 2
+        or not 1 <= out.shape[1] < 2**31
+        or out.shape[1] > (req_to_token.shape[1] // 8 + 255) // 256 * 256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 score width must fit native request capacity and int32 indexing"
+        )
+    _check(
+        out,
+        shape=(tokens, out.shape[1]),
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=q.device,
+        name="out",
+    )
+    if out.numel():
+        a, b = out.data_ptr(), out.data_ptr() + out.numel() * out.element_size()
+        for value in (
+            q,
+            weights,
+            compressed_index_keys,
+            req_to_token,
+            row_to_req,
+            positions,
+        ):
+            lo = value.data_ptr()
+            if max(a, lo) < min(b, lo + value.numel() * value.element_size()):
+                raise ValueError("Step5 scoring output must not alias inputs")
+    if tokens:
+        if can_use_step5_scoring_cute(q.device):
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring_cute import launch
+
+            launch(
+                q,
+                weights,
+                compressed_index_keys,
+                req_to_token,
+                row_to_req,
+                positions,
+                out,
+                clear_future=clear_future,
+                group_rows=group_rows,
+                weight_scale=weight_scale,
+                workspace=workspace,
+            )
+            return out
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring_triton import launch
+
+        if explicit_weight_scale:
+            weights = weights.float() * weight_scale
+            weight_scale = 1.0
+        launch(
+            q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+            weights,
+            compressed_index_keys,
+            req_to_token,
+            row_to_req,
+            positions,
+            out,
+            clear_future=clear_future,
+            group_rows=group_rows,
+            weight_scale=weight_scale,
+        )
+    return out

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Step5ScoringWorkspace:
+    request_indices: torch.Tensor
+    table_indices: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    row_starts: torch.Tensor
+    row_ends: torch.Tensor
+    request_limits: torch.Tensor
+    valid_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    q_runtime: torch.Tensor
+    kernel_weights: torch.Tensor
+    rows_per_group: int
+
+
+def allocate_scoring_workspace(rows, regions, group_rows, device):
+    group = 1 if group_rows == 1 else 4
+    groups = triton.cdiv(rows, group)
+    packed_rows = groups * 4
+    empty = lambda *shape, dtype=torch.int32: torch.empty(
+        shape, dtype=dtype, device=device
+    )
+    return Step5ScoringWorkspace(
+        request_indices=empty(packed_rows),
+        table_indices=empty(packed_rows),
+        block_table=empty(groups, triton.cdiv(regions, 8)),
+        row_starts=torch.zeros(packed_rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        row_ends=empty(packed_rows),
+        request_limits=empty(2),
+        valid_tokens=empty(1),
+        q_runtime=empty(groups * 16, 256, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        kernel_weights=empty(groups, 32, 4, dtype=torch.float32),
+        rows_per_group=group,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _prepare_scoring(
+    Q,
+    W,
+    Requests,
+    Positions,
+    PackedQ,
+    PackedW,
+    RowReq,
+    RowTable,
+    RowEnds,
+    RequestLimits,
+    ValidTokens,
+    Out,
+    Mapping,
+    Table,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    COLS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    CLEAR_FUTURE: tl.constexpr,
+    REDUCE_ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    PACK_QW: tl.constexpr = True,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    groups = tl.cdiv(ROWS, GROUP)
+    if pid < groups * 4:
+        group = pid // 4
+        slot = pid % 4
+        row = group * GROUP + slot
+        valid_row = (slot < GROUP) & (row < ROWS)
+        request = tl.load(Requests + row, valid_row, other=0)
+        position = tl.load(Positions + row, valid_row, other=0)
+        valid = valid_row & (request > 0)
+        regions = tl.maximum(position // 8, 0)
+        if not CLEAR_FUTURE:
+            regions = tl.where(regions > 512, regions, 0)
+        if PACK_QW:
+            h = tl.arange(0, 4)
+            d = tl.arange(0, 256)
+            q = tl.load(
+                Q + (row * HEADS + h[:, None]) * 256 + d[None, :],
+                valid & (h[:, None] < HEADS),
+                other=0,
+            )
+            if Q.dtype.element_ty != tl.uint8:
+                q = q.to(tl.float8e4nv).to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True)
+            w = tl.load(W + row * HEADS + h, valid & (h < HEADS), other=0)
+            packed_h = group * 16 + (h // 2) * 8 + slot * 2 + h % 2
+            tl.store(PackedQ + packed_h[:, None] * 256 + d[None, :], q)
+            tl.store(
+                PackedW + group * 128 + slot * 4 + h, w.to(tl.float32) * WEIGHT_SCALE
+            )
+        slots = tl.arange(0, 4)
+        owners = tl.load(
+            Requests + group * GROUP + slots,
+            (slots < GROUP) & (group * GROUP + slots < ROWS),
+            other=0,
+        )
+        tl.store(RowReq + pid, group)
+        owner = tl.max(owners, 0)
+        owner_positions = tl.load(
+            Positions + group * GROUP + slots,
+            (slots < GROUP) & (group * GROUP + slots < ROWS),
+            other=0,
+        )
+        live_pages = tl.cdiv(
+            tl.max(tl.where(owners > 0, tl.maximum(owner_positions // 8, 0), 0), 0), 8
+        )
+        for page_start in range(slot * 256, live_pages, 1024):
+            col = page_start + tl.arange(0, 256)
+            physical = tl.load(
+                Mapping + owner.to(tl.int64) * MAP_STRIDE + col * 64,
+                (owner > 0) & (col < live_pages) & (col < COLS),
+                other=0,
+            )
+            tl.store(
+                Table + group * COLS + col,
+                physical // 64,
+                (col < COLS) & (col < live_pages),
+            )
+        tl.store(RowTable + pid, group)
+        tl.store(RowEnds + pid, tl.where(valid, regions, 0))
+        if pid == 0:
+            tl.store(RequestLimits, groups)
+            all_rows = tl.arange(0, REDUCE_ROWS)
+            all_requests = tl.load(Requests + all_rows, all_rows < ROWS, other=0)
+            all_positions = tl.load(Positions + all_rows, all_rows < ROWS, other=0)
+            live = tl.max(
+                tl.where(all_requests > 0, tl.maximum(all_positions // 8, 0), 0), 0
+            )
+            if not CLEAR_FUTURE:
+                live = tl.where(live > 512, live, 0)
+            tl.store(RequestLimits + 1, live)
+            tl.store(ValidTokens, groups * 4)
+    elif CLEAR_FUTURE:
+        index = (pid - groups * 4) * 1024 + tl.arange(0, 1024)
+        fill_row = index // WIDTH
+        fill_col = index % WIDTH
+        fill_req = tl.load(Requests + fill_row, fill_row < ROWS, other=0)
+        fill_pos = tl.load(Positions + fill_row, fill_row < ROWS, other=0)
+        tl.store(
+            Out + index,
+            -float("inf"),
+            (fill_row < ROWS) & ((fill_req <= 0) | (fill_col >= fill_pos // 8)),
+        )
+
+
+def prepare_scoring(
+    workspace,
+    mapping,
+    requests,
+    positions,
+    *,
+    q=None,
+    weights=None,
+    out=None,
+    weight_scale=1.0,
+    clear_future=False,
+):
+    """Prepare scoring inputs, or only metadata when Q/W come from fused norm.
+
+    Without q, the packing branch is compiled out. Call once from the forward's
+    metadata build so CUDA Graph replay refreshes metadata shared across layers.
+    """
+    w = workspace
+    rows = requests.numel()
+    group = w.rows_per_group
+    groups = triton.cdiv(rows, group)
+    width = out.shape[1] if out is not None else 0
+    heads = q.shape[1] if q is not None else 0
+    if q is not None and q.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        q = q.view(torch.uint8)
+    fill_blocks = triton.cdiv(rows * width, 1024) if clear_future else 0
+    _prepare_scoring[(groups * 4 + fill_blocks,)](
+        q,
+        weights,
+        requests,
+        positions,
+        w.q_runtime.view(torch.uint8),
+        w.kernel_weights,
+        w.request_indices,
+        w.table_indices,
+        w.row_ends,
+        w.request_limits,
+        w.valid_tokens,
+        out,
+        mapping,
+        w.block_table,
+        mapping.shape[1],
+        w.block_table.shape[1],
+        rows,
+        width,
+        heads,
+        group,
+        weight_scale,
+        clear_future,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(rows),
+        PACK_QW=q is not None,
+    )
+
+
+def launch(
+    q,
+    weights,
+    keys,
+    mapping,
+    requests,
+    positions,
+    out,
+    *,
+    clear_future,
+    group_rows,
+    weight_scale,
+    workspace=None,
+):
+    rows = q.shape[0]
+    if workspace is None:
+        workspace = allocate_scoring_workspace(rows, out.shape[1], group_rows, q.device)
+    prepare_scoring(
+        workspace,
+        mapping,
+        requests,
+        positions,
+        q=q,
+        weights=weights,
+        out=out,
+        weight_scale=weight_scale,
+        clear_future=clear_future,
+    )
+    launch_prepared_scoring(keys, out, workspace, rows)
+
+
+def launch_prepared_scoring(keys, out, workspace, rows):
+    """Score using Q/W and metadata already written into the workspace."""
+    from .cute.scoring_sm100 import launch_paged_scoring
+
+    w = workspace
+    groups = triton.cdiv(rows, w.rows_per_group)
+    launch_paged_scoring(
+        keys,
+        w.block_table,
+        w.request_indices[: groups * 4],
+        w.table_indices[: groups * 4],
+        w.row_starts[: groups * 4],
+        w.row_ends[: groups * 4],
+        w.q_runtime[: groups * 16],
+        w.kernel_weights[:groups],
+        out,
+        w.request_limits,
+        w.valid_tokens,
+        w.rows_per_group,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+
+STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS = 64
+STEP5_REGION_TOKENS = 8
+STEP5_PREFILL_SCORING_HEADS = 4
+STEP5_PREFILL_SCORING_BLOCK_Q = 32
+
+
+def can_use_step5_scoring_prefill(device: torch.device, heads: int) -> bool:
+    return (
+        # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_SCORING_PREFILL_SM100; prune dead paths.
+        step5_options.SCORING_PREFILL_SM100
+        and heads == STEP5_PREFILL_SCORING_HEADS
+        and device.type == "cuda"
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0] == 10
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Step5PrefillScoringTile:
+    rows: int
+    rows_padded: int
+    cu_seqlens_q: torch.Tensor
+    cu_seqlens_k: torch.Tensor
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Step5PrefillScoringPlan:
+    heads: int
+    tiles: list
+    q: torch.Tensor
+    weights: torch.Tensor
+    q_runtime: torch.Tensor
+    kernel_weights: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def build_step5_prefill_scoring_plan(
+    *,
+    tiles,
+    prefixes,
+    lengths,
+    request_slots,
+    req_to_token,
+    capacity,
+    heads,
+    device,
+):
+    align = STEP5_PREFILL_SCORING_BLOCK_Q
+    starts = [0]
+    for n in lengths:
+        starts.append(starts[-1] + n)
+    specs = []
+    for tile_start, tile_end in tiles:
+        cu_q, cu_k, slots, pages = [0], [0], [], []
+        for i, (prefix, length) in enumerate(zip(prefixes, lengths)):
+            lo = max(tile_start, starts[i])
+            hi = min(tile_end, starts[i] + length)
+            if lo >= hi:
+                continue
+            regions = (
+                prefix + hi - starts[i] + STEP5_REGION_TOKENS - 1
+            ) // STEP5_REGION_TOKENS
+            cu_q.append(cu_q[-1] + hi - lo)
+            cu_k.append(cu_k[-1] + regions)
+            slots.append(i)
+            pages.append(
+                (regions * STEP5_REGION_TOKENS + STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS - 1)
+                // STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS
+            )
+        specs.append((cu_q, cu_k, slots, pages) if slots else None)
+    flat = [v for spec in specs if spec is not None for part in spec[:3] for v in part]
+    staged = (
+        torch.tensor(flat, dtype=torch.int32, pin_memory=True).to(
+            device, non_blocking=True
+        )
+        if flat
+        else None
+    )
+    plans = []
+    offset = 0
+    for spec in specs:
+        if spec is None:
+            plans.append(None)
+            continue
+        cu_q, cu_k, slots, pages = spec
+        cu_q_t = staged[offset : offset + len(cu_q)]
+        offset += len(cu_q)
+        cu_k_t = staged[offset : offset + len(cu_k)]
+        offset += len(cu_k)
+        slot_idx = staged[offset : offset + len(slots)]
+        offset += len(slots)
+        slot = request_slots[slot_idx.long()].long()
+        cols = max(pages) * STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS
+        table = (
+            req_to_token[slot][:, 0:cols:STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS] // STEP5_KV_PAGE_TOKENS
+        ).to(torch.int32)
+        rows = cu_q[-1]
+        plans.append(
+            Step5PrefillScoringTile(
+                rows=rows,
+                rows_padded=(rows + align - 1) // align * align,
+                cu_seqlens_q=cu_q_t,
+                cu_seqlens_k=cu_k_t,
+                block_table=table.contiguous(),
+            )
+        )
+    cap = (capacity + align - 1) // align * align
+    return Step5PrefillScoringPlan(
+        heads=heads,
+        tiles=plans,
+        q=torch.empty((cap, 1, heads, 256), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device),
+        weights=torch.empty((cap, 1, heads), dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+        q_runtime=torch.empty(
+            (cap * heads, 256), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device
+        ),
+        kernel_weights=torch.empty((cap, heads), dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+    )
+
+
+def step5_prefill_scores(
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    compressed_index_keys: torch.Tensor,
+    tile,
+    plan: Step5PrefillScoringPlan,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: float | None,
+) -> None:
+    if tile is None:
+        return
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.cute.scoring_prefill_sm100 import (
+        launch_prefill_paged_scoring,
+    )
+
+    heads = plan.heads
+    rows, padded = tile.rows, tile.rows_padded
+    if weight_scale is None and index_weights.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+        weight_scale = 0.5
+    q = plan.q[:padded]
+    w = plan.weights[:padded]
+    q[:rows].copy_(index_q[:rows].view(rows, 1, heads, index_q.shape[-1]))
+    w[:rows].copy_(index_weights[:rows].view(rows, 1, heads))
+    if weight_scale is not None:
+        w[:rows].mul_(weight_scale)
+    launch_prefill_paged_scoring(
+        q,
+        w,
+        compressed_index_keys,
+        tile.block_table,
+        tile.cu_seqlens_q,
+        tile.cu_seqlens_k,
+        int(compressed_index_keys.shape[1]),
+        q_runtime=plan.q_runtime[: padded * heads],
+        kernel_weights=plan.kernel_weights[:padded],
+        out=out[:padded],
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Paged Step5 scoring over existing SW128 E4M3 compressed_index_keys."""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=("REGIONS",),
+    do_not_specialize_on_alignment=("REGIONS",),
+)
+def _score_regions(
+    Q,
+    W,
+    CompressedIndexKeys,
+    ReqToToken,
+    RowToReq,
+    Positions,
+    Out,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    REGIONS,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+    GRID_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    CLEAR_FUTURE: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    first_tile = tl.program_id(1)
+    head = tl.arange(0, 16)
+    channel = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    request = tl.load(RowToReq + row).to(tl.int64)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + row)
+    query = tl.load(
+        Q + (row * HEADS + head[:, None]) * 256 + channel[None, :],
+        (request > 0) & (head[:, None] < HEADS),
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    weights = (
+        tl.load(W + row * HEADS + head, (request > 0) & (head < HEADS), other=0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        )
+        * WEIGHT_SCALE
+    )
+    # A 1M graph capture has 4096 capacity tiles while a 60K request has about
+    # 235 live tiles. The SM10x selector consumes positions directly, so its
+    # path can stop at live history. The portable FlashInfer fallback still
+    # overwrites future tiles to make a full-width top-k replay safe.
+    last_tile = tl.cdiv(REGIONS, BLOCK_R)
+    if not CLEAR_FUTURE:
+        live_regions = tl.maximum(position // 8, 0)
+        last_tile = tl.minimum(tl.cdiv(live_regions, BLOCK_R), last_tile)
+        # Selecting every historical region does not consume region_scores.
+        last_tile = tl.where(live_regions <= 512, 0, last_tile)
+        last_tile = tl.where(request > 0, last_tile, 0)
+    for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile, GRID_TILES):
+        regions = tile * BLOCK_R + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+        if (request > 0) & (tile * BLOCK_R < position // 8):
+            valid = regions < position // 8
+            token = tl.load(
+                ReqToToken + request * MAP_STRIDE + regions * 8,
+                valid,
+                other=0,
+            ).to(tl.int64)
+            page, slot = token // 64, token % 64 // 8
+            # Each page contains two 128-byte channel atoms, each with eight
+            # swizzled region rows. XOR uses the physical row, never logical ID.
+            offset = (
+                page[None, :] * 2048
+                + (channel[:, None] // 128) * 1024
+                + slot[None, :] * 128
+                + (((channel[:, None] % 128) // 16) ^ slot[None, :]) * 16
+                + channel[:, None] % 16
+            )
+            packed = tl.load(CompressedIndexKeys + offset, valid[None, :], other=0)
+            keys = packed.to(tl.float8e4nv, bitcast=True).to(tl.bfloat16)
+            products = tl.dot(query, keys)
+            score = tl.sum(tl.maximum(products, 0.0) * weights[:, None], axis=0)
+            score = tl.where(valid, score, -float("inf"))
+        else:
+            score = tl.full((BLOCK_R,), -float("inf"), tl.float32)
+        tl.store(Out + row * REGIONS + regions, score, regions < REGIONS)
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=("ROWS", "REGIONS"),
+    do_not_specialize_on_alignment=("ROWS", "REGIONS"),
+)
+def _score_four_rows_per_request(
+    Q,
+    W,
+    CompressedIndexKeys,
+    ReqToToken,
+    RowToReq,
+    Positions,
+    Out,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    REGIONS,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+    GRID_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Fill four MTP verifier rows with one fully occupied 16x256 dot."""
+    group = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    first_tile = tl.program_id(1)
+    group_rows = group * 4 + tl.arange(0, 4)
+    matrix_row = tl.arange(0, 16)
+    query_row = group * 4 + matrix_row // 4
+    head = matrix_row % 4
+    channel = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    row_valid = group_rows < ROWS
+    request = tl.load(RowToReq + group_rows, row_valid, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + group_rows, row_valid, other=0)
+    # Verify metadata guarantees four consecutive rows for one request. Padding
+    # groups carry request slot zero in all four rows.
+    base_request = tl.load(RowToReq + group * 4).to(tl.int64)
+    query = tl.load(
+        Q + (query_row[:, None] * HEADS + head[:, None]) * 256 + channel[None, :],
+        (query_row[:, None] < ROWS) & (head[:, None] < HEADS) & (base_request > 0),
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    weights = (
+        tl.load(
+            W + group_rows[:, None] * HEADS + tl.arange(0, 4)[None, :],
+            row_valid[:, None]
+            & (tl.arange(0, 4)[None, :] < HEADS)
+            & (request[:, None] > 0),
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        * WEIGHT_SCALE
+    )
+    live = tl.where(row_valid & (request > 0), tl.maximum(position // 8, 0), 0)
+    max_live = tl.max(live, axis=0)
+    last_tile = tl.minimum(tl.cdiv(max_live, BLOCK_R), tl.cdiv(REGIONS, BLOCK_R))
+    last_tile = tl.where(max_live <= 512, 0, last_tile)
+    for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile, GRID_TILES):
+        regions = tile * BLOCK_R + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+        valid = regions < max_live
+        token = tl.load(
+            ReqToToken + base_request * MAP_STRIDE + regions * 8,
+            valid & (base_request > 0),
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        page, slot = token // 64, token % 64 // 8
+        offset = (
+            page[None, :] * 2048
+            + (channel[:, None] // 128) * 1024
+            + slot[None, :] * 128
+            + (((channel[:, None] % 128) // 16) ^ slot[None, :]) * 16
+            + channel[:, None] % 16
+        )
+        packed = tl.load(CompressedIndexKeys + offset, valid[None, :], other=0)
+        keys = packed.to(tl.float8e4nv, bitcast=True).to(tl.bfloat16)
+        products = tl.dot(query, keys)
+        weighted = tl.maximum(products, 0.0) * tl.reshape(weights, (16, 1))
+        region_scores = tl.sum(tl.reshape(weighted, (4, 4, BLOCK_R)), axis=1)
+        output_valid = row_valid[:, None] & (regions[None, :] < live[:, None])
+        tl.store(
+            Out + group_rows[:, None] * REGIONS + regions[None, :],
+            region_scores,
+            output_valid,
+        )
+
+
+@triton.jit(
+    do_not_specialize=("ROWS", "REGIONS"),
+    do_not_specialize_on_alignment=("ROWS", "REGIONS"),
+)
+def _score_thirty_two_rows_per_request(
+    Q,
+    W,
+    CompressedIndexKeys,
+    ReqToToken,
+    RowToReq,
+    Positions,
+    Out,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    REGIONS,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+    GRID_TILES: tl.constexpr,
+    WEIGHT_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    group = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    first_tile = tl.program_id(1)
+    group_base = group * 32
+    channel = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    matrix_row = tl.arange(0, 32)
+    head = matrix_row % 4
+    row_in_subgroup = tl.arange(0, 8)
+    for subgroup in tl.static_range(0, 4):
+        rows = group_base + subgroup * 8 + row_in_subgroup
+        row_valid = rows < ROWS
+        request = tl.load(RowToReq + rows, row_valid, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+        position = tl.load(Positions + rows, row_valid, other=0)
+        base_request = tl.load(RowToReq + group_base).to(tl.int64)
+        query_row = group_base + subgroup * 8 + matrix_row // 4
+        query = tl.load(
+            Q + (query_row[:, None] * HEADS + head[:, None]) * 256 + channel[None, :],
+            (query_row[:, None] < ROWS) & (head[:, None] < HEADS) & (base_request > 0),
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.bfloat16)
+        weights = (
+            tl.load(
+                W + rows[:, None] * HEADS + tl.arange(0, 4)[None, :],
+                row_valid[:, None]
+                & (tl.arange(0, 4)[None, :] < HEADS)
+                & (request[:, None] > 0),
+                other=0.0,
+            ).to(tl.float32)
+            * WEIGHT_SCALE
+        )
+        live = tl.where(row_valid & (request > 0), tl.maximum(position // 8, 0), 0)
+        max_live = tl.max(live, axis=0)
+        last_tile = tl.minimum(tl.cdiv(max_live, BLOCK_R), tl.cdiv(REGIONS, BLOCK_R))
+        last_tile = tl.where(max_live <= 512, 0, last_tile)
+        for tile in range(first_tile, last_tile, GRID_TILES):
+            regions = tile * BLOCK_R + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+            valid = regions < max_live
+            token = tl.load(
+                ReqToToken + base_request * MAP_STRIDE + regions * 8,
+                valid & (base_request > 0),
+                other=0,
+            ).to(tl.int64)
+            page, slot = token // 64, token % 64 // 8
+            offset = (
+                page[None, :] * 2048
+                + (channel[:, None] // 128) * 1024
+                + slot[None, :] * 128
+                + (((channel[:, None] % 128) // 16) ^ slot[None, :]) * 16
+                + channel[:, None] % 16
+            )
+            packed = tl.load(CompressedIndexKeys + offset, valid[None, :], other=0)
+            keys = packed.to(tl.float8e4nv, bitcast=True).to(tl.bfloat16)
+            products = tl.dot(query, keys)
+            weighted = tl.maximum(products, 0.0) * tl.reshape(weights, (32, 1))
+            # Preserve group1's 16-lane reduction; compact reduction changes rounding.
+            heads = tl.permute(tl.reshape(weighted, (8, 4, BLOCK_R)), 0, 2, 1)
+            padded = tl.join(heads, tl.zeros_like(heads))
+            padded = tl.reshape(tl.permute(padded, 0, 1, 3, 2), (8, BLOCK_R, 8))
+            padded = tl.join(padded, tl.zeros_like(padded))
+            padded = tl.reshape(tl.permute(padded, 0, 1, 3, 2), (8, BLOCK_R, 16))
+            region_scores = tl.sum(padded, axis=2)
+            output_valid = row_valid[:, None] & (regions[None, :] < live[:, None])
+            tl.store(
+                Out + rows[:, None] * REGIONS + regions[None, :],
+                region_scores,
+                output_valid,
+            )
+
+
+def launch(
+    q,
+    weights,
+    compressed_index_keys,
+    req_to_token,
+    row_to_req,
+    positions,
+    out,
+    *,
+    clear_future,
+    group_rows=1,
+    weight_scale=1.0,
+):
+    # D256 gathers already consume substantial registers. A 32-region tile
+    # reduces that pressure and gives small batches more independent CTAs.
+    block_regions = 32
+    grid_tiles = min(triton.cdiv(out.shape[1], block_regions), 128)
+    if group_rows == 32 and not clear_future:
+        _score_thirty_two_rows_per_request[(triton.cdiv(q.shape[0], 32), grid_tiles)](
+            q,
+            weights,
+            compressed_index_keys,
+            req_to_token,
+            row_to_req,
+            positions,
+            out,
+            q.shape[1],
+            q.shape[0],
+            req_to_token.stride(0),
+            out.shape[1],
+            block_regions,
+            grid_tiles,
+            weight_scale,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+        return
+    if group_rows == 4 and not clear_future:
+        if q.shape[0] <= 16 and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(q.device) == (10, 3):
+            if q.shape[0] == 4:

+                grid_tiles = min(triton.cdiv(out.shape[1], block_regions), 1024)

+            compressed_index_keys,
+            req_to_token,
+            row_to_req,
+            positions,
+            out,
+            q.shape[1],

+            req_to_token.stride(0),
+            out.shape[1],
+            block_regions,
+            grid_tiles,
+            weight_scale,
+            num_warps=4,
+        )
+        return
+    _score_regions[(q.shape[0], grid_tiles)](
+        q,
+        weights,
+        compressed_index_keys,
+        req_to_token,
+        row_to_req,
+        positions,

+        out.shape[1],
+        block_regions,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Step5 region selection using the existing FlashInfer deterministic top-k."""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def can_use_step5_selection_cute(scores: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        scores.device.type == "cuda"
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(scores.device)[0] == 10
+    )
+
+
+def step5_select_regions(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    row_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    region_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    use_cute: bool | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Select <=512 historical regions, sort IDs, then append current exactly once.
+
+    Inputs follow step5_paged_scores: finite history and -inf future scores.
+    Width covers positions//8. Slot zero is padding. Output IDs are logical,
+    ascending, int32 [T,513], padded with -1; counts are int32 [T]. Caller must
+    keep outputs disjoint from inputs and each other. Warm FlashInfer outside
+    capture and use its shared device scratch on the sequential forward stream.
+    """
+    if scores.device.type != "cuda" or torch.version.hip is not None:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 selection requires NVIDIA CUDA")
+    if (
+        scores.ndim != 2
+        or scores.dtype != torch.float32
+        or not scores.is_contiguous()
+        or not 1 <= scores.shape[1] < 2**31
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 selection requires contiguous FP32 scores [T,R], 1<=R<2**31"
+        )
+    rows, width = scores.shape
+    for name, value, shape in (
+        ("positions", positions, (rows,)),
+        ("row_to_req", row_to_req, (rows,)),
+        ("region_ids", region_ids, (rows, 513)),
+        ("counts", counts, (rows,)),
+    ):
+        dtype_ok = (
+            value.dtype in (torch.int32, torch.int64)
+            if name in ("positions", "row_to_req")
+            else value.dtype == torch.int32
+        )
+        if (
+            value.device != scores.device
+            or value.layout != torch.strided
+            or tuple(value.shape) != shape
+            or not value.is_contiguous()
+            or not dtype_ok
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"Step5 selection invalid {name} metadata")
+    if rows == 0:
+        return region_ids, counts
+    for out, others in (
+        (region_ids, (scores, positions, row_to_req, counts)),
+        (counts, (scores, positions, row_to_req)),
+    ):
+        a = out.data_ptr()
+        b = a + out.numel() * out.element_size()
+        for value in others:
+            lo = value.data_ptr()
+            if max(a, lo) < min(b, lo + value.numel() * value.element_size()):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Step5 selection outputs must not alias inputs or each other"
+                )
+    if use_cute is None:
+        use_cute = can_use_step5_selection_cute(scores)
+    if use_cute:
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_cute import (
+            step5_select_regions_cute,
+        )
+
+        return step5_select_regions_cute(
+            scores, positions, row_to_req, region_ids, counts
+        )
+    selected_k = 0
+    indices = region_ids
+    if width > 512:
+        import flashinfer
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_triton import (
+            canonicalize_zero,
+        )
+
+        # Numerical equality includes +0/-0; the library's radix key does not.
+        # Keep the caller's scores intact, including during graph replay.
+        ordered_scores = torch.empty_like(scores)
+        canonicalize_zero(scores, ordered_scores)
+        _, indices = flashinfer.top_k(
+            ordered_scores,
+            512,
+            sorted=False,
+            deterministic=True,
+            tie_break=1,
+            dsa_graph_safe=True,
+        )
+        selected_k = 512
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_triton import launch
+
+    launch(indices, positions, row_to_req, region_ids, counts, selected_k=selected_k)
+    return region_ids, counts

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""SM10x exact stable Step5 selection bounded by each row's live history."""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.utils
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64, Uint32
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm, nvvm
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_fake_tensor
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+
+_THREADS = 512
+_WARPS = _THREADS // 32
+_TOPK = 512
+_COMPILED = {}
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _bits(value: Float32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    return Uint32(
+        llvm.inline_asm(
+            T.i32(),
+            [Float32(value).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+            "mov.b32 $0, $1;",
+            "=r,f",
+            has_side_effects=False,
+            is_align_stack=False,
+            asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _atomic_add(ptr: cute.Pointer, value: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int32:
+    return Int32(
+        nvvm.atomicrmw(
+            op=nvvm.AtomicOpKind.ADD,
+            ptr=ptr.llvm_ptr,
+            a=value.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _lane_mask(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    return Uint32(nvvm.read_ptx_sreg_lanemask_lt(T.i32(), loc=loc, ip=ip))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ordered_key(value: Float32) -> Uint32:
+    # Stable descending torch/FlashInfer semantics treat signed zero as a tie
+    # and rank NaNs before finite values. Original region order breaks ties.
+    if value == Float32(0.0):
+        value = Float32(0.0)
+    bits = _bits(value)
+    key = bits ^ Uint32(0x80000000)
+    if value < Float32(0.0):
+        key = ~bits
+    if value != value:
+        key = Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF)
+    return key
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_scan(value: Int32, lane: Int32) -> Int32:
+    for index in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        offset = 1 << index
+        other = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_up(value, offset=offset, mask_and_clamp=0)
+        if lane >= Int32(offset):
+            value += other
+    return value
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_region(output, mapping, row, request, slot, region, pack: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    if cutlass.const_expr(pack):
+        logical = Int64(region) * Int64(8)
+        physical = Int64(mapping[Int64(request), logical])
+        output[row, slot] = ((physical // Int64(8)) << Int64(32)) | logical
+    else:
+        output[row, slot] = region
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def _stable_live_topk(
+    scores: cute.Tensor,
+    positions: cute.Tensor,
+    requests: cute.Tensor,
+    region_ids: cute.Tensor,
+    counts: cute.Tensor,
+    mapping: cute.Tensor,
+    lengths: cute.Tensor,
+    pack: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    early_exit: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    capacity: Int32,
+):
+    row = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    thread = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+    lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+    request = Int64(requests[row])
+    live = request > Int64(0)
+    current = cutlass.max(Int32(positions[row]), Int32(0)) // Int32(8)
+    length = cutlass.min(current, capacity)
+    if not live:
+        length = Int32(0)
+
+    @cute.struct
+    class Storage:
+        hist: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 256]
+        warp_hist: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, _WARPS * 257]
+        state: cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 8]
+
+    storage = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator().allocate(Storage)
+    hist = storage.hist.get_tensor(cute.make_layout((256,), stride=(1,)))
+    warp_hist = storage.warp_hist.get_tensor(
+        cute.make_layout((_WARPS, 257), stride=(257, 1))
+    )
+    state = storage.state.get_tensor(cute.make_layout((8,), stride=(1,)))
+
+    region_ids[row, thread] = Int32(-1)
+    if thread == Int32(0):
+        region_ids[row, Int32(_TOPK)] = Int32(-1)
+        counts[row] = Int32(0)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(pack):
+            lengths[row] = Int32(0)
+            if live:
+                lengths[row] = Int32(positions[row]) + Int32(1)
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+    if live:
+        if length <= Int32(_TOPK):
+            if thread < length:
+                _store_region(region_ids, mapping, row, request, thread, thread, pack)
+        else:
+            if thread == Int32(0):
+                state[0] = Int32(0)
+                state[1] = Int32(_TOPK - 1)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(early_exit):
+                    state[4] = Int32(0)
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            tiles = (length + Int32(_THREADS - 1)) // Int32(_THREADS)
+
+            # Refine the threshold prefix. A wholly selected boundary bucket
+            # needs no lower bits: its prefix is an exact selection lower bound.
+            for round_index in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                if cutlass.const_expr(not early_exit) or state[4] == Int32(0):
+                    prefix = Uint32(state[0])
+                    remaining = state[1]
+                    for part in cutlass.range_constexpr(9):
+                        digit = lane + Int32(part * 32)
+                        if digit < Int32(257):
+                            warp_hist[warp, digit] = Int32(0)
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    for tile in cutlass.range(tiles, unroll=1):
+                        index = tile * Int32(_THREADS) + thread
+                        if index < length:
+                            key = _ordered_key(Float32(scores[row, index]))
+                            matches = True
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(round_index > 0):
+                                matches = (key >> Uint32(32 - round_index * 8)) == (
+                                    prefix >> Uint32(32 - round_index * 8)
+                                )
+                            if matches:
+                                digit = Int32(
+                                    (key >> Uint32(24 - round_index * 8)) & Uint32(255)
+                                )
+                                pointer = warp_hist.iterator + cute.crd2idx(
+                                    (warp, digit), warp_hist.layout
+                                )
+                                _atomic_add(pointer, Int32(1))
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+                    count = Int32(0)
+                    inclusive = Int32(0)
+                    digit = Int32(255) - thread
+                    if thread < Int32(256):
+                        for warp_index in cutlass.range_constexpr(_WARPS):
+                            count += warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), digit]
+                        hist[digit] = count
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    if thread < Int32(256):
+                        inclusive = _warp_scan(count, lane)
+                        if lane == Int32(31):
+                            warp_hist[warp, 0] = inclusive
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    if thread == Int32(0):
+                        total = Int32(0)
+                        for warp_index in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                            value = warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 0]
+                            warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 1] = total
+                            total += value
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    if thread < Int32(256):
+                        greater = warp_hist[warp, 1] + inclusive - count
+                        if greater <= remaining and remaining < greater + count:
+                            state[0] = Int32(
+                                prefix | (Uint32(digit) << Uint32(24 - round_index * 8))
+                            )
+                            state[1] = remaining - greater
+                            if cutlass.const_expr(early_exit):
+                                if remaining - greater == count - Int32(1):
+                                    state[4] = Int32(1)
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+            threshold = Uint32(state[0])
+            need_equal = state[1] + Int32(1)
+            if thread == Int32(0):
+                state[2] = Int32(0)
+                state[3] = Int32(0)
+            cute.arch.sync_threads()
+            for tile in cutlass.range(tiles, unroll=1):
+                index = tile * Int32(_THREADS) + thread
+                is_equal = False
+                is_greater = False
+                if index < length:
+                    key = _ordered_key(Float32(scores[row, index]))
+                    is_equal = key == threshold
+                    is_greater = key > threshold
+                ballot = cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(is_equal)
+                equal_rank = Int32(cute.arch.popc(Uint32(ballot) & _lane_mask()))
+                if lane == Int32(0):
+                    warp_hist[warp, 0] = Int32(cute.arch.popc(ballot))
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                if thread == Int32(0):
+                    total = state[2]
+                    for warp_index in cutlass.range_constexpr(_WARPS):
+                        value = warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 0]
+                        warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 1] = total
+                        total += value
+                    state[2] = total
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                selected = is_greater | (
+                    is_equal & (warp_hist[warp, 1] + equal_rank < need_equal)
+                )
+                ballot = cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(selected)
+                selected_rank = Int32(cute.arch.popc(Uint32(ballot) & _lane_mask()))
+                if lane == Int32(0):
+                    warp_hist[warp, 0] = Int32(cute.arch.popc(ballot))
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                if thread == Int32(0):
+                    total = state[3]
+                    for warp_index in cutlass.range_constexpr(_WARPS):
+                        value = warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 0]
+                        warp_hist[Int32(warp_index), 1] = total
+                        total += value
+                    state[3] = total
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                if selected:
+                    slot = warp_hist[warp, 1] + selected_rank
+                    if slot < Int32(_TOPK):
+                        _store_region(
+                            region_ids, mapping, row, request, slot, index, pack
+                        )
+                cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+        if thread == Int32(0):
+            count = cutlass.min(length, Int32(_TOPK)) + Int32(1)
+            _store_region(
+                region_ids, mapping, row, request, count - Int32(1), current, pack
+            )
+            counts[row] = count
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _launch(
+    scores: cute.Tensor,
+    positions: cute.Tensor,
+    requests: cute.Tensor,
+    region_ids: cute.Tensor,
+    counts: cute.Tensor,
+    mapping: cute.Tensor,
+    lengths: cute.Tensor,
+    pack: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    early_exit: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    capacity: Int32,
+    stream,
+):
+    _stable_live_topk(
+        scores,
+        positions,
+        requests,
+        region_ids,
+        counts,
+        mapping,
+        lengths,
+        pack,
+        early_exit,
+        capacity,
+    ).launch(
+        grid=[scores.shape[0], 1, 1],
+        block=[_THREADS, 1, 1],
+        stream=stream,
+    )
+
+
+def step5_select_regions_cute(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    requests: torch.Tensor,
+    region_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    causal_lengths: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Exact stable selection, optionally writing the final sparse-attention ABI.
+
+    Packing changes only the output representation: logical order, FP32 radix
+    keys and stable ties are unchanged. Mapping uses each selected region's
+    actual FULL location; physical contiguity between regions is not assumed.
+    """
+    pack = req_to_token is not None
+    if pack:
+        if (
+            region_ids.dtype != torch.int64
+            or causal_lengths is None
+            or causal_lengths.shape != counts.shape
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Packed selection requires int64 output and causal lengths"
+            )
+    elif causal_lengths is not None or region_ids.dtype != torch.int32:
+        raise ValueError("Logical selection requires int32 output")
+    # Unused arguments are eliminated in the logical-only specialization.
+    tensors = (
+        scores,
+        positions,
+        requests,
+        region_ids,
+        counts,
+        req_to_token if pack else scores,
+        causal_lengths if pack else counts,
+    )
+    layouts = tuple(
+        tuple(stride if stride in (0, 1) else -1 for stride in tensor.stride())
+        for tensor in tensors
+    )
+    early_exit = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(scores.device) == (10, 3)
+    key = scores.device.index, tuple(t.dtype for t in tensors), layouts, early_exit
+    compiled = _COMPILED.get(key)
+    if compiled is None:
+        dtypes = {
+            torch.float32: cutlass.Float32,
+            torch.int32: cutlass.Int32,
+            torch.int64: cutlass.Int64,
+        }
+        fake = [
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                dtypes[tensor.dtype],
+                tuple(cute.sym_int() for _ in tensor.shape),
+                tuple(
+                    stride if stride in (0, 1) else cute.sym_int()
+                    for stride in tensor.stride()
+                ),
+                assumed_align=1,
+            )
+            for tensor in tensors
+        ]
+        compiled = cute.compile(
+            _launch,
+            *fake,
+            pack,
+            early_exit,
+            Int32(scores.shape[1]),
+            make_fake_stream(use_tvm_ffi_env_stream=True),
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi",
+        )
+        _COMPILED[key] = compiled
+    compiled(*tensors, scores.shape[1])
+    return region_ids, counts

+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_triton import launch as pack_regions
+from sglang.kernels.ops.elementwise.deep_select_topk import (
+    DEEP_SELECT_INPUT_STRIDE_ALIGNMENT,
+    deep_select_topk,
+)
+
+STEP5_HISTORY_REGIONS = 512
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _prepare_history_lengths(Positions, Requests, Lengths, ROWS: tl.constexpr):
+    row = tl.program_id(0) * 128 + tl.arange(0, 128)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + row, row < ROWS, other=0)
+    request = tl.load(Requests + row, row < ROWS, other=0)
+    tl.store(Lengths + row, tl.where(request > 0, position // 8, 0), row < ROWS)
+
+
+def can_use_step5_selection_deepselect(device: torch.device) -> bool:
+    return (
+        # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_TOPK_DEEPSELECT; prune dead paths.
+        step5_options.TOPK_DEEPSELECT
+        and device.type == "cuda"
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0] == 10
+    )
+
+
+def deepselect_score_width(score_width: int) -> int:
+    align = DEEP_SELECT_INPUT_STRIDE_ALIGNMENT
+    return (score_width + align - 1) // align * align
+
+
+def step5_select_regions_deepselect(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    row_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    packed: torch.Tensor,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    causal_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    history_lengths: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Sort Step5 region IDs, append the current region and optionally pack addresses."""
+
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _canonicalize_zero(Scores, Out, N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    offset = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    bits = tl.load(Scores + offset, offset < N, other=0.0).to(tl.uint32, bitcast=True)
+    # FlashInfer's radix ordering distinguishes signed zero. Preserve all other
+    # bits, including subnormals, so numerical ties prefer the smaller region ID.
+    bits = tl.where((bits & 0x7FFFFFFF) == 0, 0, bits)
+    tl.store(Out + offset, bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True), offset < N)
+
+
+def canonicalize_zero(scores, out):
+    size = scores.numel()
+    _canonicalize_zero[(triton.cdiv(size, 1024),)](scores, out, size, 1024, num_warps=4)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_regions(
+    Indices,
+    Positions,
+    Requests,
+    Out,
+    Counts,
+    Mapping,
+    Packed,
+    Lengths,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PACKED_WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    lane = tl.arange(0, 512)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + row).to(tl.int32)
+    current = position // 8
+    request = tl.load(Requests + row).to(tl.int64)
+    live = request > 0
+    count = tl.minimum(current, 512)
+    if K > 0:
+        ids = tl.load(Indices + row * K + lane, lane < K, other=2147483647).to(tl.int32)
+        ids = tl.where((ids >= 0) & (ids < current), ids, 2147483647)
+        ids = tl.sort(ids, descending=False)
+    else:
+        ids = lane
+    result = tl.where(lane < count, ids, tl.where(lane == count, current, -1))
+    tl.store(Out + row * 513 + lane, tl.where(live, result, -1))
+    tl.store(Out + row * 513 + 512, tl.where(live & (count == 512), current, -1))
+    tl.store(Counts + row, tl.where(live, count + 1, 0))
+
+    if PACKED_WIDTH > 0:
+        active = live & (lane <= count)
+        logical = result.to(tl.int64) * 8
+        physical = tl.load(
+            Mapping + request * MAP_STRIDE + logical, active, other=0
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        value = ((physical // 8) << 32) | logical
+        tl.store(Packed + row * PACKED_WIDTH + lane, tl.where(active, value, -1))
+
+        # The current region occupies slot 512 when all history slots are used.
+        # Clear the remaining ABI padding for widths 513, 514 and 516 as well.
+        tail = tl.arange(0, 4)
+        active_tail = live & (count == 512) & (tail == 0)
+        logical_tail = current.to(tl.int64) * 8
+        physical_tail = tl.load(
+            Mapping + request * MAP_STRIDE + logical_tail + tl.zeros((4,), tl.int64),
+            active_tail,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        value_tail = ((physical_tail // 8) << 32) | logical_tail
+        tl.store(
+            Packed + row * PACKED_WIDTH + 512 + tail,
+            tl.where(active_tail, value_tail, -1),
+            512 + tail < PACKED_WIDTH,
+        )
+        tl.store(Lengths + row, tl.where(live, position + 1, 0))
+
+
+def launch(
+    indices,
+    positions,
+    requests,
+    out,
+    counts,
+    *,
+    selected_k,
+    req_to_token=None,
+    packed=None,
+    causal_lengths=None,
+):
+    _pack_regions[(out.shape[0],)](
+        indices,
+        positions,
+        requests,
+        out,
+        counts,
+        req_to_token,
+        packed,
+        causal_lengths,
+        selected_k,
+        req_to_token.stride(0) if packed is not None else 0,
+        packed.shape[1] if packed is not None else 0,
+        num_warps=1 if packed is not None and out.shape[0] >= 512 else 4,
+    )

+def _add_periodic_work(sm_work, *, start, tasks, weight):
+    if tasks <= 0:
+        return
+    full, remainder = divmod(tasks, len(sm_work))
+    if full:
+        increment = full * weight
+        for index in range(len(sm_work)):
+            sm_work[index] += increment
+    for index in range(remainder):
+        sm_work[(start + index) % len(sm_work)] += weight
+
+
+def _split_plan_key(*, rows, sm_count, n_split4, n_split2):
+    n_split1 = rows - n_split4 - n_split2
+    sm_work = [0] * sm_count
+    offset = 0
+    _add_periodic_work(sm_work, start=offset, tasks=n_split4 * 4, weight=1)
+    offset += n_split4 * 4
+    _add_periodic_work(sm_work, start=offset, tasks=n_split2 * 2, weight=2)
+    offset += n_split2 * 2
+    _add_periodic_work(sm_work, start=offset, tasks=n_split1, weight=4)
+    max_work = max(sm_work)
+    work_items = rows + n_split2 + 3 * n_split4
+    split_rows = n_split2 + n_split4
+    return max_work, work_items, split_rows, n_split4

+    """Plan a fixed 1/2/4-way decode mix for one captured row capacity.

+    merge work. SGLang owns when to use it and the SM103 kernel execution.

+        raise ValueError("Step5 decode rows must be a positive integer")

+        raise ValueError("Step5 decode SM count must be a positive integer")

+    def add_candidates(work_items):
+        if work_items < rows or work_items > 4 * rows:
+            return
+        n_split2 = work_items - rows
+        if 0 <= n_split2 <= rows:
+            candidates.add((0, n_split2))

+

+
+def step5_pack_decode_regions(
+    region_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    counts: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    row_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_regions: torch.Tensor,
+    causal_lengths: torch.Tensor,

+
+    Selection supplies sorted int32 IDs [T,513] and counts [T], including current.
+    Request slot zero is padding and must have count zero. The native FULL pool

+    Its page16 view uses the same physical token numbering. Each int64 output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Lossless logical-to-physical metadata adaptation for Step5 sparse decode."""
+
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_decode_regions(
+    Ids,
+    Counts,
+    Mapping,
+    Requests,
+    Positions,
+    Packed,
+    Lengths,
+    MAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    lane = tl.arange(0, 1024)
+    request = tl.load(Requests + row).to(tl.int64)
+    count = tl.load(Counts + row)
+    live = request > 0
+    active = live & (lane < count) & (lane < 513)
+    region = tl.load(Ids + row * 513 + lane, active, other=0).to(tl.int64)
+    logical_start = region * 8
+    physical_start = tl.load(
+        Mapping + request * MAP_STRIDE + logical_start,
+        active,
+        other=0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    value = ((physical_start // 8) << 32) | logical_start
+    tl.store(Packed + row * WIDTH + lane, tl.where(active, value, -1), lane < WIDTH)
+    position = tl.load(Positions + row).to(tl.int32)
+    tl.store(Lengths + row, tl.where(live, position + 1, 0))
+
+
+def pack_decode_regions(ids, counts, mapping, requests, positions, packed, lengths):
+    _pack_decode_regions[(ids.shape[0],)](
+        ids,
+        counts,
+        mapping,
+        requests,
+        positions,
+        packed,
+        lengths,
+        mapping.stride(0),
+        packed.shape[1],
+        num_warps=4,
+    )

+"""Align a SWA paged-KV sequence so FA4 n-blocks start at the window.
+
+A 511-token window at ctx=60000 starts at token 59488. tile_n=128 then covers
+logical keys [59392, 60000) — five n-blocks — even though only 512 keys are
+visible. Shifting the logical origin to the window start (leftpad=59488,
+seqused=512) yields four n-blocks without changing which keys are attended.
+
+PagedKVManager already maps ``row + leftpad`` through the page table; this
+helper only computes the host/device integers.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+
+def swa_window_align_supported(query_len: int) -> bool:
+    """True when FA4 leftpad is safe for this query width.
+
+    T=1 decode/draft is the priced SM103 shape. ``query_len > 1`` is MTP
+    verify / draft-extend; pack_gqa plus leftpad changes n-block coverage
+    and is not bit-equivalent to the unaligned sliding window.
+    """
+    return int(query_len) == 1
+
+
+def align_swa_cache_seqlens(
+    cache_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    window_left: int,
+    query_len: int,
+    out_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    out_leftpad: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return ``(aligned_seqlens, leftpad)`` for the visible SWA span.
+
+    ``leftpad = relu(cache_seqlens - (window_left + query_len))`` so the
+    leftmost query still sees a full window. ``aligned_seqlens`` is the
+    remaining K length in that shifted space. Keep the original sliding-window
+    mask: rows>1 still need it for the extra keys on the left of later queries.
+
+    Serving only applies this shift for ``query_len == 1``. MTP target-verify
+    (T=4, pack_gqa) was never the priced shape; using the T=1 leftpad there
+    moves later verify queries off the draft window and pins accept length
+    at ~2. See ``swa_window_align_supported``.
+    """
+    if cache_seqlens.dtype != torch.int32:
+        raise ValueError("cache_seqlens must be int32")
+    if window_left < 0:
+        raise ValueError("window_left must be >= 0")
+    if query_len <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("query_len must be positive")
+    span = int(window_left) + int(query_len)
+    if out_leftpad is None:
+        leftpad = torch.clamp(cache_seqlens - span, min=0)
+    else:
+        torch.clamp(cache_seqlens - span, min=0, out=out_leftpad)
+        leftpad = out_leftpad
+    if out_seqlens is None:
+        seqlens = cache_seqlens - leftpad
+    else:
+        torch.sub(cache_seqlens, leftpad, out=out_seqlens)
+        seqlens = out_seqlens
+    return seqlens, leftpad

+"""Step5 routing with unbiased sigmoid weights and ordered FP32 normalization."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional
+
+from sglang.kernels.fused_op import BaseFusedOp
+from sglang.kernels.spec import CapabilityRequirement, FormatSignature, KernelBackend
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    import torch
+
+
+def _storage_overlaps(left: torch.Tensor, right: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    if left.device != right.device or not left.numel() or not right.numel():
+        return False
+    left_storage, right_storage = left.untyped_storage(), right.untyped_storage()
+    left_start, right_start = left_storage.data_ptr(), right_storage.data_ptr()
+    return max(left_start, right_start) < min(
+        left_start + left_storage.nbytes(), right_start + right_storage.nbytes()
+    )
+
+
+def _prepare_outputs(
+    *,
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    out_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    out_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    import torch
+
+    if (
+        logits.layout != torch.strided
+        or logits.device.type not in ("cpu", "cuda")
+        or logits.dtype != torch.float32
+        or logits.ndim != 2
+        or logits.shape[1] != 352
+        or logits.stride(1) != 1
+        or (logits.shape[0] > 1 and logits.stride(0) < 352)
+        or logits.requires_grad
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "logits must be inference-only FP32 [tokens, 352] on CPU/CUDA, "
+            "with contiguous columns and nonoverlapping rows"
+        )
+    if (
+        bias.layout != torch.strided
+        or bias.device != logits.device
+        or bias.dtype != torch.float32
+        or bias.shape != (352,)
+        or bias.stride(0) != 1
+        or bias.requires_grad
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "bias must be inference-only contiguous FP32 [352] on logits.device"
+        )
+    if (out_weights is None) != (out_ids is None):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "out_weights and out_ids must both be supplied or both omitted"
+        )
+    shape = (logits.shape[0], 8)
+    if out_weights is None:
+        return (
+            torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=logits.device),
+            torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device),
+        )
+    assert out_ids is not None
+    for out, dtype in ((out_weights, torch.float32), (out_ids, torch.int32)):
+        if (
+            out.layout != torch.strided
+            or out.device != logits.device
+            or out.dtype != dtype
+            or out.shape != shape
+            or out.stride(1) != 1
+            or (out.shape[0] > 1 and out.stride(0) < 8)
+            or out.requires_grad
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "outputs must be inference-only FP32 weights/int32 IDs [tokens, 8], "
+                "on logits.device with contiguous columns and nonoverlapping rows"
+            )
+        if _storage_overlaps(out, logits) or _storage_overlaps(out, bias):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "outputs must not share storage memory with logits or bias"
+            )
+    if _storage_overlaps(out_weights, out_ids):
+        raise ValueError("weights and IDs must not share storage memory")
+    return out_weights, out_ids
+
+
+class Step5RouterTopKOp(BaseFusedOp):
+    """FP32 sigmoid + correction bias, top-8, unbiased probabilities, then scale 3.
+
+    The supported input geometry is FP32 logits [tokens, 352] and bias [352].
+    Bias must be finite, verified by the loader before device execution; this
+    operator validates metadata only and does not synchronize to inspect values.
+    Logit NaNs produce positive-zero weights and ID 0 for the entire row;
+    infinities follow sigmoid. Ties choose the lower logical expert ID. Outputs
+    retain descending score order and use FP32 weights / int32 IDs [tokens, 8].
+
+    Each selected weight is sigmoid of its original logit. The denominator adds those
+    eight FP32 values in selection order, then adds 1e-20. Division precedes a
+    separate multiplication by 3. Bias affects selection only; it is never subtracted from a rounded score.
+    There is no tree sum, grouped routing, shared expert, or physical remapping.
+
+    Supplied output buffers may have padded rows/nonzero offsets. They must use
+    storage address ranges distinct from both inputs and each other, including
+    external-memory wrappers. Both outputs must be supplied together. Empty
+    token rows return without importing or launching the Triton leaf. After
+    warmup, supplied buffers support CUDA Graph capture without scratch allocation
+    or data-dependent host reads. Only logical output elements are written.
+
+    Native torch is a cast-graph diagnostic, not a device sigmoid/division oracle;
+    inherited torch.compile and the Triton candidate need independent source
+    device qualification. This operator does not compute the BF16-to-FP32 GEMM.
+    """
+
+    op = "moe.step5_router_topk"
+    priority = (KernelBackend.TRITON, KernelBackend.TORCH)
+    capabilities = {KernelBackend.TRITON: frozenset({CapabilityRequirement.CUDA})}
+    format_signature = FormatSignature(
+        supported_dtypes=("float32",),
+        description="FP32 logits/bias; FP32 weights and int32 IDs; padded rows allowed",
+    )
+    descriptions = {
+        KernelBackend.TRITON: "Step5 top-8 with ordered FP32 unbiased probability normalization.",
+        KernelBackend.TORCH: "CPU cast-graph diagnostic; not a device arithmetic oracle.",
+    }

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        num_experts: int = 352,
+        top_k: int = 8,
+        routed_scaling_factor: float = 3.0,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if type(num_experts) is not int or num_experts != 352:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 routing supports num_experts=352 only")
+        if type(top_k) is not int or top_k != 8:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 routing supports top_k=8 only")
+        if (
+            isinstance(routed_scaling_factor, bool)
+            or not isinstance(routed_scaling_factor, (int, float))
+            or routed_scaling_factor != 3.0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 routing supports routed_scaling_factor=3.0 only")

+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        out_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        out_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        import torch
+
+        weights, ids = _prepare_outputs(
+            logits=logits, bias=bias, out_weights=out_weights, out_ids=out_ids
+        )
+        if num_token_non_padded is not None:
+            if (
+                num_token_non_padded.device != logits.device
+                or num_token_non_padded.dtype != torch.int32
+                or num_token_non_padded.numel() != 1
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("padding count must be a same-device int32 scalar")
+        if logits.shape[0] == 0:
+            return weights, ids
+        probabilities = torch.sigmoid(logits)
+        scores = probabilities + bias
+        total = torch.zeros(logits.shape[0], dtype=torch.float32, device=logits.device)
+        selected, selected_ids = [], []
+        for _ in range(8):
+            score, expert_id = scores.max(dim=-1)
+            probability = probabilities.gather(1, expert_id[:, None]).squeeze(1)
+            selected.append(probability)
+            selected_ids.append(expert_id)
+            total = total + probability
+            scores = scores.scatter(1, expert_id[:, None], -float("inf"))

+        scaled = normalized * 3.0
+        bad = torch.isnan(logits).any(dim=-1, keepdim=True)

+        ids.copy_(torch.stack(selected_ids, dim=-1).masked_fill(bad, 0))
+        if num_token_non_padded is not None:
+            rows = torch.arange(logits.shape[0], device=logits.device)

+
+    def forward_triton(
+        self,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        bias: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        out_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        out_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        import torch
+
+        if logits.device.type != "cuda" or torch.version.hip is not None:
+            raise ValueError("the Triton backend requires NVIDIA CUDA logits")

+            logits=logits, bias=bias, out_weights=out_weights, out_ids=out_ids
+        )
+        if num_token_non_padded is not None:
+            if (
+                num_token_non_padded.device != logits.device
+                or num_token_non_padded.dtype != torch.int32
+                or num_token_non_padded.numel() != 1
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("padding count must be a same-device int32 scalar")

+            return weights, ids
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.step5_router_topk_triton import _step5_router_topk
+

+            logits=logits,
+            bias=bias,
+            weights=weights,
+            ids=ids,
+            num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded,
+        )
+        return weights, ids

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the SGLang project
+"""Adapted from vLLM models/step5/nvidia/ops/triton/router_bias.py.
+
+Preserves sigmoid probabilities from the selected logits, ordered normalization,
+and scale. This leaf uses one fixed launch configuration, not vLLM's optional
+driver-launch cache or autotuner. Public metadata validation owns buffer safety.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _step5_router_topk_kernel(
+    logits,
+    bias,
+    weights_out,
+    ids_out,
+    logits_stride,
+    weights_stride,
+    ids_stride,
+    num_token_non_padded,
+    HAS_PADDING: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    expert = tl.arange(0, 512)
+    valid = expert < 352
+    gating = tl.load(logits + row * logits_stride + expert, mask=valid, other=0)
+    probability = tl.sigmoid(gating.to(tl.float32))
+    correction = tl.load(bias + expert, mask=valid, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    correction = tl.where(valid, correction, -float("inf"))
+    scores = tl.where(valid, probability + correction, -float("inf"))
+    has_bad = tl.max((gating != gating).to(tl.int32), axis=0) > 0
+
+    weights = tl.zeros((8,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    indices = tl.zeros((8,), dtype=tl.int32)
+    total = 0.0
+    slot = tl.arange(0, 8)
+    for k in tl.static_range(8):
+        score, index = tl.max(
+            scores, axis=0, return_indices=True, return_indices_tie_break_left=True
+        )
+        index = index.to(tl.int32)
+        # NaN rows are overwritten below, but still execute the reduction. A
+        # masked padding winner must never read outside the logical logits row.
+        selected_logit = tl.load(
+            logits + row * logits_stride + index,
+            mask=(index >= 0) & (index < 352),
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        # Bias affects selection only. Subtracting it from the rounded score
+        # can erase small probabilities and change normalized routing weights.
+        selected_probability = tl.sigmoid(selected_logit)
+        weights = tl.where(slot == k, selected_probability, weights)
+        indices = tl.where(slot == k, index, indices)
+        total += selected_probability
+        scores = tl.where(expert == index, -float("inf"), scores)
+
+    weights = weights / (total + 1e-20)
+    weights = weights * 3.0
+    weights = tl.where(has_bad, 0.0, weights)
+    indices = tl.where(has_bad, 0, indices)
+    tl.store(weights_out + row * weights_stride + slot, weights)
+    if HAS_PADDING:
+        indices = tl.where(row < tl.load(num_token_non_padded), indices, -1)
+    tl.store(ids_out + row * ids_stride + slot, indices)
+
+
+def _step5_router_topk(
+    *,
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ids: torch.Tensor,
+    num_token_non_padded: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    _step5_router_topk_kernel[(logits.shape[0],)](
+        logits,
+        bias,
+        weights,
+        ids,
+        logits.stride(0),
+        weights.stride(0),
+        ids.stride(0),
+        num_token_non_padded,
+        HAS_PADDING=num_token_non_padded is not None,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=2,
+    )

+def get_step5_text_config(config: PretrainedConfig) -> "Step5Config | None":
+    """Resolve the Step5 backbone in a text checkpoint or a Step3.7 VLM."""
+    text_config = getattr(config, "text_config", config)

+def _consume_alias(*, kwargs: dict[str, Any], name: str, expected: Any) -> None:
+    value = kwargs.pop(name, None)
+    if value is not None and value != expected:
+        raise ValueError(f"Step5 {name}={value!r} conflicts with {expected!r}.")
+
+
+def _check_layer_array(*, name: str, values: list | None, total_layers: int) -> None:
+    if values and len(values) < total_layers:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Step5 {name} must cover the main and MTP layers: expected at least "
+            f"{total_layers} entries, got {len(values)}."
+        )

+
+def _resolve_head_dim(*, hidden_size: int, num_heads: int, head_dim: int | None) -> int:
+    if num_heads <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 attention head counts must be positive.")
+    if head_dim is None:
+        if hidden_size % num_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 hidden_size must be divisible by num_heads when head_dim "
+                f"is omitted, got hidden_size={hidden_size}, num_heads={num_heads}."
+            )
+        return hidden_size // num_heads
+    return head_dim
+
+
+def _parse_moe_layers(*, value: str | list[int] | None, name: str) -> set[int] | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    raw = value.split(",") if isinstance(value, str) else value
+    try:
+        indices = [int(item) for item in raw if str(item).strip()]
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"Step5 {name} must contain integer layer indices.") from exc
+    if len(indices) != len(set(indices)):
+        raise ValueError(f"Step5 {name} contains duplicate layer indices.")
+    return set(indices)

+    @staticmethod

+        num_attention_groups: int,
+        num_hidden_layers: int,
+        num_nextn_predict_layers: int,
+        max_seq_len: int,

+        kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:

+            )

+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 requires positive main depth and non-negative MTP depth."
+            )

+            if other

+                serialized[: self.num_hidden_layers]

+            for value in layer_types
