+class Step5LayerSelection(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Absolute attention IDs owned by one target or one MTP runner.
+
+    ``draft_model_idx`` remains a relative checkpoint depth. Only this resolver
+    translates it; model and pool construction must consume the resulting IDs.
+    The model owns this value; its runner reuses it after load. The shared
+    ModelConfig keeps the complete partition for its role.
+    """
+
+    draft_model_idx: int | None
+    start_layer: int
+    end_layer: int
+    full_attention_layer_ids: tuple[int, ...]
+    swa_attention_layer_ids: tuple[int, ...]
+
+
+def get_step5_mtp_layer_ids(
+    *, config: Step5Config
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
+    """Return the entire checkpoint's absolute (SWA, FULL) draft partition."""
+    start = config.num_hidden_layers
+    depth = config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+    if type(start) is not int or start <= 0 or type(depth) is not int or depth <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 MTP requires positive main and draft depths.")
+    end = start + depth
+    types = config.layer_types_with_mtp
+    if types is None or len(types) < end:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 MTP requires explicit attention types for every layer.")
+    swa = tuple(i for i in range(start, end) if types[i] == "sliding_attention")
+    full = tuple(i for i in range(start, end) if types[i] == "full_attention")
+    if len(swa) + len(full) != depth:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 MTP contains an unknown attention type.")
+    return swa, full
+
+
+def resolve_step5_layer_selection(
+    *,
+    config: Step5Config,
+    draft_model_idx: int | None,
+) -> Step5LayerSelection:
+    """Resolve from the exact config and relative-index kwargs of the loader.
+
+    This metadata boundary supports a declared SWA-only draft partition. It does
+    not enable a speculative algorithm or qualify any draft execution depth.
+    """
+    pass
+
+    if not isinstance(config, Step5Config):
+        raise TypeError("Step5 layer selection requires the registered Step5 config.")
+    architecture = config.architectures[0]
+    if architecture not in ("Step5ForCausalLM", "Step5MTP"):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 layer selection requires a Step5 architecture.")
+    draft = architecture == "Step5MTP"
+    if not config.is_hybrid_swa:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 layer selection requires native hybrid SWA memory.")
+    if draft:
+        swa, full = get_step5_mtp_layer_ids(config=config)
+        if full:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 draft FULL/DSA attention is not supported.")
+        if type(draft_model_idx) is not int or not (
+            0 <= draft_model_idx < config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 draft_model_idx must be a valid relative depth.")
+        layer_id = swa[draft_model_idx]
+        return Step5LayerSelection(
+            draft_model_idx=draft_model_idx,
+            start_layer=layer_id,
+            end_layer=layer_id + 1,
+            full_attention_layer_ids=(),
+            swa_attention_layer_ids=(layer_id,),
+        )
+    if draft_model_idx is not None:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 target must not have a draft_model_idx.")
+    # This is the same checkpoint-owned pattern consumed by the native hybrid
+    # config adapter; it includes only main layers, even for a bundled MTP file.
+    pattern = config.hybrid_layer_pattern
+    full = tuple(i for i, kind in enumerate(pattern) if kind == 0)
+    swa = tuple(i for i, kind in enumerate(pattern) if kind == 1)
+    if len(pattern) != config.num_hidden_layers or len(full) + len(swa) != len(pattern):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 target pattern must cover every main layer once.")
+    return Step5LayerSelection(
+        draft_model_idx=None,
+        start_layer=0,
+        end_layer=config.num_hidden_layers,
+        full_attention_layer_ids=full,
+        swa_attention_layer_ids=swa,
+    )

+class Step5IndexGeometry(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    index_head_dim: int
+    index_k_heads: int
+    region_size: int

+def parse_step5_index_geometry(config) -> Step5IndexGeometry:
+    """Shared model/pool interpretation of the compressed-key storage geometry."""
+    sparse = config.sparse_config
+    geometry = Step5IndexGeometry(
+        index_head_dim=config.index_head_dim,
+        index_k_heads=sparse["sparse_indexer_num_k_heads"],
+        region_size=sparse["region_block_size"],
+    )
+    values = (geometry.index_head_dim, geometry.index_k_heads, geometry.region_size)
+    if any(type(value) is not int for value in values) or values != (256, 1, 8):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 index kernels require D256/H1/R8 geometry")
+    return geometry

+class Step5AttentionProfile(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    hidden_size: int
+    head_dim: int
+    num_heads: int
+    num_kv_heads: int
+    index_head_dim: int
+    index_num_heads: int
+    index_num_kv_heads: int
+    provider_groups: int
+    region_size: int
+    index_rope_dim: int
+    sliding_window: int
+
+
+def parse_step5_attention_profile(config) -> Step5AttentionProfile:
+    sparse = config.sparse_config
+    index = parse_step5_index_geometry(config)
+    profile = Step5AttentionProfile(
+        hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+        head_dim=config.head_dim,
+        num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+        num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+        # External config spelling is handled by Step5Config.index_head_dim.
+        index_head_dim=index.index_head_dim,
+        index_num_heads=sparse["sparse_indexer_num_heads"],
+        index_num_kv_heads=index.index_k_heads,
+        provider_groups=sparse["num_provider_groups"],
+        region_size=index.region_size,
+        index_rope_dim=sparse["sparse_indexer_rope_dim"],
+        sliding_window=config.sliding_window,
+    )
+    # Current QK-norm, scoring and R8 compressor kernel capabilities.
+    if (
+        profile.hidden_size,
+        profile.head_dim,
+        profile.num_heads,
+        profile.num_kv_heads,
+        profile.index_head_dim,
+        profile.index_num_heads,
+        profile.index_num_kv_heads,
+        profile.provider_groups,
+        profile.region_size,
+        profile.index_rope_dim,
+        profile.sliding_window,
+    ) != (4096, 192, 64, 4, 256, 16, 1, 4, 8, 32, 512):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 kernels require the D192/R8/index-D256 profile")
+    if (
+        config.num_sliding_attention_heads,
+        config.swa_num_key_value_heads,
+        config.swa_head_dim,
+    ) != (profile.num_heads, profile.num_kv_heads, profile.head_dim):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 FULL/SWA attention geometry must agree")
+    if (
+        config.zero_centered is not True
+        or config.norm_dtype.lower() not in ("fp32", "float32", "float")
+        or config.use_head_wise_attn_gate is not True
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 requires FP32 Gemma norms and per-head gates")
+    required = {
+        "enabled": True,
+        "sparse_indexer_use_rope": True,
+        "sparse_indexer_q_norm_type": "rmsnorm",
+        "sparse_indexer_k_norm_type": "layernorm",
+        "sparse_indexer_csa_z_norm_type": "none",
+    }
+    if any(sparse[key] != value for key, value in required.items()):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 indexer differs from the supported norm/RoPE profile")
+    for layer_id, kind in enumerate(config.layer_types_with_mtp):
+        if kind not in ("full_attention", "sliding_attention"):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 attention has an unknown layer type")
+        full = kind == "full_attention"
+        width = 64 if full else profile.head_dim
+        if (
+            config.rope_theta[layer_id] != (10_000_000 if full else 10_000)
+            or config.partial_rotary_factors[layer_id] != width / profile.head_dim
+            or (
+                config.use_rope_layers is not None
+                and not config.use_rope_layers[layer_id]
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 attention RoPE differs from the supported table profile"
+            )
+    return profile
+

+def resolve_step5_vocab_size(
+    *, config: Step5Config, tokenizer_vocab_size: int | None
+) -> int:
+    """Resolve once before model/serving construction; never resize HF weights."""
+    explicit = config.valid_vocab_size
+    if explicit is not None and (
+        type(explicit) is not int or not 0 < explicit <= config.vocab_size
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 valid_vocab_size must be in (0, physical vocab_size]")
+    if tokenizer_vocab_size is None:
+        if explicit is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 skip_tokenizer_init requires valid_vocab_size in "
+                "--json-model-override-args"
+            )
+        return explicit
+    bound = tokenizer_vocab_size
+    if bound > config.vocab_size:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 tokenizer token-ID bound exceeds physical vocab_size")
+    if explicit is not None and explicit > bound:
+        raise ValueError("Step5 valid_vocab_size exceeds tokenizer token-ID bound")
+    return bound if explicit is None else explicit

+def get_step5_position_padding() -> int:
+    """Execution headroom, not an extension of the advertised model context.
+
+    The public speculative worker computes a complete window before enforcing
+    each request's output limit. Keep RoPE, indexer and MTP input validation
+    within the same native request-row allocation. R8 storage needs full groups.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocation_sizing import (
+        get_req_to_token_extra_context_len,
+    )
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_spec
+
+    if get_spec().speculative_algorithm is None:
+        return 0
+    return get_req_to_token_extra_context_len() // 8 * 8

+import json
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Tool
+from sglang.srt.function_call.core_types import StreamingParseResult, ToolCallItem
+from sglang.srt.function_call.qwen3_coder_detector import Qwen3CoderDetector
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _NormalizedSegment:
+    text: str
+    literal: bool = False
+
+
+class _Step5XMLNormalizer:
+    """Normalize high-confidence Step5 XML mistakes incrementally.
+
+    Step models use the same canonical XML protocol as Qwen3-Coder, but they
+    occasionally omit a delimiter or a closing tag. Repairs are deliberately
+    schema-gated and only happen when a later tag provides an unambiguous
+    boundary. A stream truncated at EOS is left untouched.
+    """
+
+    _FIXED_TAGS = (
+        "<tool_call>",
+        "</tool_call>",
+        "</function>",
+        "</parameter>",
+    )
+    _PARTIAL_PREFIXES = _FIXED_TAGS + ("<function", "<parameter")
+
+    def __init__(self, tools: List[Tool]):
+        self._buffer = ""
+        self._input_length = 0
+        self._function_parameters = self._collect_tool_schema(tools)
+
+        self._inside_tool_call = False
+        self._synthetic_tool_call = False
+        self._function_open = False
+        self._parameter_open = False
+        self._current_function: Optional[str] = None
+        self._suppress_current_tool = False
+        self._current_tool_raw_start: Optional[int] = None
+        self._redundant_synthetic_close_pending = False
+        self._pending_synthetic_whitespace = ""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _collect_tool_schema(tools: List[Tool]) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+        schemas: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+        for tool in tools:
+            try:
+                if tool.type != "function" or not tool.function.name:
+                    continue
+                parameters = tool.function.parameters
+                if isinstance(parameters, dict):
+                    properties = parameters.get("properties", {})
+                    parameter_names = (
+                        set(properties) if isinstance(properties, dict) else set()
+                    )
+                else:
+                    parameter_names = set()
+                schemas[tool.function.name] = parameter_names
+            except AttributeError:
+                continue
+        return schemas
+
+    def _is_partial_tag(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        return any(prefix.startswith(text) for prefix in self._PARTIAL_PREFIXES)
+
+    def _looks_like_function_candidate(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        suffix = text[len("<function") :]
+        if not suffix:
+            return True
+
+        if self._inside_tool_call and not self._function_open:
+            return suffix[0] in "= \t\r\n" or suffix[0].isalpha()
+
+        if suffix[0] == "=":
+            candidate_name = re.split(r"[\s<>]", suffix[1:], maxsplit=1)[0]
+            return not candidate_name or any(
+                name.startswith(candidate_name) for name in self._function_parameters
+            )
+
+        if suffix[0] in " \t\r\n":
+            candidate_name = re.split(r"[\s<>]", suffix.lstrip(), maxsplit=1)[0]
+            if not candidate_name:
+                return True
+            if ">" in text:
+                return candidate_name in self._function_parameters
+            return any(
+                name.startswith(candidate_name) for name in self._function_parameters
+            )
+
+        candidate_name = re.split(r"[\s<>]", suffix, maxsplit=1)[0]
+        return any(
+            name.startswith(candidate_name) for name in self._function_parameters
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _looks_like_parameter_candidate(text: str) -> bool:
+        suffix = text[len("<parameter") :]
+        return not suffix or suffix.startswith("=")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _append(
+        output: list[_NormalizedSegment], text: str, *, literal: bool = False
+    ) -> None:
+        if not text:
+            return
+        if output and output[-1].literal == literal:
+            output[-1].text += text
+        else:
+            output.append(_NormalizedSegment(text=text, literal=literal))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _split_missing_angle_body(body: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        """Split a missing-``>`` tag into its name and preserved suffix."""
+        match = re.match(r"([^\s<]+)(.*)", body, re.DOTALL)
+        if match is None:
+            return "", body
+        return match.group(1), match.group(2)
+
+    def _normalize_function_tag(
+        self, raw_tag: str, complete: bool
+    ) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
+        if complete:
+            canonical = re.fullmatch(r"<function=([^<>]+)>", raw_tag)
+            if canonical:
+                return raw_tag, canonical.group(1)
+
+            missing_equals = re.fullmatch(
+                r"<function(?:\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*>", raw_tag
+            )
+            if missing_equals:
+                name = missing_equals.group(1)
+                if name in self._function_parameters:
+                    return f"<function={name}>", name
+            return None, None
+
+        if not raw_tag.startswith("<function="):
+            return None, None
+        name, suffix = self._split_missing_angle_body(raw_tag[len("<function=") :])
+        if name in self._function_parameters:
+            return f"<function={name}>{suffix}", name
+        return None, None
+
+    def _normalize_parameter_tag(
+        self, raw_tag: str, complete: bool
+    ) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
+        if complete:
+            canonical = re.fullmatch(r"<parameter=([^<>]+)>", raw_tag)
+            if canonical:
+                return raw_tag, canonical.group(1)
+            return None, None
+
+        if not raw_tag.startswith("<parameter=") or not self._current_function:
+            return None, None
+
+        name, suffix = self._split_missing_angle_body(raw_tag[len("<parameter=") :])
+        if name.startswith("parameter="):
+            name = name[len("parameter=") :]
+        name = name.rstrip(":,;")
+        declared = self._function_parameters.get(self._current_function, set())
+        if name in declared:
+            return f"<parameter={name}>{suffix}", name
+        return None, None
+
+    def _take_named_tag(self, kind: str) -> Optional[tuple[str, bool, int]]:
+        """Return ``(raw_tag, complete, consumed)`` or wait for more input."""
+        gt_pos = self._buffer.find(">", 1)
+        next_lt = self._buffer.find("<", 1)
+        if gt_pos != -1 and (next_lt == -1 or gt_pos < next_lt):
+            return self._buffer[: gt_pos + 1], True, gt_pos + 1
+        if next_lt != -1:
+            return self._buffer[:next_lt], False, next_lt
+
+        # A missing right angle is only repairable once a later tag supplies
+        # the boundary. Until then this may simply be a split canonical tag.
+        expected = f"<{kind}"
+        if self._buffer.startswith(expected):
+            return None
+        return self._buffer[0], True, 1

+    def _close_parameter(self, output: list[_NormalizedSegment]) -> None:
+        if self._parameter_open:
+            self._append(output, "</parameter>")
+            self._parameter_open = False
+
+    def _close_function(self, output: list[_NormalizedSegment]) -> None:
+        self._close_parameter(output)
+        if self._function_open:
+            self._append(output, "</function>")
+            self._function_open = False
+            self._current_function = None
+
+    def _close_tool_call(self, output: list[_NormalizedSegment]) -> None:
+        self._close_function(output)
+        if self._inside_tool_call:
+            self._append(output, "</tool_call>")
+        self._inside_tool_call = False
+        self._synthetic_tool_call = False
+        self._suppress_current_tool = False
+        self._current_tool_raw_start = None
+        self._redundant_synthetic_close_pending = False
+        self._pending_synthetic_whitespace = ""
+
+    def _handle_tool_start(
+        self, output: list[_NormalizedSegment], raw_start: int
+    ) -> None:
+        if self._inside_tool_call:
+            self._close_tool_call(output)
+        self._append(output, "<tool_call>")
+        self._inside_tool_call = True
+        self._current_tool_raw_start = raw_start
+
+    def _handle_function_start(
+        self,
+        output: list[_NormalizedSegment],
+        raw_tag: str,
+        complete: bool,
+        raw_start: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        if self._suppress_current_tool:
+            return
+
+        if self._parameter_open or self._function_open:
+            # A function-looking fragment inside an existing function may be
+            # literal parameter content. Step's protocol permits one function
+            # per tool-call wrapper, so treating it as a second function would
+            # be an unsafe repair.
+            self._append(output, raw_tag)
+            return
+
+        normalized, name = self._normalize_function_tag(raw_tag, complete)
+        if normalized is None or name is None:
+            if self._inside_tool_call:
+                # The wrapper has already been consumed by the downstream
+                # parser. Suppress malformed internals until its close rather
+                # than emitting argument fragments with tool_index=-1.
+                self._suppress_current_tool = True
+            else:
+                self._append(output, raw_tag, literal=True)
+            return

+        if not self._inside_tool_call:
+            # A missing outer wrapper is repaired only for a declared tool.
+            # Canonical unknown functions inside a real wrapper retain the
+            # existing Qwen parser behavior, but a bare unknown call is not
+            # promoted from text into a structured action.
+            if name not in self._function_parameters:
+                self._append(output, raw_tag, literal=True)
+                return
+            self._append(output, "<tool_call>")
+            self._inside_tool_call = True
+            self._synthetic_tool_call = True
+            self._current_tool_raw_start = raw_start
+
+        if self._function_open:
+            self._close_function(output)
+        self._suppress_current_tool = False
+        self._append(output, normalized)
+        self._function_open = True
+        self._current_function = name
+
+    def _handle_parameter_start(
+        self, output: list[_NormalizedSegment], raw_tag: str, complete: bool
+    ) -> None:
+        if self._suppress_current_tool:
+            return
+        if not self._function_open:
+            self._append(output, raw_tag, literal=True)
+            return
+        normalized, name = self._normalize_parameter_tag(raw_tag, complete)
+        if normalized is None or name is None:
+            # Preserve unsupported XML-like text as parameter content instead
+            # of silently deleting it or manufacturing a parameter name.
+            self._append(output, raw_tag)
+            return

+        self._append(output, normalized)
+        self._parameter_open = True

+class Step5Detector(Qwen3CoderDetector):
+    """Step5 tool parser with schema-gated malformed XML recovery."""
+
+    _FUNCTION_CANDIDATE = re.compile(r"<function(?:=|\s+|[A-Za-z_])", re.DOTALL)

+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self._step_normalizer: Optional[_Step5XMLNormalizer] = None

+        # into the next OpenAI request.  Do not publish its name before the
+        # complete arguments object is available: a stream that ends after the
+        # function tag would otherwise expose ``arguments=""``, which this same
+        # frontend rejects when the response is used as assistant history.
+        self._atomic_tool_buffer = ""
+        self._next_stream_tool_index = 0
+
+    def has_tool_call(self, text: str) -> bool:
+        # Serving checks this before non-stream parsing. Recognize a bare
+        # function candidate so the Step-only missing-wrapper repair is reachable.
+        return super().has_tool_call(text) or bool(
+            self._FUNCTION_CANDIDATE.search(text)
+        )
+
+    def detect_and_parse(self, text: str, tools: List[Tool]) -> StreamingParseResult:
+        normalizer = _Step5XMLNormalizer(tools)
+        segments = normalizer.feed(text)
+
+        # A partial opening tag has no reliable boundary. Do not turn it into
+        # an empty/invalid tool call merely because the non-streaming request
+        # reached EOS.
+        incomplete_start = normalizer.incomplete_tool_raw_start
+        if incomplete_start is not None:
+            # Keep completed calls before the truncated suffix. Re-running the
+            # prefix makes the rollback local to the unfinished wrapper rather
+            # than turning the entire response back into ordinary text.
+            prefix_result = (
+                self.detect_and_parse(text[:incomplete_start], tools)
+                if incomplete_start > 0
+                else StreamingParseResult()
+            )
+            prefix_result.normal_text += text[incomplete_start:]
+            return prefix_result
+
+        # Non-streaming owns the complete output and can safely close a
+        # schema-confirmed Step call at EOS. Streaming deliberately waits for
+        # a later chunk because it has no explicit finish callback.
+        trailing: list[_NormalizedSegment] = []

+            normalizer._close_tool_call(trailing)

+            result = self._parse_segments(Qwen3CoderDetector(), segments, tools)

+        calls_by_index: dict[int, ToolCallItem] = {}

+                call.tool_index,
+                ToolCallItem(tool_index=call.tool_index, parameters=""),
+            )

+            state.parameters += call.parameters

+
+    def parse_streaming_increment(
+        self, new_text: str, tools: List[Tool]
+    ) -> StreamingParseResult:
+        if self._step_normalizer is None:
+            self._step_normalizer = _Step5XMLNormalizer(tools)
+        segments = self._step_normalizer.feed(new_text)
+        normal_text: list[str] = []
+        calls: list[ToolCallItem] = []
+
+        for segment in segments:
+            if segment.literal:
+                normal_text.append(segment.text)
+                continue
+
+            self._atomic_tool_buffer += segment.text
+            while "</tool_call>" in self._atomic_tool_buffer:
+                end = self._atomic_tool_buffer.index("</tool_call>") + len(
+                    "</tool_call>"
+                )
+                candidate = self._atomic_tool_buffer[:end]
+                self._atomic_tool_buffer = self._atomic_tool_buffer[end:]
+
+                parsed = Qwen3CoderDetector().detect_and_parse(candidate, tools)
+                if not parsed.calls:
+                    # Preserve the detector's established handling for an
+                    # unknown/malformed wrapped call.  It may intentionally
+                    # suppress the wrapper instead of surfacing it as text.
+                    normal_text.append(parsed.normal_text)
+                    continue
+
+                complete_calls: list[ToolCallItem] = []
+                valid = True
+                for call in parsed.calls:
+                    try:
+                        arguments = json.loads(call.parameters)
+                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    complete_calls.append(
+                        ToolCallItem(
+                            tool_index=self._next_stream_tool_index + call.tool_index,
+                            name=call.name,
+                            parameters=json.dumps(arguments, ensure_ascii=False),
+                        )
+                    )
+
+                if not valid:
+                    normal_text.append(candidate)
+                    continue
+
+                calls.extend(complete_calls)
+                self._next_stream_tool_index += len(complete_calls)
+
+        return StreamingParseResult(normal_text="".join(normal_text), calls=calls)
+
+    def finish(self, tools: List[Tool]) -> StreamingParseResult:
+        """Release an incomplete Step call as text instead of a partial action.
+
+        Structured tool calls are committed atomically by
+        :meth:`parse_streaming_increment`.  At EOS, any remaining candidate is
+        necessarily incomplete, so preserving it as assistant text keeps the
+        response truthful and guarantees that it can be used as history by the
+        same frontend.
+        """
+        suffix = ""
+        if self._step_normalizer is not None:
+            suffix = "".join(
+                segment.text for segment in self._step_normalizer.flush_unrepairable()
+            )
+        normal_text = self._atomic_tool_buffer + suffix
+        self._atomic_tool_buffer = ""
+        return StreamingParseResult(normal_text=normal_text)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _parse_segments(
+        parser: Qwen3CoderDetector,
+        segments: list[_NormalizedSegment],
+        tools: List[Tool],
+    ) -> StreamingParseResult:
+        normal_text: list[str] = []
+        calls: list[ToolCallItem] = []
+        for segment in segments:
+            if segment.literal:
+                normal_text.append(segment.text)
+                continue
+            result = Qwen3CoderDetector.parse_streaming_increment(
+                parser, segment.text, tools
+            )
+            normal_text.append(result.normal_text)
+            calls.extend(result.calls)
+        return StreamingParseResult(normal_text="".join(normal_text), calls=calls)

+"""Step5 non-online compression plans and ring execution."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.csa_ring import AppendRingPlan, append_ring
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.step5.metadata import Step5IndexerMetadata
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import async_h2d
+
+
+def build_prefill_compression_inputs(
+    *,
+    request_slots,
+    prefix_lengths,
+    append_lengths,
+    req_to_token,
+    compressed_index_key_pages,
+) -> dict:
+    """Build a batched prefill plan once, shared by every DSA layer.
+
+    CPU spans are native scheduler metadata. All FULL mapping checks are batched
+    on device. A request with any invalid completed region is disabled in full.
+    Padding consumes source rows but never owns ring cells or destinations.
+    """
+    if (
+        req_to_token.device.type != "cuda"
+        or req_to_token.ndim != 2
+        or req_to_token.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64)
+        or compressed_index_key_pages < 2
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("CSA append requires native CUDA request/FULL mapping")
+    if any(len(v) != len(request_slots) for v in (prefix_lengths, append_lengths)):
+        raise ValueError("CSA append batch lengths differ")
+    rows, source = [], 0
+    for base, length in zip(prefix_lengths, append_lengths):
+        if (
+            length < 0
+            or base < 0
+            or base + length > min(1048576, req_to_token.shape[1])
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("CSA append invalid logical span")
+        rows.append((base, source, length))
+        source += length
+    if source > 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("CSA append packed input exceeds int32")
+    device = req_to_token.device
+    raw_slots = torch.as_tensor(request_slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    slots = raw_slots.clamp(0, req_to_token.shape[0] - 1)
+    packed = async_h2d(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device=device).reshape(-1, 3)
+    bases, sources, lengths = packed.T.contiguous().unbind(0)
+    active = (raw_slots != 0) & (lengths > 0)
+    uses = torch.zeros(req_to_token.shape[0], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    uses.scatter_add_(0, slots, active.to(torch.int32))
+    admitted = (raw_slots == slots) & (uses[slots] == 1)
+    max_regions = max(((row[0] % 8 + row[2]) // 8 for row in rows), default=0)
+    region = torch.arange(max_regions, device=device)[:, None]
+    offsets = torch.arange(8, device=device)
+    logical = (bases // 8 + region) * 8
+    complete = logical + 8 <= bases + lengths
+    mapped = req_to_token[
+        slots[None, :, None],
+        (logical[:, :, None] + offsets).clamp_max(req_to_token.shape[1] - 1),
+    ].long()
+    first = mapped[:, :, 0]
+    valid = (
+        (first >= 64)
+        & (first < compressed_index_key_pages * 64)
+        & (first.remainder(8) == 0)
+        & (mapped == first[:, :, None] + offsets).all(2)
+    )
+    return dict(
+        request_slots=slots,
+        input_start_positions=bases,
+        input_start_rows=sources,
+        input_lengths=lengths,
+        request_active=active,
+        request_mapping_valid=admitted & (~complete | valid).all(0),
+        request_count_valid=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.bool, device=device),
+        compressed_key_write_indices=(first // 8).contiguous(),
+        num_input_tokens=source,
+    )
+
+
+def compress_index_keys(
+    *,
+    batch: Step5IndexerMetadata,
+    compressed_index_keys,
+    index_key_ring,
+    compression_logits_ring,
+    positions,
+    index_key,
+    compression_logits,
+    enabled,
+    success,
+    assert_success=False,
+    use_pdl=False,
+):
+    """Compress history/current inputs, then retain inputs for the next forward.
+
+    One batched launch sequence serves prefill, decode and verify. Acceptance
+    changes native sequence lengths only; rejected ring values are overwritten
+    when their positions are reused. Region scoring enforces query causality.
+    """
+    # K is packed; Z may be a row-padded view of the combined projection.
+    # No forward-mode flag reaches the kernels.
+    for value in (index_key, compression_logits):
+        if (
+            value.shape != (batch.num_input_tokens, 1, 256)
+            or value.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or value.device != batch.request_slots.device
+            or value.stride(2) != 1
+            or value.stride(0) < 256
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 compression requires BF16 index K/Z rows: "
+                f"expected shape={(batch.num_input_tokens, 1, 256)}, "
+                f"got shape={tuple(value.shape)}, dtype={value.dtype}, "
+                f"device={value.device}, strides={value.stride()}"
+            )
+    if not index_key.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("Step5 compression requires packed BF16 index K")
+    plan = AppendRingPlan(
+        slots=batch.request_slots,
+        bases=batch.input_start_positions,
+        sources=batch.input_start_rows,
+        lengths=batch.input_lengths,
+        active=batch.request_active,
+        admitted=batch.request_mapping_valid,
+        count_valid=batch.request_count_valid,
+        physical_regions=batch.compressed_key_write_indices,
+        max_regions=batch.compressed_key_write_indices.shape[0],
+        enabled=enabled,
+        success=success,
+    )
+    return append_ring(
+        plan=plan,
+        index_key=index_key,
+        compression_logits=compression_logits,
+        index_key_ring=index_key_ring,
+        compression_logits_ring=compression_logits_ring,
+        positions=positions,
+        compressed_index_keys=compressed_index_keys,
+        assert_success=assert_success,
+        use_pdl=use_pdl,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Step5 index projections, compression and region selection."""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.nn import functional as F
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.indexer_norm import step5_indexer_norm_rope
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.tiny_gemm import tiny_gemm_bf16
+from sglang.srt.configs.step5 import get_step5_position_padding
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.step5.compressor import compress_index_keys
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.step5.metadata import Step5IndexerMetadata
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.step5.region_selection import select_step5_regions
+from sglang.srt.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm, LayerNorm
+from sglang.srt.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    ReplicatedLinear,
+    ReplicatedParallelGroup,
+)
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import bf16_gemm_dispatch
+from sglang.srt.layers.rotary_embedding import get_rope
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec, get_lora, get_model
+from sglang.srt.utils import add_prefix
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def _cuda_fp8_saturates(device: torch.device) -> bool:
+    """Probe once per CUDA device before capture; Torch cast policy can differ."""
+    if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+        raise RuntimeError("Warm up the Step5 FP8 cast before CUDA graph capture")
+    bits = (
+        torch.tensor([1024.0], dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+        .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        .view(torch.uint8)
+        .item()
+    )
+    if bits not in (0x7E, 0x7F):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported Torch CUDA E4M3 overflow encoding: {bits}")
+    return bits == 0x7E
+
+
+class Step5Indexer(nn.Module):
+    """Provider-sharded Q/W, replicated K/Z, compression and region selection."""
+
+    fold_indexer_scale = False
+    fuse_indexer_fp8_cast = False
+    fp8_saturate = False
+    qkz_tokens = ()
+    use_cutedsl_qkz = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        layer_id: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        index_head_dim: int,
+        num_index_heads: int,
+        index_tp_size: int,
+        tp_rank: int,
+        tp_size: int,
+        rotary_dim: int,
+        rope_theta: float,
+        rope_scaling: dict,
+        max_position_embeddings: int,
+        eps: float,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_id = layer_id
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.index_head_dim = index_head_dim
+        self.provider_rank = tp_rank // (tp_size // index_tp_size)
+        self.num_heads = num_index_heads // index_tp_size
+        self.weight_scale = self.num_heads**-0.5
+        self.sparse_indexer_q = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=num_index_heads * index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            gather_output=False,
+            parallel_group=ReplicatedParallelGroup("attn_tp", tp_size // index_tp_size),
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=add_prefix("sparse_indexer_q", prefix),
+        )
+        self.sparse_indexer_k = ReplicatedLinear(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=add_prefix("sparse_indexer_k", prefix),
+        )
+        self.sparse_indexer_z = ReplicatedLinear(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=add_prefix("sparse_indexer_z", prefix),
+        )
+        self.sparse_indexer_w = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            input_size=hidden_size,
+            output_size=num_index_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            gather_output=False,
+            parallel_group=ReplicatedParallelGroup("attn_tp", tp_size // index_tp_size),
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=add_prefix("sparse_indexer_w", prefix),
+        )
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            head_size=index_head_dim,
+            rotary_dim=rotary_dim,
+            max_position=max_position_embeddings + get_step5_position_padding(),
+            base=rope_theta,
+            rope_scaling=rope_scaling,
+            is_neox_style=True,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            cache_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        weight = self.sparse_indexer_q.weight
+        use_b300_fusions = (
+            weight.is_cuda
+            and torch.version.hip is None
+            and torch.cuda.get_device_capability(weight.device) == (10, 3)
+            and weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and hidden_size == 4096
+            and index_head_dim == 256
+            and self.num_heads == 4
+            and tp_size in (4, 8)
+        )
+        self.register_buffer("qkz_weight", None, persistent=False)

+            use_b300_fusions
+            and get_exec().kernel.bf16_gemm_backend in ("auto", "torch")
+            and not get_exec().deterministic.enable_deterministic_inference
+            and not get_lora().enable_lora
+            and get_model().weight_cache_mode == "off"
+            and get_model().load_format
+            in ("auto", "pt", "safetensors", "npcache", "dummy")
+            and get_exec().offload.cpu_offload_gb == 0
+            and get_exec().offload.offload_group_size <= 0
+        ):
+            self.use_cutedsl_qkz = tp_size == 4
+            self.qkz_tokens = (
+                (4, 256)
+                if tp_size == 8 or get_exec().kernel.bf16_gemm_backend == "auto"
+                else (256,)
+            )
+            self.qkz_weight = torch.empty(
+                1536, hidden_size, dtype=weight.dtype, device=weight.device
+            )
+            # Preserve the parameter objects/loaders, including provider sharding.
+            # Their disjoint views also receive dummy initialization and direct
+            # in-place weight updates, without a stale packed copy in graphs.
+            offset = 0
+            for projection in (
+                self.sparse_indexer_q,
+                self.sparse_indexer_k,
+                self.sparse_indexer_z,
+            ):
+                rows = projection.weight.shape[0]
+                projection.weight.data = self.qkz_weight[offset : offset + rows]
+                offset += rows
+        # Keep existing explicit overrides; the measured B300 shape needs none.
+        self.fold_indexer_scale = (
+            # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_FOLD_INDEXER_SCALE; prune dead paths.
+            step5_options.FOLD_INDEXER_SCALE
+            if step5_options.FOLD_INDEXER_SCALE is not None
+            else use_b300_fusions
+        )
+        self.fuse_indexer_fp8_cast = (
+            # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_FUSE_INDEXER_FP8_CAST; prune dead paths.
+            step5_options.FUSE_INDEXER_FP8_CAST
+            if step5_options.FUSE_INDEXER_FP8_CAST is not None
+            else use_b300_fusions
+        )
+        self.fp8_saturate = (
+            _cuda_fp8_saturates(weight.device)
+            if self.fuse_indexer_fp8_cast and weight.is_cuda
+            else False
+        )
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.sparse_indexer_q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(
+            index_head_dim, eps=eps, weight_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        self.sparse_indexer_k_norm = LayerNorm(
+            index_head_dim, eps=eps, dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse=True):
+        super()._apply(fn, recurse=recurse)
+        if self.qkz_weight is not None:
+            offset = 0
+            for projection in (
+                self.sparse_indexer_q,
+                self.sparse_indexer_k,
+                self.sparse_indexer_z,
+            ):
+                weight = projection.weight
+                if weight.data_ptr() != self.qkz_weight[offset].data_ptr():
+                    # Module transforms can replace each parameter separately.
+                    # Use the original projections once their storage diverges.
+                    self.qkz_weight = None
+                    break

+    def _project_weights(self, hidden_states):
+        tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        weight_projection = self.sparse_indexer_w
+        if (
+            self.use_cutedsl_qkz
+            and self.qkz_weight is not None
+            and tokens == 4
+            and hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and hidden_states.is_contiguous()
+            and hidden_states.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+            and weight_projection.weight.is_contiguous()
+            and weight_projection.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and weight_projection.weight.data_ptr() % 32 == 0
+            and get_exec().kernel.bf16_gemm_backend == "auto"
+            and not weight_projection._forward_hooks
+            and not weight_projection._forward_pre_hooks

+                hidden_states, weight_projection.weight, max_m=4, n_split=1
+            )

+            index_weights, _ = weight_projection(hidden_states)
+        return index_weights
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        metadata: Step5IndexerMetadata,
+        *,
+        weights_first: bool = False,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]

+"""Step5 per-forward metadata. Persistent cache storage belongs to the KV pool."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import msgspec
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+
+STEP5_SCORE_WORKSPACE_ELEMENTS = 128 * 1024 * 1024
+
+
+def selection_tile_rows(rows: int, score_width: int) -> int:
+    """Query rows per DSA selection tile: the FP32 score tile stays within the budget;
+    step5_options.SELECTION_TILE_ROWS adds a fixed cap (0 = none)."""
+    tile = min(int(rows), STEP5_SCORE_WORKSPACE_ELEMENTS // max(int(score_width), 1))
+    # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_SELECTION_TILE_ROWS; prune dead paths.
+    cap = step5_options.SELECTION_TILE_ROWS
+    if cap < 0:
+        raise ValueError("step5_options.SELECTION_TILE_ROWS must be nonnegative")
+    if cap > 0:
+        tile = min(tile, cap)
+    return tile
+
+
+def query_group_spans(lengths, query_group: int):
+    """Query-group starts and ends in packed-token rows, plus the len(lengths) + 1
+    request boundaries; all int64, in per-request order."""
+    lengths = np.asarray(lengths, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
+    boundaries = np.zeros(lengths.size + 1, dtype=np.int64)
+    np.cumsum(lengths, out=boundaries[1:])
+    groups = (lengths + query_group - 1) // query_group
+    request = np.repeat(np.arange(lengths.size), groups)
+    first = np.repeat(np.cumsum(groups) - groups, groups)
+    offsets = (np.arange(int(groups.sum())) - first) * query_group
+    starts = boundaries[request] + offsets
+    ends = np.minimum(starts + query_group, boundaries[request + 1])
+    return starts, ends, boundaries
+
+
+class Step5PrefillWorkspace(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Per-layer union/bitset scratch; only allocated for the prefill kernel.
+
+    Query rows hold selected logical/physical regions; group rows hold their
+    union and membership. The union builder initializes the buffers it reads
+    each layer. Addresses are local to one forward, never shared globally.
+    """
+
+    logical_starts: torch.Tensor
+    physical_regions: torch.Tensor
+    union_physical: torch.Tensor
+    union_logical: torch.Tensor
+    membership: torch.Tensor
+    union_counts: torch.Tensor
+    bitset: torch.Tensor
+    sm100_block_counts: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    sm100_block_indices: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    sm100_full_block_counts: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    sm100_region_words: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    sm100_token_limits: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+
+class Step5SelectionWorkspace(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Per-layer scoring/selection outputs, not immutable query layout.
+
+    packed/counts/lengths have one row per query (lengths are causal KV lengths).
+    region_scores/ids are bounded tile scratch; tiles/use_cute are shape/device
+    policy. Selection writes each consumed range before attention reads it.
+    """
+
+    packed: torch.Tensor
+    counts: torch.Tensor
+    lengths: torch.Tensor
+    region_scores: torch.Tensor
+    ids: torch.Tensor | None  # portable selector only; SM10x packs directly
+    tiles: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
+    use_cute: bool
+    scoring_workspace: object | None = None
+    scoring_metadata_ready: bool = False
+    use_deepselect: bool = False
+    topk_lengths: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    topk_lengths_ready: bool = False
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    prefill_scoring: dict | None = None
+
+
+class Step5IndexerMetadata(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Complete indexer metadata, assembled before entering decoder layers.
+
+    R = compression request rows, Q = packed query/token rows, G = maximum
+    completed regions per request. Plans/validity are computed once per forward
+    (or by captured GPU operations on replay); scratch is rewritten per layer.
+    K/Z rings, position tags and completed compressed keys belong to the KV pool.
+    """
+
+    # Borrowed references; storage and lifetime remain owned by the pools.
+    token_to_kv_pool: object
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor
+
+    # Compression access plan. Request rows need not equal query rows: verify
+    # packs multiple tokens per request, while prefill has variable input lengths.
+    request_slots: torch.Tensor  # [R], request-pool row, zero means padding
+    input_start_positions: torch.Tensor  # [R], absolute logical token position
+    input_start_rows: torch.Tensor  # [R], offset into this forward's packed K/Z
+    input_lengths: torch.Tensor  # [R], number of input K/Z rows for the request
+    # [G, R], flattened compressed-key address, NOT a physical KV page number.
+    # Ordinal g names region floor(input_start_positions / 8) + g. Incomplete
+    # destinations are unused; consumers test the region's causal completion.
+    compressed_key_write_indices: torch.Tensor
+    num_input_tokens: int  # capacity of this forward's packed K/Z, including padding
+
+    # Input validity, immutable across layers. Padding is inactive regardless
+    # of length. Mapping validity covers native slot bounds/duplicate ownership,
+    # logical spans and FULL mappings; it does not validate layer-local ring tags.
+    request_active: torch.Tensor  # bool [R], live request row, excluding slot 0
+    request_mapping_valid: torch.Tensor  # bool [R], admission from input checks
+    request_count_valid: torch.Tensor  # bool [1], live count fits request capacity
+
+    # Query/scoring layout, complete at construction (no later replace/binding).
+    query_request_slots: torch.Tensor  # [Q], request slot for each query
+    query_positions: torch.Tensor  # [Q], absolute logical query positions
+    score_width: int  # maximum logical region count to score per query
+    score_group_rows: int  # rows sharing a scoring tile; does not change causality
+
+    # Per-layer scratch, owned by this eager forward or captured graph bucket.
+    # _admit overwrites BOTH bool buffers for every request row, including padding,
+    # before compression/ring writes. Do not cache these as input validity: ring
+    # tags differ by layer. Padding succeeds without enabling any write.
+    compression_enabled: torch.Tensor  # bool [R], input AND layer-ring admission
+    compression_success: torch.Tensor  # bool [R], success (including inert padding)
+    selection_workspace: Step5SelectionWorkspace
+
+
+class Step5AttentionMetadata(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Attention layout and scratch owned by one eager forward or graph bucket.
+
+    Tensor contents can be updated on the owning model stream. Overlapping
+    forwards must have separate objects and storage; none of this is global.
+    """
+
+    indexer_metadata: Step5IndexerMetadata
+    # Layout: packed query boundaries, separate from request-pool slot indices.
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor  # [request rows + 1], cumulative query counts
+    group_start: torch.Tensor  # [groups], first query row (prefill/verify)
+    group_end: torch.Tensor  # [groups], exclusive last query row
+    region_bins: int  # power-of-two logical region capacity for union bitsets
+    # Kernel family: target verification also uses per-row sparse decode.
+    decode: bool
+    valid_rows: torch.Tensor  # int32 [1], live QUERY rows, not request count
+    # Shape/device-derived split schedule, fixed for this metadata's query layout.
+    decode_dynamic_splits: bool  # one request, runtime split count from selection
+    decode_split4_rows: int  # leading query rows assigned four partials (static)
+    decode_split2_rows: int  # following query rows assigned two partials (static)
+    decode_work_rows: int  # total partial-output rows (dynamic: 16 * query rows)
+    # Per-layer execution scratch; the selected attention kernel/merge overwrites
+    # its consumed range before the next reader. Storage follows this metadata.
+    lse: (
+        torch.Tensor | None
+    )  # FP32 [query rows, query heads]; unused by candidate prefill
+    partial: torch.Tensor | None
+    partial_lse: torch.Tensor | None
+    prefill: Step5PrefillWorkspace | None

+"""Bound score workspace while retaining the native per-row selection contract."""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5 import options as step5_options
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring import (
+    can_use_step5_scoring_cute,
+    step5_paged_scores,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring_prefill import (
+    build_step5_prefill_scoring_plan,
+    can_use_step5_scoring_prefill,
+    step5_prefill_scores,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection import (
+    can_use_step5_selection_cute,
+    step5_select_regions,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_deepselect import (
+    STEP5_HISTORY_REGIONS,
+    can_use_step5_selection_deepselect,
+    deepselect_score_width,
+    step5_select_regions_deepselect,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.sparse_metadata import step5_pack_decode_regions
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.step5.metadata import (
+    STEP5_SCORE_WORKSPACE_ELEMENTS,
+    Step5SelectionWorkspace,
+    selection_tile_rows,
+)
+
+
+def allocate_selection_workspace(
+    *,
+    rows,
+    score_width,
+    score_group_rows,
+    device,
+    prefill=False,
+    max_score_width=None,
+    prefill_spans=None,
+    req_to_token=None,
+    row_to_req=None,
+    positions=None,
+):
+    """Per-forward scratch shared by sequential DSA layers on the model stream.
+
+    Selection/attention consume it before the next layer overwrites it. Each
+    eager forward owns its own tensors; graph capture gives each bucket fixed
+    addresses. It is not a global buffer shared with overlapping forwards.
+    """
+    if rows < 0 or not 1 <= score_width <= STEP5_SCORE_WORKSPACE_ELEMENTS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 requires nonnegative rows and a score row fitting its workspace budget"
+        )
+    use_deepselect = False
+    if (
+        # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_TOPK_DEEPSELECT_DECODE; prune dead paths.
+        (prefill or step5_options.TOPK_DEEPSELECT_DECODE)
+        and score_width > STEP5_HISTORY_REGIONS
+        and can_use_step5_selection_deepselect(torch.device(device))
+    ):
+        padded = deepselect_score_width(score_width)
+        if max_score_width is None or padded <= deepselect_score_width(max_score_width):
+            score_width, use_deepselect = padded, True
+    # 512 MiB FP32 score budget, independent of packed prefill length.
+    capacity = selection_tile_rows(rows=rows, score_width=score_width)
+    if score_group_rows > 1 and capacity:
+        capacity -= capacity % score_group_rows
+    if rows > 0 and capacity == 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 selection tile cannot fit one score group: "
+            f"rows={rows}, score_group_rows={score_group_rows}, "
+            f"score_width={score_width}. Check "
+            "step5_options.SELECTION_TILE_ROWS and the score workspace budget."
+        )
+    prefill_scoring = None
+    if use_deepselect and prefill_spans is not None and req_to_token is not None:
+        prefill_scoring = dict(spans=prefill_spans, req_to_token=req_to_token)
+    score_rows = (capacity + 63) // 64 * 64 + 64 if prefill_scoring else capacity
+    region_scores = torch.empty(
+        (score_rows, score_width), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+    )
+    use_cute = can_use_step5_selection_cute(region_scores)
+    topk_lengths, topk_lengths_ready = None, False
+    if use_deepselect:
+        topk_lengths = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        if row_to_req is not None and positions is not None:
+            topk_lengths.copy_(torch.where(row_to_req > 0, positions // 8, 0))
+            topk_lengths_ready = True
+    scoring_workspace = None
+    scoring_metadata_ready = False
+    if capacity and can_use_step5_scoring_cute(region_scores.device):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring_cute import (
+            allocate_scoring_workspace,
+            prepare_scoring,
+        )
+
+        scoring_workspace = allocate_scoring_workspace(
+            capacity, score_width, score_group_rows, region_scores.device
+        )
+        # Metadata is computed in the forward graph, hence refreshed on replay.
+        # Prefill/tiled/CLEAR_FUTURE paths retain the original implementation.
+        if (
+            # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_OPT_STEP5_INDEXER_NORM_PACKED; prune dead paths.
+            step5_options.INDEXER_NORM_PACKED
+            and not prefill
+            and use_cute
+            and rows == capacity
+            and req_to_token is not None
+            and row_to_req is not None
+            and positions is not None
+        ):
+            prepare_scoring(scoring_workspace, req_to_token, row_to_req, positions)
+            scoring_metadata_ready = True
+    return Step5SelectionWorkspace(
+        packed=torch.empty((rows, 513), dtype=torch.int64, device=device),
+        counts=torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        lengths=torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        region_scores=region_scores,
+        use_cute=use_cute,
+        scoring_workspace=scoring_workspace,
+        scoring_metadata_ready=scoring_metadata_ready,
+        ids=(
+            None
+            if use_cute and not use_deepselect
+            else torch.empty((capacity, 513), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        ),
+        use_deepselect=use_deepselect,
+        prefill_scoring=prefill_scoring,
+        topk_lengths=topk_lengths,
+        topk_lengths_ready=topk_lengths_ready,
+        topk_ids=(
+            torch.empty(
+                (capacity, STEP5_HISTORY_REGIONS), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+            )
+            if use_deepselect
+            else None
+        ),
+        tiles=tuple(
+            (start, min(start + capacity, rows))
+            for start in range(0, rows, capacity or 1)
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def select_step5_regions(
+    *,
+    index_q: torch.Tensor,
+    index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    compressed_index_keys: torch.Tensor,
+    req_to_token: torch.Tensor,
+    row_to_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    score_width: int,
+    score_group_rows: int = 1,
+    scoring_weight_scale: float | None = None,
+    packed_qw_ready: bool = False,
+    workspace: Step5SelectionWorkspace | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Return packed region IDs, counts and lengths without owning request state.
+
+    CSA publication precedes this call. Every row sees the same completed
+    compressed_index_keys and causal position as the untiled path. Slicing only query rows
+    keeps request IDs, logical regions and subsequent prefill groups unchanged.
+    Scratch is reused on the caller's stream; Graph loops depend on shapes only.
+    """
+    if workspace is None:
+        # Standalone kernel callers may allocate their own one-call workspace.
+        workspace = allocate_selection_workspace(
+            rows=index_q.shape[0],
+            score_width=score_width,
+            score_group_rows=score_group_rows,
+            device=index_q.device,
+            row_to_req=row_to_req,
+            positions=positions,
+        )
+    packed, counts, lengths = workspace.packed, workspace.counts, workspace.lengths
+    region_scores, ids = workspace.region_scores, workspace.ids
+    plan = _prefill_scoring_plan(workspace, index_q)
+    if packed_qw_ready and (
+        not workspace.scoring_metadata_ready
+        or not workspace.use_cute
+        or len(workspace.tiles) != 1
+        or plan is not None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Packed Q/W requires prepared single-tile decode scoring")
+    for tile_index, (start, end) in enumerate(workspace.tiles):
+        tile_scores = region_scores[: end - start]
+        if packed_qw_ready:
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.scoring_cute import (
+                launch_prepared_scoring,
+            )
+
+            launch_prepared_scoring(
+                compressed_index_keys,
+                tile_scores,
+                workspace.scoring_workspace,
+                end - start,
+            )
+        elif plan is not None:
+            step5_prefill_scores(
+                index_q[start:end],
+                index_weights[start:end],
+                compressed_index_keys=compressed_index_keys,
+                tile=plan.tiles[tile_index],
+                plan=plan,
+                out=region_scores,
+                weight_scale=scoring_weight_scale,
+            )
+        else:
+            step5_paged_scores(
+                index_q[start:end],
+                index_weights[start:end],
+                compressed_index_keys=compressed_index_keys,
+                req_to_token=req_to_token,
+                row_to_req=row_to_req[start:end],
+                positions=positions[start:end],
+                out=tile_scores,
+                clear_future=not workspace.use_cute,
+                group_rows=score_group_rows,
+                workspace=workspace.scoring_workspace,
+                weight_scale=scoring_weight_scale,
+            )
+        if workspace.use_deepselect:
+            step5_select_regions_deepselect(
+                tile_scores,
+                positions[start:end],
+                row_to_req[start:end],
+                packed[start:end],
+                counts[start:end],
+                req_to_token=req_to_token,
+                causal_lengths=lengths[start:end],
+                history_lengths=workspace.topk_lengths[start:end],
+                topk_ids=workspace.topk_ids[: end - start],
+                region_ids=ids[: end - start],
+                history_ready=workspace.topk_lengths_ready,
+            )
+        elif workspace.use_cute:
+            from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.selection_cute import (
+                step5_select_regions_cute,
+            )
+
+            step5_select_regions_cute(
+                tile_scores,
+                positions[start:end],
+                row_to_req[start:end],
+                packed[start:end],
+                counts[start:end],
+                req_to_token=req_to_token,
+                causal_lengths=lengths[start:end],
+            )
+        else:
+            tile_ids = ids[: end - start]
+            step5_select_regions(
+                tile_scores,
+                positions=positions[start:end],
+                row_to_req=row_to_req[start:end],
+                region_ids=tile_ids,
+                use_cute=workspace.use_cute,
+                counts=counts[start:end],
+            )
+            step5_pack_decode_regions(
+                tile_ids,
+                counts[start:end],
+                req_to_token=req_to_token,
+                row_to_req=row_to_req[start:end],

+def _build_prefill_request_spans(fb: ForwardBatch):
+    if fb.forward_mode not in (

+        raise ValueError("Step5 eager extend requires native CPU packed spans")
+    prefixes = list(fb.extend_prefix_lens_cpu)
+    lengths = list(fb.extend_seq_lens_cpu)
+    if not (len(prefixes) == len(lengths) == fb.batch_size):
+        raise ValueError("Step5 native request/token batch dimensions differ")

+    if tokens != padded_tokens:
+        # Native DP pads token arrays to attention-TP alignment without adding

+    CustomAllReduceV2,
+)
+from sglang.srt.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    get_attn_tp_group,
+    get_moe_ep_group,
+    get_moe_tp_group,
+    in_the_same_node_as,
+)

+    FlashInferWorkspaceManager,

+    FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput,

+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec, get_parallel, max_decode_batch_tokens
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _get_comm() -> Optional[CustomAllReduceV2]:
+    parallel = get_parallel()
+    backend = resolve_flashinfer_allreduce_fusion_backend()
+    topology = (parallel.tp_size, parallel.attn_tp_size, parallel.moe_ep_size)
+    a2a_backend = get_moe_a2a_backend()
+    supported = (
+        (((4, 4, 4), "trtllm"),)
+        if a2a_backend.is_megamoe()
+        else (((8, 8, 8), "mnnvl"), ((4, 4, 1), "trtllm"))
+    )
+    if (
+        torch.version.hip is not None
+        or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 3)
+        or (topology, backend) not in supported
+        or parallel.attn_dp_size != 1
+        or parallel.pp_size != 1
+        or get_exec().comm.enable_symm_mem
+        or not (a2a_backend.is_none() or a2a_backend.is_megamoe())
+    ):
+        return None
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    moe_group = get_moe_ep_group() if parallel.moe_ep_size > 1 else get_moe_tp_group()
+    if (
+        not isinstance(group.ca_comm, CustomAllReduceV2)
+        or group.ca_comm.disabled
+        or not group.ca_comm.has_multicast
+        or group.ranks != get_attn_tp_group().ranks
+        or group.ranks != moe_group.ranks
+        or not all(in_the_same_node_as(group.cpu_group, source_rank=0))
+    ):
+        return None
+    # Keep phase counters separate from ordinary all-reduce. Only the small
+    # decode/verify path uses this fusion; larger batches retain their backend.
+    max_rows = 32 if parallel.tp_size == 4 else 4
+    comm = CustomAllReduceV2(
+        group.cpu_group,
+        torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device()),
+        max_push_size=max_rows * 4096 * 2,
+        max_push_blocks=max_rows,
+        max_pull_size=0,
+    )
+    if comm.disabled or not comm.has_multicast:
+        return None
+    all_reduce_fusion.register_comm(comm.obj)
+    return comm
+
+
+def _verify_workspace_rows() -> int:
+    return min(max_decode_batch_tokens(), FUSE_ALLREDUCE_MAX_BATCH_SIZE)
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _get_verify_workspace():
+    comm = _get_comm()
+    if comm is None or comm.world_size != 4:
+        return None
+
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    # The package version alone does not identify the RMSNorm arithmetic fix.
+    try:
+        from flashinfer.jit.comm import gen_trtllm_mnnvl_comm_module
+
+        module = gen_trtllm_mnnvl_comm_module().build_and_load()
+        version = getattr(module, "step5_tp4_rmsnorm_order_version", None)
+        supported = version is not None and version() == 2
+    except (ImportError, AttributeError, RuntimeError):
+        supported = False
+    ready = torch.tensor(int(supported), dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu")
+    dist.all_reduce(ready, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group)
+    if not ready.item():
+        return None
+
+    manager = FlashInferWorkspaceManager()
+    manager.initialize(
+        world_size=4,
+        rank=group.rank_in_group,
+        max_token_num=_verify_workspace_rows(),
+        hidden_dim=4096,
+        backend="mnnvl",
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        use_oneshot=True,
+        device_group=group.device_group,
+        cpu_group=group.cpu_group,
+    )
+    ready.fill_(int(manager.initialized))
+    dist.all_reduce(ready, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group)
+    if not ready.item():
+        manager.cleanup()

+    return manager

+def get_step5_ring_capacity(max_verify_width: int, compression_ratio: int = 8) -> int:
+    """Retain R-1 history inputs and every candidate, rounded to complete regions.
+
+    max_verify_width includes the initial target input; use 1 without speculation.
+    Writing p aliases p-C < floor(base/R)*R for all candidates in this capacity.
+    """
+    if max_verify_width < 1:
+        raise ValueError("maximum verify input width must be positive")
+    required = compression_ratio - 1 + max_verify_width
+    return ((required + compression_ratio - 1) // compression_ratio) * compression_ratio
+

+class Step5Fp8FullKVPool(MHATokenToKVPool):
+    def _create_buffers(self):
+        if self.post_capture_active or self.use_hnd or self.head_num != 1:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 FP8 FULL KV requires eager NHD storage with one KV head"
+            )
+        with (
+            self.memory_saver_adapter.region(GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE),
+            (
+                torch.cuda.use_mem_pool(self.custom_mem_pool)
+                if self.enable_custom_mem_pool
+                else nullcontext()
+            ),
+        ):
+            slots = self.size + self.page_size
+            self.store_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            self.k_buffer = [
+                torch.zeros(
+                    (slots, self.head_num, self.head_dim),
+                    dtype=self.store_dtype,
+                    device=self.device,
+                )
+                for _ in range(self.layer_num)
+            ]
+            self.v_buffer = [
+                torch.zeros(
+                    (slots, self.head_num, self.v_head_dim),
+                    dtype=self.store_dtype,
+                    device=self.device,
+                )
+                for _ in range(self.layer_num)
+            ]
+            self.k_scale_buffer = [
+                torch.ones(
+                    (slots, self.head_num), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device
+                )
+                for _ in range(self.layer_num)
+            ]
+            self.v_scale_buffer = [
+                torch.ones(
+                    (slots, self.head_num), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device
+                )
+                for _ in range(self.layer_num)
+            ]
+        self.dq_k_buffer = None
+        self.dq_v_buffer = None
+        self._kv_buffer_descs = self._build_kv_buffer_descs()
+        self._init_data_ptrs_and_strides()
+
+    def _get_key_buffer(self, layer_id: int):
+        return self.k_buffer[layer_id - self.start_layer]
+
+    def _get_value_buffer(self, layer_id: int):
+        return self.v_buffer[layer_id - self.start_layer]
+
+    def get_kv_scale_buffer(self, layer_id: int):
+        index = layer_id - self.start_layer
+        return self.k_scale_buffer[index], self.v_scale_buffer[index]
+
+    def set_kv_buffer(
+        self,
+        layer,
+        loc_info,
+        cache_k,
+        cache_v,
+        k_scale=None,
+        v_scale=None,
+        layer_id_override=None,
+        dcp_kv_mask=None,
+    ):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.step5.fp8_kv import step5_fp8_kv_store
+
+        if dcp_kv_mask is not None:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step5 FP8 FULL KV does not support DCP")
+        loc, _, _ = unwrap_write_loc(loc_info)
+        layer_id = (
+            layer_id_override if layer_id_override is not None else layer.layer_id
+        )
+        index = layer_id - self.start_layer
+        step5_fp8_kv_store(
+            cache_k,
+            cache_v,
+            loc,
+            self.k_buffer[index],
+            self.v_buffer[index],
+            self.k_scale_buffer[index],
+            self.v_scale_buffer[index],
+        )
+
+    def get_cpu_copy(self, indices, mamba_indices=None, req_pool_index=None):
+        return [
+            [
+                tensor[indices].to("cpu", copy=True)
+                for tensor in (
+                    self.k_buffer[i],
+                    self.v_buffer[i],
+                    self.k_scale_buffer[i],
+                    self.v_scale_buffer[i],
+                )
+            ]
+            for i in range(self.layer_num)
+        ]
+
+    def load_cpu_copy(
+        self, kv_cache_cpu, indices, mamba_indices=None, req_pool_index=None
+    ):
+        for i, saved in enumerate(kv_cache_cpu):
+            for tensor, value in zip(
+                (
+                    self.k_buffer[i],
+                    self.v_buffer[i],
+                    self.k_scale_buffer[i],
+                    self.v_scale_buffer[i],
+                ),
+                saved,
+            ):
+                tensor[indices] = value.to(tensor.device)
+        if torch.device(self.device).type == "cuda":
+            torch.cuda.synchronize(self.device)
+
+    def get_kv_scale_buf_infos(self):
+        tensors = self.k_scale_buffer + self.v_scale_buffer
+        return (
+            [tensor.data_ptr() for tensor in tensors],
+            [tensor.nbytes for tensor in tensors],
+            [tensor[0].nbytes * self.page_size for tensor in tensors],
+        )
+
+
+def _require_outside_capture(device: torch.device) -> None:
+    if device.type == "cuda":
+        with torch.cuda.device(device):
+            if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "Step5 DSA storage construction/reset is outside capture only"
+                )
