+class Step5TokenToKVPool(SWAKVPool):
+    """Target-only indexer cache with explicit page and request ownership.
+
+    Compressed index keys follow FULL physical pages. Raw K/Z rings are
+    request-owned, with layer-major backing tensors and per-layer lists that alias the same storage.
+
+    The caller supplies the actual request-pool capacity, including padding
+    slot zero and any PD preallocation slots. Existing backend, HiCache and PD
+    consumers can use the same tensor views and buffer ordering. Draft SWA and
+    MTP input history remain separately owned.
+
+    Memory-saver requires a drained reset before KV pause and after resume,
+    before request admission: KV-tag storage has no CPU backup. Reset must not
+    write unmapped storage, and callers own cross-stream ordering.
+    """
+
+    def get_cpu_copy(self, indices, mamba_indices=None, req_pool_index=None):
+        if req_pool_index is None or not 0 < req_pool_index < self.num_req_slots:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 retraction requires a live request slot")
+        cpu_copy = super().get_cpu_copy(indices, mamba_indices, req_pool_index)
+        # Physical region indices preserve logical token order across page remapping.
+        regions = torch.unique_consecutive(indices // self.compression_ratio)
+        keys = self.compressed_index_key_buffer.flatten(1, 2)
+        cpu_copy["compressed_index_keys"] = keys[:, regions].to("cpu", copy=True)
+        cpu_copy["index_key_ring"] = self.index_key_ring[:, req_pool_index].to(
+            "cpu", copy=True
+        )
+        cpu_copy["compression_logits_ring"] = self.compression_logits_ring[
+            :, req_pool_index
+        ].to("cpu", copy=True)
+        cpu_copy["index_positions"] = self.index_position_buffer[:, req_pool_index].to(
+            "cpu", copy=True
+        )
+        return cpu_copy
+
+    def load_cpu_copy(
+        self, kv_cache_cpu, indices, mamba_indices=None, req_pool_index=None
+    ):
+        if req_pool_index is None or not 0 < req_pool_index < self.num_req_slots:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 retraction requires a live request slot")
+        regions = torch.unique_consecutive(indices // self.compression_ratio)
+        if regions.numel() != kv_cache_cpu["compressed_index_keys"].shape[1]:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 retraction changed the compressed region layout")
+        super().load_cpu_copy(kv_cache_cpu, indices, mamba_indices, req_pool_index)
+        keys = self.compressed_index_key_buffer.flatten(1, 2)
+        keys[:, regions] = kv_cache_cpu["compressed_index_keys"].to(keys.device)
+        self.index_key_ring[:, req_pool_index].copy_(kv_cache_cpu["index_key_ring"])
+        self.compression_logits_ring[:, req_pool_index].copy_(
+            kv_cache_cpu["compression_logits_ring"]
+        )
+        # Publish validity only after restoring the corresponding raw inputs.
+        self.index_position_buffer[:, req_pool_index].copy_(
+            kv_cache_cpu["index_positions"]
+        )
+        if torch.device(self.device).type == "cuda":
+            torch.cuda.synchronize(self.device)
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        size: int,
+        size_swa: int,
+        page_size: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        head_num: int,
+        head_dim: int,
+        swa_attention_layer_ids: list[int],
+        full_attention_layer_ids: list[int],
+        device: str,
+        num_req_slots: int,
+        index_head_dim: int = 256,
+        compression_ratio: int = 8,
+        index_ring_size: int = 8,
+        enable_memory_saver: bool = False,
+        enable_kv_cache_copy: bool = False,
+        enable_alt_stream: bool = True,
+        kv_cache_layout: str | None = None,
+        token_to_kv_pool_class: type[MHATokenToKVPool] = MHATokenToKVPool,
+        post_capture_active: bool = False,
+        full_kv_fp8: bool = False,
+    ):
+        # Kernel layout constraints; engine configuration owns device, layer
+        # selection and int32 address-capacity validation.
+        if (page_size, compression_ratio, index_head_dim) != (64, 8, 256):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 indexer kernels require P64/R8/D256")
+        if size <= 0 or size % page_size:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 requires a positive, page-aligned capacity")
+        if num_req_slots < 2:
+            raise ValueError("num_req_slots must include padding and a usable slot")
+        if index_ring_size < compression_ratio or index_ring_size % compression_ratio:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 ring capacity must be a positive multiple of R8")
+        if dtype != torch.bfloat16 or post_capture_active:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 requires BF16 KV storage without post-capture allocation"
+            )
+        _require_outside_capture(torch.device(device))
+        # The parent constructor calls get_kv_size_bytes before allocating
+        # the indexer buffers. Recompute mem_usage after all allocations.
+        self.compressed_index_key_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self.index_key_ring: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self.compression_logits_ring: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self.index_position_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        super().__init__(
+            size=size,
+            size_swa=size_swa,
+            page_size=page_size,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            head_num=head_num,
+            head_dim=head_dim,
+            swa_attention_layer_ids=swa_attention_layer_ids,
+            full_attention_layer_ids=full_attention_layer_ids,
+            device=device,
+            enable_memory_saver=enable_memory_saver,
+            enable_kv_cache_copy=enable_kv_cache_copy,
+            enable_alt_stream=enable_alt_stream,
+            kv_cache_layout=kv_cache_layout,
+            token_to_kv_pool_class=token_to_kv_pool_class,
+            full_kv_pool_class=Step5Fp8FullKVPool if full_kv_fp8 else None,
+            post_capture_active=post_capture_active,
+        )
+        self.full_kv_fp8 = full_kv_fp8
+        self.dsa_layer_ids = tuple(full_attention_layer_ids)
+        self.full_num_pages = size // page_size + 1
+        self.num_req_slots = num_req_slots
+        self.index_head_dim = index_head_dim
+        self.compression_ratio = compression_ratio
+        self.index_ring_size = index_ring_size
+        request_shape = (self.full_layer_nums, self.num_req_slots)
+        ring_shape = (*request_shape, self.index_ring_size, 1, self.index_head_dim)
+
+        # Indexer buffers share the FULL KV pool's memory-saver and PD allocator.
+        pool = self.full_kv_pool
+        with (
+            pool.memory_saver_adapter.region(GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE),
+            (
+                torch.cuda.use_mem_pool(pool.custom_mem_pool)
+                if pool.enable_custom_mem_pool
+                else nullcontext()
+            ),
+        ):
+            self.compressed_index_key_buffer = torch.empty(
+                (
+                    self.full_layer_nums,
+                    self.full_num_pages,
+                    self.page_size // self.compression_ratio,
+                    1,
+                    self.index_head_dim,
+                ),
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+                device=pool.device,
+            )
+            # Pending index keys and compression logits for non-online R8,
+            # indexed by layer, request slot and absolute-position residue.
+            self.index_key_ring = torch.empty(
+                ring_shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=pool.device
+            )
+            # Z contains per-channel compression logits, not region scores.
+            self.compression_logits_ring = torch.empty(
+                ring_shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=pool.device
+            )
+            self.index_position_buffer = torch.empty(
+                (*request_shape, self.index_ring_size),
+                dtype=torch.int64,
+                device=pool.device,
+            )
+            self.reset_dsa_state()
+
+        # Cache layer aliases once; getters do not create views in the hot path.
+        self.compressed_index_key_buffer_pool = list(
+            self.compressed_index_key_buffer.unbind(0)
+        )
+        self.index_key_ring_pool = list(self.index_key_ring.unbind(0))
+        self.compression_logits_ring_pool = list(self.compression_logits_ring.unbind(0))
+        self.index_position_buffer_pool = list(self.index_position_buffer.unbind(0))
+        k_size, v_size = self.get_kv_size_bytes()
+        self.mem_usage = (k_size + v_size) / GB
+
+    def _transfer_full_attention_id(self, layer_id: int) -> int:
+        index, is_swa = self.layers_mapping[layer_id]
+        if is_swa:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 indexer state belongs to FULL attention layers")
+        self._wait_for_layer(layer_id)
+        return index
+
+    def get_compressed_index_key_buffer(self, layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.compressed_index_key_buffer_pool[
+            self._transfer_full_attention_id(layer_id)
+        ]
+
+    def get_index_key_ring(self, layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.index_key_ring_pool[self._transfer_full_attention_id(layer_id)]
+
+    def get_compression_logits_ring(self, layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.compression_logits_ring_pool[
+            self._transfer_full_attention_id(layer_id)
+        ]
+
+    def get_index_position_buffer(self, layer_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.index_position_buffer_pool[
+            self._transfer_full_attention_id(layer_id)
+        ]
+
+    def reset_dsa_state(self) -> None:
+        """Invalidate in place after a drained flush; never call during capture.
+
+        Only construction or an owner-proven drained flush may invoke this.
+        All readers' WAR dependencies must have completed before these writes,
+        and later readers must observe their stream ordering. CompressedIndexKeys/raw K/Z
+        bytes remain untouched; invalid position tags prohibit
+        their use. This is not page eviction or request-generation advancement.
+        """
+        _require_outside_capture(torch.device(self.device))
+        self.index_position_buffer.fill_(-1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get_state_buf_infos(tensors: list[torch.Tensor]):
+        """PD geometry: each layer tensor's first axis is a page or request slot."""
+        if not tensors or any(not tensor.is_contiguous() for tensor in tensors):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 PD state tensors must be nonempty and contiguous")
+        return (
+            [tensor.data_ptr() for tensor in tensors],
+            [tensor.nbytes for tensor in tensors],
+            [tensor[0].nbytes for tensor in tensors],
+        )
+
+    def get_compressed_index_key_buf_infos(self):
+        """Physical-page-indexed completed R8 compressed_index_keys for PD transfer."""
+        compressed_index_keys = self.compressed_index_key_buffer
+        return self._get_state_buf_infos(
+            [
+                compressed_index_keys[index]
+                for index in range(compressed_index_keys.shape[0])
+            ]
+        )
+
+    def get_committed_tail_buf_infos(self):
+        """Request-slot-indexed input ring and absolute-position validity tags."""
+        tensors = [
+            tensor[layer]
+            for layer in range(len(self.dsa_layer_ids))
+            for tensor in (
+                self.index_key_ring,
+                self.compression_logits_ring,
+                self.index_position_buffer,
+            )
+        ]
+        return self._get_state_buf_infos(tensors)
+
+    @property
+    def aux_state(self):
+        """Expose pool-owned DSA state through the existing PD interface."""
+        return self
+
+    def attach_aux_state(self, state) -> None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Step5 target state is owned by the pool constructor")
+
+    def get_pd_state_components(self):
+        """Page-owned compressed_index_keys first, then the request-slot-owned tail."""
+        components = (
+            ("step5_compressed_index_key", self.get_compressed_index_key_buf_infos()),
+        )
+        if self.full_kv_fp8:
+            components += (("block_scale", self.get_kv_scale_buf_infos()),)
+        return components + (("step5_dsa_tail", self.get_committed_tail_buf_infos()),)
+
+    def invalidate_pd_receive(self, request_slot: int) -> None:
+        """Invalidate a decode destination before publishing its remote address."""
+        if not 0 < request_slot < self.num_req_slots:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 PD destination request slot is out of range")
+        self.index_position_buffer[:, request_slot].fill_(-1)
+
+    def initialize_synthetic_pd_receive(
+        self, *, request_slot: int, frontier: int
+    ) -> None:
+        """Install a canonical synthetic tail for the fake PD transport only.
+
+        Decode startup warmup deliberately bypasses the prefill worker and does
+        not transfer state.  Step5 nevertheless executes a real decode graph,
+        so give that synthetic request valid local tail geometry.  Missing raw
+        K/Z values are zeroed; fake-transfer output is discarded and must never
+        be exposed as a real handoff.
+        """
+        if not 0 < request_slot < self.num_req_slots or not 0 <= frontier <= 1048576:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 synthetic PD destination is out of range")
+        self.invalidate_pd_receive(request_slot)
+        self.index_key_ring[:, request_slot].zero_()
+        self.compression_logits_ring[:, request_slot].zero_()
+        for position in range(frontier // 8 * 8, frontier):
+            self.index_position_buffer[
+                :, request_slot, position % self.index_ring_size
+            ] = position
+
+    def bind_pd_receive(
+        self, *, request_slot: int, generation: int, frontier: int
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Validate the common PD handoff coordinates; ring tags travel with K/Z."""
+        if (
+            not 0 < request_slot < self.num_req_slots
+            or not 0 < generation < 2**63
+            or not 0 <= frontier <= 1048576
+        ):
+            return False
+        return True
+
+    def get_kv_size_bytes(self):
+        k_bytes, v_bytes = super().get_kv_size_bytes()
+        k_bytes += sum(self.get_dsa_size_bytes().values())
+        return k_bytes, v_bytes
+
+    def get_dsa_size_bytes(self) -> dict[str, int]:
+        """Count backing buffers once; exclude layer aliases and workspaces."""
+        return {
+            "compressed_index_key_buffer": (
+                self.compressed_index_key_buffer.nbytes
+                if self.compressed_index_key_buffer is not None
+                else 0
+            ),
+            "index_ring": sum(
+                tensor.nbytes
+                for tensor in (
+                    self.index_key_ring,
+                    self.compression_logits_ring,
+                    self.index_position_buffer,
+                )
+                if tensor is not None
+            ),
+        }
+

+class _Step5SwaStrategy(_SwaStrategy):
+    """Native FULL/SWA stack plus the page-owned compressed index key sidecar."""
+
+    def matches(self, kvcache, components):
+        return isinstance(kvcache, Step5TokenToKVPool) and super().matches(
+            kvcache, components
+        )
+
+    def build(self, **kwargs):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, SidecarPoolSpec
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool_host import DeepSeekV4PagedHostPool
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.common import get_allocator_type
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_memory
+
+        memory = get_memory()
+        # The sidecar reuses a generic page-row host pool whose other
+        # layout/backend branches are not validated for Step5.
+        if (memory.hicache_mem_layout, memory.hicache_io_backend) != (
+            "page_first",
+            "kernel",
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Step5 DSA HiCache supports kernel/page_first only"
+            )
+        kv_pool = kwargs["kvcache"]
+        compressed_index_keys = kv_pool.compressed_index_key_buffer
+        # flatten() of a non-contiguous buffer returns a copy, which would
+        # detach the host pool from the live device pages.
+        if not compressed_index_keys.is_contiguous():
+            raise ValueError("Step5 compressed_index_keys must be contiguous")
+
+        result = super().build(**kwargs)
+        kv_host = result.host_pool_group.get_pool(PoolName.KV)
+        if kv_pool.page_size != kv_host.page_size:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 compressed_index_keys and FULL host page sizes must match"
+            )
+
+        def add_page_sidecar(name, page_rows):
+            host_pool = DeepSeekV4PagedHostPool(
+                pool_name=str(name),
+                device_buffers=page_rows,
+                item_bytes=page_rows[0].shape[-1],
+                num_host_pages=kv_host.page_num,
+                slot_page_size=kv_host.page_size,
+                layout=kv_host.layout,
+                device=kv_host.device,
+                pin_memory=kv_host.pin_memory,
+                allocator_type=get_allocator_type(),
+                page_aligned_only=True,
+            )
+            result.cache_controller.register_host_pool_entry(
+                build_pool_entry(
+                    name=name,
+                    host_pool=host_pool,
+                    device_pool=kv_pool,
+                    layer_mapping={
+                        global_id - kv_pool.start_layer: local_id
+                        for local_id, global_id in enumerate(kv_pool.dsa_layer_ids)
+                    },
+                    transfer_layer_id_max=result.cache_controller.transfer_layer_id_max,
+                )
+            )
+            result.sidecars.append(
+                SidecarPoolSpec(pool_name=name, indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV)
+            )
+
+        # One page row holds a FULL page's completed R8 keys for one DSA layer,
+        # so the sidecar moves whole rows at the FULL page number.
+        add_page_sidecar(
+            PoolName.STEP5_COMPRESSED_INDEX_KEY,
+            list(compressed_index_keys.flatten(2).unbind(0)),
+        )
+        result.pools_desc += " + Step5 compressed index keys"
+
+        full_kv_pool = kv_pool.full_kv_pool
+        if isinstance(full_kv_pool, Step5Fp8FullKVPool):
+            if memory.hicache_storage_backend is not None:
+                raise NotImplementedError(
+                    "Step5 FP8 FULL KV does not support HiCache storage backends"
+                )
+            for name, buffers in (
+                (PoolName.STEP5_FP8_K_SCALE, full_kv_pool.k_scale_buffer),
+                (PoolName.STEP5_FP8_V_SCALE, full_kv_pool.v_scale_buffer),

+_STEP5_INT32_MAX = (1 << 31) - 1

+_STEP5_INT64_MAX = (1 << 63) - 1

+_Step5Phase = Literal["profiled", "token_constrained"]

+def _step5_integer(name: str, value: int, minimum: int = 0) -> None:
+    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= _STEP5_INT64_MAX:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} must be an integer in [{minimum}, {_STEP5_INT64_MAX}]"
+        )
+
+
+def _step5_bytes(value: int) -> int:
+    if value > _STEP5_INT64_MAX:
+        raise OverflowError("Step5 KV byte accounting exceeds signed int64")
+    return value
+
+
+def _step5_capacity(name: str, value: int, page_size: int) -> None:
+    _step5_integer(name, value, 1)
+    if value % page_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain complete pages")
+    if value + page_size - 1 > _STEP5_INT32_MAX:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} including the dummy page exceeds int32 addresses")

+class Step5KVReservations(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True, kw_only=True):
+    """Mandatory additional bounds, disjoint from persistent payload/upstream.
+
+    Explicit zero is an assumption, not evidence of zero producer workspace.
+    Each bound must cover fixed B/row capacity and both pool capacity ceilings.
+    Constructor minimum checks below prove only known individual lower bounds;
+    the caller must still supply a bound for the complete constructor lifetime.
+    """
+
+    dsa_workspace_bytes: int
+    constructor_extra_bytes: int
+    allocator_runtime_extra_bytes: int
+    non_dsa_runtime_extra_bytes: int
+    allocation_rounding_extra_bytes: int
+    full_capacity_ceiling: int
+    swa_capacity_ceiling: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for name, value in (
+            ("dsa_workspace_bytes", self.dsa_workspace_bytes),
+            ("constructor_extra_bytes", self.constructor_extra_bytes),
+            ("allocator_runtime_extra_bytes", self.allocator_runtime_extra_bytes),
+            ("non_dsa_runtime_extra_bytes", self.non_dsa_runtime_extra_bytes),
+            ("allocation_rounding_extra_bytes", self.allocation_rounding_extra_bytes),
+        ):
+            _step5_integer(name, value)
+        _step5_capacity("full_capacity_ceiling", self.full_capacity_ceiling, 64)
+        _step5_capacity("swa_capacity_ceiling", self.swa_capacity_ceiling, 64)
+        # mapping cat overlaps its final storage with zeros + sentinel inputs.
+        # Each child clear may also overlap one old/new free-page array. These
+        # are necessary individual bounds, not a proved simultaneous peak.
+        minimum = max(
+            8 * (self.full_capacity_ceiling + 64 + 1),
+            8 * (self.full_capacity_ceiling // 64),
+            8 * (self.swa_capacity_ceiling // 64),
+        )
+        if self.constructor_extra_bytes < minimum:
+            raise ValueError("constructor reserve is below a known individual cost")
+        _step5_bytes(self.total_bytes)

+    @property
+    def total_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return (
+            self.dsa_workspace_bytes
+            + self.constructor_extra_bytes
+            + self.allocator_runtime_extra_bytes
+            + self.non_dsa_runtime_extra_bytes
+            + self.allocation_rounding_extra_bytes
+        )

+    """Native sizing policy including compressed index keys, raw ring and MTP buffer costs."""

+    def __init__(self, kvc):

+    def calculate_pool_sizes(self, available_bytes: int, page_size: int):

+        and long-context workspace qualification remain required before production.
+        This entry serves target operation with native device-cache owners and an
+        MTP with native device prefix caching and scheduler overlap. MTP uses eager
+        prefill and either eager or full-graph target verify and draft extend.
+        Overlap uses the scheduler's shared-read barrier: Step5 declares POST_REPLAY,
+        so shared mappings cannot be rewritten before the forward finishes reading.
+        The general Step5 solver retains the wider cache/MTP sizing contracts.
+        """
+
+        kvc, policy = self.kvc, self.capacity_policy
+        schedule = get_schedule()
+        page = kvc.page_size

+        upper = native.max_total_num_tokens

+        # concurrency. Reserve workspace for the upper bound; the solver prices
+        # request-owned buffers at each candidate's actual native concurrency.
+        requests = kvc.resolve_max_num_reqs(upper)

+        )

+                "disaggregation_decode_extra_slots",
+                get_disagg().disaggregation_decode_extra_slots,
+            ),
+            ("swa_eviction_interval", envs.SGLANG_SWA_EVICTION_INTERVAL.get()),
+            ("hnd_kvcache", envs.SGLANG_USE_HND_KVCACHE.get()),
+            ("step5_fp8_full_kv", _step5_full_kv_fp8()),
+            ("aiter_kv_cache_layout", envs.SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.get()),
+            ("swa_full_tokens_ratio", schedule.swa_full_tokens_ratio),
+        ) + Step5PoolConfigurator._parallel_inputs()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_runtime(
+        *, kvc: KVCacheConfigurator, config: Step5MemoryPoolConfig
+    ) -> None:
+        """Reject drift when either role consumes the target's frozen budget.
+
+        This validates construction inputs, not target geometry on a draft worker.
+        Target geometry is resolved once before byte accounting.
+        """
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+
+        if not isinstance(config, Step5MemoryPoolConfig):
+            raise ValueError("an explicit resolved Step5 KV budget is required")
+        if Step5PoolConfigurator._mode_inputs() != config.mode_inputs:
+            raise ValueError("runtime inputs differ from the resolved Step5 KV budget")
+        if kvc.spec_algorithm is not SpeculativeAlgorithm.from_string(
+            get_spec().speculative_algorithm
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "worker speculative algorithm differs from the Step5 KV budget"
+            )
+        Step5PoolConfigurator._validate_parallel_topology(kvc)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_parallel_topology(kvc: KVCacheConfigurator) -> None:
+        """The worker and runtime must agree on one supported topology."""
+
+        ps = get_parallel()
+        declared = (
+            ps.tp_size,
+            ps.moe_ep_size,
+            ps.attn_tp_size,
+            ps.pp_size,
+            ps.dp_size,
+            ps.attn_dp_size,
+            ps.attn_cp_size,
+            ps.attn_dcp_size,
+        )
+        actual = tuple(value for _, value in Step5PoolConfigurator._parallel_inputs())
+        for value in declared + actual:
+            _step5_integer("parallel dimension", value, 1)
+        if (
+            declared
+            not in (
+                (4, 1, 4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
+                (4, 4, 4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
+                (8, 8, 8, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1),
+                (8, 8, 4, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1),
+            )
+            or actual != declared
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "runtime parallel topology must match TP4/EP1, TP4/EP4, TP8/EP8, or "
+                "DP2/TP4/EP8 with PP1/CP1"
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_worker_profile(
+        kvc: KVCacheConfigurator,
+        max_running_requests: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import ModelConfig
+        from sglang.srt.configs.step5 import Step5Config
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.kv_cache_configurator import KVCacheConfigurator
+
+        if not isinstance(kvc, KVCacheConfigurator):
+            raise ValueError("a real target KVCacheConfigurator is required")
+        _step5_integer("max_running_requests", max_running_requests, 1)
+        if max_running_requests > _STEP5_INT32_MAX:
+            raise ValueError("request slot IDs exceed int32")
+        mc = kvc.model_config
+        if not isinstance(mc, ModelConfig) or not isinstance(
+            mc.hf_text_config, Step5Config
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("a resolved target Step5 ModelConfig is required")
+        hf = mc.hf_text_config
+        if mc.is_draft_model or hf.architectures != ["Step5ForCausalLM"]:
+            raise ValueError("a complete target Step5 ModelConfig is required")
+        Step5PoolConfigurator._validate_parallel_topology(kvc)
+        ps = get_parallel()
+        schedule, memory, spec = get_schedule(), get_memory(), get_spec()
+        if (
+            kvc.is_draft_worker
+            or kvc.post_capture_kv_active
+            or memory.enable_unified_memory
+            or memory.enable_page_major_kv_layout
+            or envs.SGLANG_USE_HND_KVCACHE.get()
+            or envs.SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT.get() != "nhd"
+            or spec.speculative_adaptive
+            or not kvc.is_hybrid_swa
+            or kvc.is_hybrid_swa_compress
+            or kvc.use_mla_backend
+            or kvc.mambaish_config is not None
+            or kvc.kv_cache_dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or kvc.kv_cache_dtype_str not in (None, "auto", "bf16", "bfloat16")
+            or kvc.model_dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or kvc.device not in ("cpu", "cuda")
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported Step5 target BF16 NHD sizing mode")
+        disagg = get_disagg()
+        pd_mtp_mode = (
+            spec.speculative_algorithm in ("EAGLE", "EAGLE3")
+            and spec.enable_multi_layer_eagle
+            and not spec.speculative_use_rejection_sampling
+            and (
+                spec.speculative_num_steps,
+                spec.speculative_eagle_topk,
+                spec.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+            )
+            == (3, 1, 4)
+        )
+        if (
+            _step5_full_kv_fp8()
+            and disagg.disaggregation_mode != "null"
+            and disagg.disaggregation_transfer_backend != "mooncake"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 FP8 FULL KV PD requires the mooncake backend")
+        if disagg.disaggregation_mode != "null" and (
+            disagg.disaggregation_transfer_backend not in ("mooncake", "nixl")
+            or (spec.speculative_algorithm is not None and not pd_mtp_mode)
+            or (
+                memory.enable_hierarchical_cache
+                and disagg.disaggregation_mode == "decode"
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported Step5 PD sizing mode")
+        if (
+            kvc.page_size != 64
+            or schedule.page_size != kvc.page_size
+            or (
+                schedule.max_running_requests is not None
+                and schedule.max_running_requests // ps.attn_dp_size
+                != max_running_requests
+            )
+            or kvc.sliding_window_size != 512
+            or hf.sliding_window != kvc.sliding_window_size
+            or (kvc.layer_info.start_layer, kvc.layer_info.end_layer) != (0, 92)
+            or kvc.layer_info.num_effective_layers != 92
+            or hf.num_hidden_layers != 92
+            or hf.num_nextn_predict_layers != 3
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 sizing requires explicit B, P64, W512 and all 92 layers"
+            )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve_geometry(kvc: KVCacheConfigurator) -> Step5KVGeometry:
+        from sglang.srt.configs.step5 import parse_step5_index_geometry
+
+        mc, ps = kvc.model_config, get_parallel()
+        hf = mc.hf_text_config
+        full, swa = (
+            tuple(mc.full_attention_layer_ids),
+            tuple(mc.swa_attention_layer_ids),
+        )
+        for layer_id in full + swa:
+            _step5_integer("resolved layer ID", layer_id)
+        if (
+            len(full) != 23
+            or len(swa) != 69
+            or len(set(full + swa)) != 92
+            or set(full + swa) != set(range(92))
+            or hf.layer_types_with_mtp is None
+            or len(hf.layer_types_with_mtp) != 95
+            or any(hf.layer_types_with_mtp[i] != "full_attention" for i in full)
+            or any(hf.layer_types_with_mtp[i] != "sliding_attention" for i in swa)
+            or hf.layer_types_with_mtp[92:] != ["sliding_attention"] * 3
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "invalid resolved target partition or three draft SWA layers"
+            )
+        heads = mc.get_num_kv_heads(ps.attn_tp_size, ps.attn_dcp_size)
+        for name, value in (
+            ("page size", kvc.page_size),
+            ("window", kvc.sliding_window_size),
+            ("model window", hf.sliding_window),
+            ("model target depth", hf.num_hidden_layers),
+            ("model MTP depth", hf.num_nextn_predict_layers),
+            ("model hidden size", hf.hidden_size),
+            ("local FULL KV heads", heads),
+            ("FULL K width", mc.head_dim),
+            ("FULL V width", mc.v_head_dim),
+            ("local SWA KV heads", mc.get_swa_num_kv_heads(ps.attn_tp_size)),
+            ("SWA K width", mc.swa_head_dim),
+            ("SWA V width", mc.swa_v_head_dim),
+        ):
+            _step5_integer(name, value, 1)
+        if (heads, mc.head_dim, mc.v_head_dim) != (1, 192, 192) or (
+            mc.get_swa_num_kv_heads(ps.attn_tp_size),
+            mc.swa_head_dim,
+            mc.swa_v_head_dim,
+        ) != (heads, mc.head_dim, mc.v_head_dim):
+            raise ValueError("unsupported resolved Step5 FULL/SWA KV geometry")
+        sparse = hf.sparse_config
+        if (
+            not isinstance(sparse, dict)
+            or sparse["enabled"] is not True
+            or sparse["apply_to_layer_types"] != ["full_attention"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("DSA layer IDs must equal the resolved target FULL IDs")
+        index = parse_step5_index_geometry(hf)
+        if kvc.page_size != 64:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 requires page64")
+        return Step5KVGeometry(
+            target_full_ids=full,
+            target_swa_ids=swa,
+            draft_swa_ids=(
+                tuple(
+                    range(
+                        hf.num_hidden_layers,
+                        hf.num_hidden_layers + hf.num_nextn_predict_layers,
+                    )
+                )
+                if not kvc.spec_algorithm.is_none()
+                else ()
+            ),
+            local_kv_heads=heads,
+            hidden_size=hf.hidden_size,
+            k_head_dim=mc.head_dim,
+            v_head_dim=mc.v_head_dim,
+            page_size=kvc.page_size,
+            region_size=index.region_size,
+            index_head_dim=index.index_head_dim,
+            index_k_heads=index.index_k_heads,
+            sliding_window=kvc.sliding_window_size,
+            full_kv_fp8=_step5_full_kv_fp8(),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve_requests(
+        kvc: KVCacheConfigurator,
+        max_running_requests: int,
+    ) -> Step5RequestCapacity:
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.allocation_sizing import (
+            get_req_to_token_extra_context_len,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+
+        spec, mc = get_spec(), kvc.model_config
+        algo = SpeculativeAlgorithm.from_string(spec.speculative_algorithm)
+        if algo is not kvc.spec_algorithm:
+            raise ValueError("resolved speculative algorithm disagrees with the worker")
+        if algo is SpeculativeAlgorithm.NONE:
+            if kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers is not None:
+                _step5_integer(
+                    "inactive MTP depth", kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers
+                )
+            if kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers not in (None, 0):
+                raise ValueError("MTP-off must not reserve active draft layers")
+            if any(
+                value is not None
+                for value in (
+                    spec.speculative_num_steps,
+                    spec.speculative_eagle_topk,
+                    spec.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+                )
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("MTP-off requires unset speculative sizing fields")
+            index_ring_size = 8
+        elif (
+            algo in (SpeculativeAlgorithm.EAGLE, SpeculativeAlgorithm.EAGLE3)
+            and (
+                spec.speculative_num_steps,
+                spec.speculative_eagle_topk,
+                spec.speculative_num_draft_tokens,
+            )
+            == (3, 1, 4)
+            and kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers == 3
+        ):
+            from sglang.srt.mem_cache.step5_kv_pool import get_step5_ring_capacity
+
+            index_ring_size = get_step5_ring_capacity(spec.speculative_num_draft_tokens)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "only MTP-off or fixed three-step/top1/four-row MTP is supported"
+            )
+        if not kvc.spec_algorithm.is_none():
+            for name, value in (
+                ("MTP steps", spec.speculative_num_steps),
+                ("MTP topk", spec.speculative_eagle_topk),
+                ("MTP tokens", spec.speculative_num_draft_tokens),
+                ("MTP layers", kvc.spec_aux_config.eagle_draft_num_layers),
+            ):
+                _step5_integer(name, value, 1)
+        _step5_integer("context_len", mc.context_len, 1)
+        if mc.context_len > 1 << 20:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 payload profile supports context length up to 1M")
+        extra = get_req_to_token_extra_context_len()
+        _step5_integer("request extra context", extra)
+        row = mc.context_len + extra
+        if row > _STEP5_INT32_MAX:
+            raise ValueError("request row capacity exceeds int32")
+        return Step5RequestCapacity(
+            max_running_requests=max_running_requests,
+            context_len=mc.context_len,
+            extra_context_len=extra,
+            index_ring_size=index_ring_size,
+            extra_slots=(
+                int(get_disagg().disaggregation_decode_extra_slots or 0)
+                if get_disagg().disaggregation_mode == "decode"
+                else 0
+            ),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve(
+        kvc: KVCacheConfigurator,
+        max_running_requests: int,
+    ) -> tuple[Step5KVGeometry, Step5RequestCapacity, _Step5ModeInputs]:
+        mode = Step5PoolConfigurator._mode_inputs()
+        Step5PoolConfigurator._validate_worker_profile(kvc, max_running_requests)
+        requests = Step5PoolConfigurator._resolve_requests(kvc, max_running_requests)
+        geometry = Step5PoolConfigurator._resolve_geometry(kvc)
+        if Step5PoolConfigurator._mode_inputs() != mode:
+            raise RuntimeError("runtime sizing inputs changed during resolution")
+        return geometry, requests, mode
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_startup_mode(*, page: int) -> bool:
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import (
+            Backend,
+            Phase,
+            check_cuda_graph_backend,
+        )
+
+        schedule, spec = get_schedule(), get_spec()
+        if (
+            (
+                schedule.max_running_requests is not None
+                and schedule.max_running_requests < 1
+            )
+            or schedule.chunked_prefill_size is None
+            or schedule.chunked_prefill_size <= 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 startup requires positive request capacity and chunked prefill"
+            )
+        # Speculative chain shape and PD compatibility are validated once by the
+        # budget resolver. This boundary only checks execution/workspace needs.
+        mtp = spec.speculative_algorithm is not None
+        if page != 64:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 startup requires page64")
+        if mtp and (
+            not spec.enable_multi_layer_eagle
+            or schedule.enable_mixed_chunk
+            or schedule.chunked_prefill_size < page + 3
+            or not (
+                check_cuda_graph_backend(Phase.PREFILL, Backend.DISABLED)
+                or check_cuda_graph_backend(Phase.PREFILL, Backend.BREAKABLE)
+            )
+            or not (
+                check_cuda_graph_backend(Phase.DECODE, Backend.DISABLED)
+                or check_cuda_graph_backend(Phase.DECODE, Backend.FULL)
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step5 MTP startup requires fixed multi-layer MTP3/top1/width4, eager or breakable prefill "
+                "and eager/full-graph decode, "
+                "unmixed batches and chunked-prefill-size >= 67"
+            )
+        return mtp
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def quote(
+        *,
+        kvc: KVCacheConfigurator,
+        native_config: MemoryPoolConfig,
+        max_running_requests: int,
+        reservations: Step5KVReservations,
+    ) -> Step5MemoryPoolConfig:
+        """Price a supplied native config using real resolved metadata; no search."""
+
+        geometry, requests, mode = Step5PoolConfigurator._resolve(
+            kvc, max_running_requests
+        )
+        payload = Step5PoolConfigurator.price_pool(
+            native_config, geometry, requests, reservations
+        )
+        if (
+            kvc.resolve_max_num_reqs(payload.full_max_total_num_tokens)
+            != max_running_requests
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("native request resolution changed the declared B")
+        if Step5PoolConfigurator._mode_inputs() != mode:
+            raise RuntimeError("runtime sizing inputs changed while quoting")
+        return payload
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def solve(
+        *,
+        kvc: KVCacheConfigurator,
+        budget_bytes: int,
+        max_running_requests: int,
+        reservations: Step5KVReservations,
+        min_full_tokens: int,
+        max_full_tokens: int,
+        external_token_cap: int | None = None,
+        policy: HybridSWAPoolConfigurator | None = None,
+    ) -> Step5MemoryPoolConfig:
+        """Resolve once, then apply native capacity policy to pure byte accounting."""
+
+        geometry, requests, mode = Step5PoolConfigurator._resolve(
+            kvc, max_running_requests
+        )
+        if policy is None:
+            policy = _create_capacity_policy(kvc)
+        payload = Step5PoolConfigurator.solve_capacity(
+            geometry=geometry,
+            requests=requests,
+            policy=policy,
+            resolve_max_num_reqs=kvc.resolve_max_num_reqs,
+            automatic_requests=get_schedule().max_running_requests is None,
+            budget_bytes=budget_bytes,
+            reservations=reservations,
+            min_full_tokens=min_full_tokens,
+            max_full_tokens=max_full_tokens,
+            external_token_cap=external_token_cap,
+        )
+        if Step5PoolConfigurator._mode_inputs() != mode:
+            raise RuntimeError("runtime sizing inputs changed during the solve")
+        return replace(payload, budget_bytes=budget_bytes, mode_inputs=mode)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def price_pool(
+        native_config: MemoryPoolConfig,
+        geometry: Step5KVGeometry,
+        requests: Step5RequestCapacity,
+        reservations: Step5KVReservations,
+    ) -> Step5MemoryPoolConfig:
+        if not isinstance(native_config, MemoryPoolConfig):
+            raise ValueError("a native MemoryPoolConfig is required")
+        if not isinstance(reservations, Step5KVReservations):
+            raise ValueError("explicit complete Step5 reservations are required")
+        # Native MTP NHD copy warmup for K/V width 192 BF16 uses one int64[256]
+        # dummy-location tensor. This is another necessary individual lower bound,
+        # not a proved complete constructor peak and not a second charged term.
+        if geometry.draft_swa_ids and reservations.constructor_extra_bytes < 2048:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "constructor reserve is below the native KV copy warmup cost"
+            )
+        full, swa = (
+            native_config.full_max_total_num_tokens,
+            native_config.swa_max_total_num_tokens,
+        )
+        page = geometry.page_size
+        _step5_capacity("FULL capacity", full, page)
+        _step5_capacity("SWA capacity", swa, page)
+        _step5_integer("max_total_num_tokens", native_config.max_total_num_tokens, 1)
+        if native_config.max_running_requests is not None:
+            _step5_integer(
+                "native max_running_requests", native_config.max_running_requests, 1
+            )
+        for value in (
+            native_config.c4_max_total_num_tokens,
+            native_config.c128_max_total_num_tokens,
+            native_config.c4_state_pool_size,
+            native_config.c128_state_pool_size,
+        ):
+            _step5_integer("non-Step5 capacity", value)
+        if (
+            native_config.max_total_num_tokens != full
+            or native_config.max_running_requests
+            not in (None, requests.max_running_requests)
+            or any(
+                (
+                    native_config.c4_max_total_num_tokens,
+                    native_config.c128_max_total_num_tokens,
+                    native_config.c4_state_pool_size,
+                    native_config.c128_state_pool_size,
+                )
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "native pool config is not the requested plain FULL/SWA profile"
+            )
+        if full < 2 * requests.max_running_requests:
+            raise ValueError("FULL capacity would reduce the requested B")
+        # Native ratio sizing rejects equality at window + page. Chunk-cap's
+        # generic constrained entry does not check it, so retain this admission
+        # requirement explicitly after replaying an external Step5 token cap.
+        if swa <= geometry.sliding_window + page:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "SWA capacity is below the native window-plus-page admission floor"
+            )
+        if (
+            full > reservations.full_capacity_ceiling
+            or swa > reservations.swa_capacity_ceiling
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("capacities exceed the declared reservation domain")
+        state_request_capacity = requests.max_running_requests + requests.extra_slots
+        if not 1 <= state_request_capacity <= _STEP5_INT32_MAX:
+            raise ValueError("request slot IDs including PD extra slots exceed int32")
+        slots = state_request_capacity + 1
+        layers = len(geometry.target_full_ids)
+        compressed_index_key_bytes = (
+            layers
+            * (full // page + 1)
+            * (page // geometry.region_size)
+            * geometry.index_k_heads
+            * geometry.index_head_dim
+        )
+        ring_bytes = (
+            layers
+            * slots
+            * (
+                4
+                * requests.index_ring_size
+                * geometry.index_k_heads
+                * geometry.index_head_dim
+                + 8 * requests.index_ring_size
+            )
+        )
+        per_token = _step5_full_kv_bytes_per_token(
+            geometry.local_kv_heads,
+            geometry.k_head_dim,
+            geometry.v_head_dim,
+            fp8=False,
+        )
+        full_per_token = _step5_full_kv_bytes_per_token(
+            geometry.local_kv_heads,
+            geometry.k_head_dim,
+            geometry.v_head_dim,
+            fp8=geometry.full_kv_fp8,
+        )
+        layer_count = len(
+            geometry.target_full_ids + geometry.target_swa_ids + geometry.draft_swa_ids
+        )
+        # These two costs are consumed by allocation checks. The other costs are
+        # local arithmetic, not a string-keyed ledger required by pool construction.
+        index_state_bytes = _step5_bytes(compressed_index_key_bytes + ring_bytes)
+        # Public two-row stash: int64 tokens, FP32 hidden states, int32 length.
+        draft_boundary_stash_bytes = _step5_bytes(
+            slots * (8 * geometry.hidden_size + 20) if geometry.draft_swa_ids else 0
+        )
+        persistent = _step5_bytes(
+            (full + page) * len(geometry.target_full_ids) * full_per_token
+            + (swa + page)
+            * (len(geometry.target_swa_ids) + len(geometry.draft_swa_ids))
+            * per_token
+            + draft_boundary_stash_bytes
+            # ReqToTokenPool: int32 slot-to-token table (including slot zero).
+            + 4 * slots * requests.row_capacity
+            # Shared int64 FULL->SWA map, including dummy page and -1 sentinel.
+            + 8 * (full + page + 1)
+            # Two native allocators: int64 free-page IDs, no dummy page entry.
+            + 8 * (full // page + swa // page)
+            # MHATokenToKVPool: K/V pointers, combined pointers and strides.
+            # Each BF16 layer has (1 + 1 + 2 + 2) 64-bit entries.
+            + 8 * (1 + 1 + 2 + 2) * layer_count
+            + index_state_bytes
+        )
+        payload = Step5MemoryPoolConfig(
+            max_total_num_tokens=full,
+            full_max_total_num_tokens=full,
+            swa_max_total_num_tokens=swa,
+            max_running_requests=requests.max_running_requests,
+            geometry=geometry,
+            requests=requests,
+            index_state_bytes=index_state_bytes,
+            draft_boundary_stash_bytes=draft_boundary_stash_bytes,
+            persistent_payload_bytes=persistent,
+            reservations=reservations,
+        )

+        return self.topk(
+            hidden_states,
+            logits,
+            num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded,
+            expert_location_dispatch_info=expert_location_dispatch_info,
+        )
+
+
+def _step5_keep_bf16_experts(quant_config, prefix: str) -> bool:
+    if quant_config is None:
+        return True
+    ignored = quant_config.ignored_layers
+    w13_skipped = is_layer_skipped(f"{prefix}.w13_weight", ignored)
+    w2_skipped = is_layer_skipped(f"{prefix}.w2_weight", ignored)
+    if w13_skipped != w2_skipped:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Step5 expert matrices must have matching precision: {prefix}"
+        )
+    return w13_skipped and not envs.SGLANG_STEP5_QUANTIZE_BF16_MOE.get()
+
+
+_STEP5_EXPERT_LAYER = re.compile(r"layers\.(\d+)\.moe\.experts")
+_STEP5_EXPERT_TENSOR = re.compile(r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.moe\.experts\.\d+\.")
+_STEP5_PACKED_NVFP4_TENSOR = re.compile(
+    r"(?:^|\.)layers\.(\d+)\.moe\.(?:gate|up|down)_proj\.weight_scale_2$"
+)
+_STEP5_NVFP4_EXPERT_SOURCES = {
+    f"{projection}_proj.{suffix}": (f"{target}{param_suffix}", shard)
+    for projection, target, shard in (
+        ("gate", "w13", "w1"),
+        ("up", "w13", "w3"),
+        ("down", "w2", "w2"),
+    )
+    for suffix, param_suffix in (
+        ("weight", "_weight"),
+        ("weight_scale", "_weight_scale"),
+        ("weight_scale_2", "_weight_scale_2"),
+        ("input_scale", "_input_scale"),
+    )
+}
+_STEP5_NVFP4_PACKED_SOURCES = {
+    f"{projection}_proj.{suffix}": (f"{target}{param_suffix}", shard)
+    for projection, target, shard in (
+        ("gate", "w13", "w1"),
+        ("up", "w13", "w3"),
+        ("down", "w2", "w2"),
+    )
+    for suffix, param_suffix in (
+        ("weight", "_weight"),
+        ("weight_scale", "_weight_scale"),
+        ("weight_scale_2", "_weight_scale_2"),
+        ("input_scale", "_input_scale"),
+    )
+}
+_STEP5_NVFP4_PARAM_SOURCES = {
+    target: tuple(
+        source
+        for source, (candidate, _) in _STEP5_NVFP4_EXPERT_SOURCES.items()
+        if candidate == target
+    )
+    for target in dict.fromkeys(
+        target for target, _ in _STEP5_NVFP4_EXPERT_SOURCES.values()
+    )
+}
+
+
+def _step5_indexed_nvfp4_layers(checkpoint_path) -> dict[int, str] | None:
+    if not checkpoint_path:
+        return None
+    index_path = Path(checkpoint_path) / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if not index_path.is_file():
+        return None
+    layers: dict[int, str] = {}
+    for name in json.loads(index_path.read_text())["weight_map"]:
+        match = _STEP5_EXPERT_TENSOR.search(name)
+        if match is not None:
+            layers[int(match.group(1))] = "per_expert"
+            continue
+        match = _STEP5_PACKED_NVFP4_TENSOR.search(name)
+        if match is not None:
+            layers[int(match.group(1))] = "packed"
+    return layers
+
+
+def step5_nvfp4_expert_layouts(
+    config: Step5Config,
+    quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+    checkpoint_path: str | Path | None = None,
+) -> dict[int, str]:
+    """MoE layers whose routed experts are ModelOpt NVFP4, with their checkpoint layout.
+
+    ModelOpt exports the experts either per expert (``experts.E.gate_proj.weight``) or
+    packed per projection (``moe.gate_proj.weight`` with a leading expert axis); the
+    checkpoint index decides when it exists, otherwise the ModelOpt ignore list names the
+    layers whose experts stayed BF16/FP8 and the per-expert layout is assumed.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(quant_config, ModelOptFp4Config):
+        return {}
+    indexed = _step5_indexed_nvfp4_layers(checkpoint_path)
+    if indexed is not None:
+        return {
+            layer: indexed[layer] for layer in config.moe_layer_list if layer in indexed
+        }
+    excluded = set()
+    for pattern in quant_config.exclude_modules:
+        match = _STEP5_EXPERT_LAYER.search(pattern)
+        if match is not None:
+            excluded.add(int(match.group(1)))
+    return {
+        layer: "per_expert" for layer in config.moe_layer_list if layer not in excluded
+    }
+
+
+def step5_nvfp4_expert_layers(
+    config: Step5Config,
+    quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+    checkpoint_path: str | Path | None = None,
+) -> frozenset[int]:
+    return frozenset(step5_nvfp4_expert_layouts(config, quant_config, checkpoint_path))
+
+
+def step5_nvfp4_packed_source(
+    name: str, layouts: Mapping[int, str]
+) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    """Fused parameter and shard id for a packed per-projection NVFP4 expert tensor."""
+    head, marker, suffix = name.rpartition(".moe.")
+    source = _STEP5_NVFP4_PACKED_SOURCES.get(suffix) if marker else None
+    if source is None or layouts.get(_step5_layer_index(head)) != "packed":
+        return None
+    param_name, shard_id = source
+    return f"{head}.moe.experts.{param_name}", shard_id
+
+
+def step5_check_nvfp4_expert_scales(experts: FusedMoE, prefix: str) -> None:
+    """The fused kernels dequantise gate and up with one global scale per expert."""
+    scale = experts.w13_weight_scale_2
+    if (
+        scale.dim() == 2
+        and scale.shape[1] == 2
+        and not torch.equal(scale[:, 0], scale[:, 1])
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{prefix}: gate and up NVFP4 weight_scale_2 differ for "
+            f"{int((scale[:, 0] != scale[:, 1]).sum())} experts"
+        )
+
+
+def step5_expert_quant_config(
+    quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+    layer_id: int,
+    nvfp4_expert_layers: frozenset[int],
+) -> QuantizationConfig | None:
+    if (
+        not isinstance(quant_config, ModelOptFp4Config)
+        or layer_id in nvfp4_expert_layers
+    ):
+        return quant_config
+    # Experts the NVFP4 export left in BF16 follow the FP8 checkpoint's BF16 policy;
+    # SGLANG_STEP5_QUANTIZE_BF16_MOE=1 restores load-time FP8 quantization.
+    if not envs.SGLANG_STEP5_QUANTIZE_BF16_MOE.get():
+        return None
+    return Fp8Config(
+        is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized=True,
+        activation_scheme="dynamic",
+        weight_block_size=[128, 128],
+    )
+
+
+def step5_nvfp4_expert_source(name: str) -> tuple[str, str, int] | None:
+    """Map a per-expert ModelOpt tensor name to (fused param name, shard id, expert id)."""
+    head, marker, tail = name.rpartition(".moe.experts.")
+    if not marker:
+        return None
+    expert_text, _, source = tail.partition(".")
+    mapped = _STEP5_NVFP4_EXPERT_SOURCES.get(source)
+    if mapped is None or not expert_text.isdecimal():
+        return None
+    param_name, shard_id = mapped
+    return f"{head}{marker}{param_name}", shard_id, int(expert_text)
+
+
+def _step5_layer_index(prefix: str) -> int | None:
+    _, _, index = prefix.rpartition(".")
+    return int(index) if index.isdecimal() else None
+

+        # TODO(yhyang201): frozen SGLANG_STEP5_SHARED_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS; prune dead paths.
+        self.overlap_max_rows = step5_options.SHARED_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS

+
+    def _can_use_allreduce_dp_gather(self, gathered, forward_batch):
+        comm = get_tp_group().ca_comm
+        return (
+            self.use_allreduce_dp_gather
+            and not world_dp_gather_enabled()
+            and forward_batch.dp_padding_mode is not None
+            and forward_batch.dp_padding_mode.is_max_len()
+            and gathered.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and 0 < gathered.shape[0] <= 512
+            and gathered.shape[0] % 8 == 0
+            and isinstance(comm, CustomAllReduceV2)
+            and not comm.disabled
+            and comm.should_custom_ar(gathered)
+        )
+
+    def _forward_dp(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        gathered = get_global_dp_buffer(get_tp_group())
+        overlap = (
+            self.dp_alt_stream is not None
+            and self._can_use_allreduce_dp_gather(gathered, forward_batch)
+            and 0 < hidden_states.shape[0] <= self.dp_overlap_max_rows
+            and get_attn_tp_group()._can_use_flashinfer_allreduce(hidden_states)
+            and get_tp_group()._can_use_flashinfer_allreduce(gathered)
+            and (
+                forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            )
+        )
+        if not overlap:
+            shared = self.share_expert(hidden_states)
+            return shared, self._forward_dp_routed(
+                hidden_states, forward_batch=forward_batch
+            )
+
+        current = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.dp_alt_stream.wait_stream(current)
+        hidden_states.record_stream(self.dp_alt_stream)
+        # The leader-preserving gather leaves hidden_states untouched. Shared
+        # experts and their TP4 reduction can overlap the routed EP8 branch;
+        # the two reductions own distinct FlashInfer group workspaces.
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.dp_alt_stream):
+            shared = self.share_expert(hidden_states)
+        routed = self._forward_dp_routed(hidden_states, forward_batch=forward_batch)
+        current.wait_stream(self.dp_alt_stream)
+        shared.record_stream(current)
+        return shared, routed
+
+    def _forward_dp_routed(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, *, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # DP gather may overwrite nonleader inputs; compute shared output first.
+        gathered = get_global_dp_buffer(get_tp_group())
+        # Small B300 DP2 gathers use custom allreduce v2 instead of an
+        # attention-TP reduce-scatter followed by a global allgather. Retain
+        # each DP leader as the source, even if other attention ranks differ.
+        # Only globally shared geometry may select the collective sequence.
+        use_all_reduce = self._can_use_allreduce_dp_gather(gathered, forward_batch)
+        dp_gather_replicate(
+            gathered, hidden_states, forward_batch, use_all_reduce=use_all_reduce
+        )
+        # Every EP rank sees the same gathered rows. MegaMoE consumes global
+        # expert IDs and filters to this rank's experts; ordinary runners use
+        # StandardDispatcher. Both return partials for the single reduction below.
+        topk = self.router(gathered)
+        if self.use_mega_moe:
+            routed = forward_mega_moe_local_experts(
+                self.experts,
+                gathered,
+                topk.topk_ids,
+                topk.topk_weights,
+                group=get_moe_tp_group().device_group,
+                activation_clamp=self.swiglu_limit,
+            )
+        else:
+            routed = self.experts(gathered, topk)
+        routed = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(routed)
+        local = torch.empty_like(hidden_states)
+        dp_scatter(local, routed, forward_batch, fuse_zero_copy=use_all_reduce)
+        return local
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        num_token_non_padded: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | FlashInferTrtllmDeferredFinalizeOutput]:
+        """Return shared and routed outputs; routed output may defer finalization."""
+        if self.attn_dp_size > 1 and forward_batch is None:
+            raise ValueError("Step5 DP MoE requires native per-forward DP metadata")
+        if self.attn_dp_size > 1:
+            return self._forward_dp(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        overlap = (
+            self.alt_stream is not None
+            and 0 < hidden_states.shape[0] <= self.overlap_max_rows
+            and forward_batch is not None
+            and (
+                forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+                or forward_batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+            )
+        )
+        if overlap:
+            current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+            self.alt_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
+            # Keep collectives and routed workspace on the main stream.
+            hidden_states.record_stream(self.alt_stream)
+        else:
+            shared_output = self.share_expert(hidden_states)
+        topk = self.router(hidden_states, num_token_non_padded=num_token_non_padded)
+        if self.use_mega_moe:
+            routed_output = forward_mega_moe_local_experts(
+                self.experts,
+                hidden_states,
+                topk.topk_ids,
+                topk.topk_weights,
+                group=get_moe_tp_group().device_group,
+                activation_clamp=self.swiglu_limit,
+            )
+        elif (
+            self.fuse_shared_finalize
+            and hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and get_moe_runner_backend().value
+            in ("flashinfer_trtllm_routed", "flashinfer_trtllm")
+        ):
+            routed_output = self.experts.forward_deferred_finalize(hidden_states, topk)
+        else:
+            routed_output = self.experts(hidden_states, topk)
+        if overlap:
+            with torch.cuda.stream(self.alt_stream):
+                shared_output = self.share_expert(hidden_states)
+            current_stream.wait_stream(self.alt_stream)
+            shared_output.record_stream(current_stream)
+        return shared_output, routed_output
+

+_STEP5_ATTENTION_OWNERS: weakref.WeakValueDictionary[int, Step5Attention] = (

+def _step5_attention_core(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    owner_key: int,
+    use_gate_epilogue: bool,
+) -> None:
+    forward_batch = get_tc_piecewise_forward_context().forward_batch
+    owner = _STEP5_ATTENTION_OWNERS[owner_key]
+    layer = owner.attn
+    num_tokens = forward_batch.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu
+    backend = get_attn_backend()
+    kwargs = {}
+    if use_gate_epilogue:
+        kwargs["head_gate"] = gate[:num_tokens]
+    if owner.is_dsa:
+        metadata = backend.get_indexer_metadata(layer.layer_id, forward_batch)
+        # The index plan includes DP-alignment rows, but not the larger graph
+        # bucket tail. Its extent must also size the indexer and sparse queries.
+        if metadata is None:
+            output.zero_()
+            return
+        num_tokens = metadata.num_input_tokens
+        kwargs["index_selection"] = owner.indexer(
+            hidden_states[:num_tokens], positions[:num_tokens], metadata
+        )
+    out_cache_loc = forward_batch.out_cache_loc
+    forward_batch.out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc[:num_tokens]
+    try:
+        ret = backend.forward(
+            q[:num_tokens],
+            k[:num_tokens].view(-1, layer.tp_k_head_num, layer.qk_head_dim),
+            v[:num_tokens].view(-1, layer.tp_v_head_num, layer.v_head_dim),
+            layer,
+            forward_batch,
+            save_kv_cache=True,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+    finally:
+        forward_batch.out_cache_loc = out_cache_loc
+    output[:num_tokens].copy_(ret.reshape(num_tokens, output.shape[-1]))
+    output[num_tokens:].zero_()
+
+
+_breakable_step5_attention_core = eager_on_graph(True)(_step5_attention_core)
